title: Security Engineer
description:
About Prelude 

Prelude is redefining how companies authenticate and onboard users - turning what's traditionally a cost center into a growth lever.

Our flagship product lets businesses send OTP codes with the best price-to-conversion ratio on the market, dynamically selecting the most effective channel in real time (optimized SMS, WhatsApp, and more) while actively blocking spam and fraud that legacy providers miss.

Founded in 2022 by former Zenly team members who lived the pain of broken SMS authentication firsthand, we're already serving fast-growing companies across Europe and are expanding into the US. 

But authentication is only the starting point - we're building the platform for trust at scale, with an ambitious roadmap of market-defining products ahead.

Why join us 

Today, we're a team of 60 and growing, based in Paris, building products that power secure and high-performance user onboarding for companies across the world. We believe small, highly skilled teams outperform large, fragmented organizations, and we are intentional about staying focused on impact, quality, and speed.

We operate with a flat org structure and value in-person collaboration, which helps ideas move faster, decisions stay grounded, and teams take full ownership of what they build.
Our values 

- Care
We care deeply about our customers, our teammates, and the quality and reliability of what we ship.

- Bias for Action
We move fast, test in the real world, and iterate quickly rather than over-optimizing in theory.

- Ownership
We take responsibility end to end, from identifying problems to delivering outcomes and learning from results.

About the role

When your product is the front door to someone else’s product, security isn’t a feature, it’s the product. Every login and every signup that goes through Prelude is a moment where our customers trust us with their users, their phone numbers, and their reputation.

As our first dedicated Security Engineer, you’ll own security across Prelude: our cloud infrastructure, our codebase, our APIs and SDKs, and the way we handle the sensitive data that flows through them. You’ll start from solid ground: a certified ISO 27001 and SOC 2 program, short-lived credentials across our cloud environment, and a 24/7 on-call rotation. You’ll run that foundation day to day and take it further, with direct support from Engineering leadership and the founders.

This is a hands-on IC role: you’ll write code, ship guardrails, and fix things yourself, and set the standard for how every engineer at Prelude thinks about security.

What you’ll do

Own the security of our cloud infrastructure. Harden our AWS and ClickHouse environments and make the secure path the default for every service we deploy.

Build security into how we ship. Run threat modeling and design reviews with engineers, review critical code paths, and extend our automated checks in CI/CD (adding dependency scanning, secrets detection, and container and IaC security scanning) without slowing the team down.

Protect our customers’ users and their data. Personal data is at the heart of our product. Design and enforce the controls that protect it (encryption, access control, retention, and auditability) in line with GDPR and our customers’ expectations.

Mature detection and incident response. Extend our logging, alerting, and runbooks to spot abuse and compromise early, lead incident response when something goes wrong, and write honest post-mortems the next morning.

Drive compliance and customer trust. Maintain and mature our SOC 2 and ISO 27001 certifications through surveillance and recertification audits. Own our answers to enterprise security questionnaires, and be the technical voice of Prelude’s security posture with our largest customers.

Partner with our anti-fraud team. Fraud here isn’t theoretical. Work alongside the engineers fighting SMS pumping, toll fraud, bot traffic, and account takeover attempts in production, bringing an attacker’s mindset to the problems at the core of our product.

Use AI to multiply your impact. AI is already part of how we build. Make it part of how we defend: automate triage, log analysis, questionnaire answers, and code review so a team of one can operate like a team of five.

Join the on-call rotation for the systems you secure.

What we’re looking for

- 4+ years of experience in security engineering, application security, or cloud and infrastructure security, ideally at a fast-growing tech company

- Hands-on experience securing AWS in production (IAM, VPC, KMS, CloudTrail, GuardDuty, or equivalent), and comfort working with infrastructure as code

- Strong software engineering skills: you can read and write production code, ideally in Go or TypeScript, and fix vulnerabilities yourself rather than just filing tickets

- Solid knowledge of web and API security (OWASP Top 10, authentication and authorization flows, rate limiting, abuse prevention)

- Experience building or running security programs pragmatically: you know which 20% of controls cover 80% of the risk at a company our size

- Experience with incident response and with setting up logging, monitoring, and alerting

- A builder’s mindset: you prefer guardrails and automation over gatekeeping, and engineers see you as a partner, not a blocker

- Clear written and verbal communication: you can explain risk to an engineer, a founder, and a customer’s CISO

- Professional fluency in English, the working language of our international team

Nice to have

- Experience maintaining SOC 2 Type II and/or ISO 27001 certifications through audit cycles

- Background in identity, authentication, fintech, telecom, or another regulated or high-stakes domain

- Familiarity with fraud and abuse patterns (SMS pumping, bot traffic, account takeover)

- Penetration testing or red team experience, or a track record in bug bounty programs

- Knowledge of telecom protocols and ecosystem risks (SMPP, SS7, SIM swap)

- Experience with Connect/gRPC and Protobuf, Rust, or AWS serverless architectures

- French is a plus, not a requirement

Tech stack

- Languages: Go, TypeScript, React

- Infrastructure and data: AWS (Lambda, DynamoDB, Aurora PostgreSQL, ElastiCache, SQS), ClickHouse, Connect RPC and Protobuf

- Infrastructure as code and CI: AWS CDK (Go), GitHub Actions

- Observability: OpenTelemetry, Grafana

- Build: Bazel

- AI tooling: Claude Code, Cursor, and whatever comes next

title: Staff Software Engineer, Delivery Engineering
description:
Headquarters: Remote, Canada (EST) OR Remote, US (EST) OR Remote, UK

About CircleCI Engineering

CI/CD has been solved. Now it's being reinvented. AI agents don't just run pipelines. They write code, trigger builds, interpret failures, and propose fixes. The interfaces that developers use to understand and trust that work don't exist yet. We're building them.

At CircleCI, our guiding principles aren't posters on a wall. We learn fast: we run experiments, accept failure, and scale what works. We think like the customer: every decision connects back to the developer sitting in front of a failing build at 2 am. We own the outcome: not just our slice of it, but the whole thing. If that's how you already work, you'll fit here.

About Delivery Engineering

Delivery Engineering enables CircleCI engineers to deliver quickly, confidently, and securely. We provide the tools and resources that make standard patterns and best practices simple to adopt, and we reduce toil.

Our current focus is the agentic software development lifecycle: how changes are found, planned, built, reviewed, merged, and measured as AI agents take on more of the work. We evaluate the harnesses, repository patterns, skills, and agentic tooling available, decide what our teams should standardize on, and build and support the shared tooling other teams depend on.

We're a small, very senior team, and everyone on it shapes where we go. Every improvement we make compounds across the organization.

What You'll Do

- Build AI-natively. AI is how we work. It's not a productivity layer on top of engineering, but the default starting point for how problems get approached and solved.

- Shape how CircleCI builds software with agents. Help define the end-to-end agentic SDLC, from identifying a change through planning, execution, pull request, merge, and measuring impact afterward. Evaluate shared tooling and patterns, and help decide what teams standardize on.

- Start from how our teams actually work. Spend time with engineering teams to understand their workflows and where they get stuck. Use what you learn to drive decisions and direction that teams adopt because the work fits how they operate.

- Build platforms, not one-offs. Build and support shared tooling that other teams depend on, and own its adoption as much as its delivery. A tool nobody uses isn't done.

- Measure what matters. Instrument agent usage and outcomes so we know what improves throughput and quality and what just burns tokens. Treat cost, model choice, and reliability as design concerns.

- Make build-vs-buy calls. Evaluate models, vendors, and open-source tools against our needs, and choose the path that gets engineers the most leverage.

- Lead through influence. Write the design docs, lead technical discussions across teams, and mentor engineers across the org as they adopt agentic workflows.

What You'll Bring

- Direct experience driving agentic developer experience efforts. You've driven an initiative that changed how an engineering organization builds software with AI agents. You can speak to what you built, how you measured its impact, how you drove adoption, and what didn't work.

- Hands-on depth with agentic tooling. You work daily with coding agents, agent harnesses, MCP, and skills or prompt design. You know how to evaluate agent output and reason about model and token economics.

- A platform mindset. You've built and supported internal platforms or developer tooling that other engineers build on and rely on, and driven their adoption.

- Backend depth in Go. You've owned production backend services in Go, including API design, data modeling, and service integration.

- A track record at staff scope. 8+ years of production engineering experience, including technical decisions that spanned multiple teams and accountability for whether they landed.

- Decision-making grounded in your users. You build direction by listening first. You turn the needs of many teams into clear tradeoffs, document your reasoning, and bring people along.

This role is open to candidates based in Europe or in the Eastern time zone.

Sound like you?

You've stopped waiting for AI to mature and are already building with it, not as a productivity trick, but as a core part of how you think about problems. You care about the engineers using your tools as much as the code behind them. You're drawn to work where the patterns don't exist yet and the best answer requires you to invent it with the people who'll use it. If that's how you already operate, we want to talk.

$195,000 — $265,000 CAD 

United Kingdom Base Pay Range

£125,000 — £170,000 GBP 

Expected salary range for specific metro areas including Boston, Washington DC, Denver, Los Angeles, New York, Portland, San Diego, and Seattle. These metro areas may change periodically.

US Metro Zone 2

$200,000 — $275,000 USD 

Expected pay range for all other US locations not falling into Metro Zone 3 or Metro Zone 2.

US General

$180,000 — $250,000 USD 

We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation.

About CircleCI 

CircleCI is the world’s largest continuous integration/continuous delivery (CI/CD) platform, and the hub where code moves from idea to delivery. As one of the most-used DevOps tools - processing more than 3 million jobs a day - CircleCI has unique access to data on how the most effective engineering teams work, and the tools to help software companies successfully leverage the power of AI into their commercial applications. How CircleCI Uses AI in Hiring

title: AI Systems Engineer
description:
Who is Sonar? 

Sonar enables organizations to ship agentic code with confidence. Code creation is abundant, but confidence is scarce. Our core platform, SonarQube, verifies over 750 billion lines of code every day, delivering agentic verification and governance for all code. Trusted by more than 7 million developers and 75% of the Fortune 100, including teams at Nvidia, ServiceNow, Booking.com , Goldman Sachs, AstraZeneca, and Ford Motor Company, Sonar enables organizations to reduce outages, improve security, and lower the cost and risk of agentic software development.

Founded in Geneva and now headquartered in Austin, Texas, Sonar has a global team working across offices and hubs, including Silicon Valley, London, Bochum, Barcelona, Singapore, Tokyo, and the Washington, D.C. area. At Sonar, we’re enabling enterprises to build agentic software factories that can move quickly while maintaining the control, consistency and evidence required to ship with confidence. 

Position description 

The Business Technology team is composed of passionate technologists who are fully engaged in delivering the best products that help teams deliver their best work. We are focused on reducing friction and getting the most value from solutions to enhance outcomes. We want to expand our Business Technology landscape to manage more systems in a predictable way that accounts for scalability, resilience, and performance.

This role sits at the intersection of AI-native operations, enterprise platform engineering, and IT service management. You will own how Sonar designs, builds, and operationalizes AI-augmented systems across its internal technology ecosystem — engineering AI agents and connectors, automating workflows end-to-end, and integrating our enterprise tool stack, with Jira Service Management and the Atlassian suite as one core platform among several.

While Jira Service Management and the broader Atlassian suite form a core part of your platform footprint, your scope extends well beyond it: you will build and maintain integrations across our enterprise tool stack, engineer automation pipelines that eliminate manual work at scale, and operationalize AI-native capabilities (Enterprise Apps connectors, Claude MCP integrations, Rovo agents) that put Sonar ahead of the curve in AI-driven internal operations.

Your success will directly enable every internal team at Sonar to work faster, smarter, and with less friction — and will give leadership real-time visibility, consistent governance, and a platform that scales effortlessly with the company's global growth.

What you will do 

You are confident in owning and evolving a multi-platform internal technology ecosystem for a fast-growing, multi-site, multinational organization. You bring deep expertise in building AI-native systems and automations, and you are equally at home administering and evolving ITSM platforms — especially Atlassian — that anchor Sonar's internal operations.

You bring proven, multi-year experience in: 

- 
AI Systems & Agent Engineering (primary focus): Designing, building, and operationalizing AI-native capabilities across Sonar's internal stack — Claude MCP (Model Context Protocol) integrations, custom Claude skills, Rovo agents, and Enterprise Apps connectors. You prototype on the frontier, then harden what works into reliable, governed production systems that internal teams depend on daily.

- 
ITSM Platform Ownership (JSM): Administering, configuring, and continuously evolving Jira Service Management — including service catalog design, SLA management, queue configuration, request type rationalization, and automated routing. You treat JSM as a product, not a ticket system.

- 
Atlassian Suite Administration: Managing the full Atlassian Cloud ecosystem (Jira Software, Confluence, JSM, Guard, Loom, Trello, Bitbucket) with deep expertise in governance, user access management, project templates, and platform health monitoring.

- 
Automation Engineering: Designing and implementing sophisticated workflow automations — using Atlassian Automation, REST APIs, and third-party middleware — that eliminate manual processes and scale operations without adding headcount.

- 
Enterprise Integration Architecture: Building and maintaining integrations between Atlassian and adjacent enterprise systems (Slack, HR platforms, identity providers, monitoring tools) using webhooks, APIs, and marketplace apps.

- 
CMDB & Asset Management: Owning JSM Assets configuration, data integrity, and lifecycle management across IT hardware, software licenses, and configuration items (CIs) — ensuring a reliable, audit-ready source of truth.

- 
ITSM Process Governance: Defining and enforcing ITIL-aligned processes including incident management, change management, problem management, and access management — translating business needs into governed, automated workflows.

- 
Security, Compliance & Audit Support: Ensuring platform configurations adhere to SonarSource's data protection, access control, and audit requirements. Supporting external audit engagements (KPMG, PwC) with documentation and evidence packages.

- 
Stakeholder Enablement: Partnering with all internal teams (HR, Finance, Legal, IT, Security, GTM) to identify automation opportunities, gather requirements, and deliver continuous improvements — acting as a true internal platform consultant.

- 
Platform Roadmap Contribution: Proactively identifying opportunities to modernize internal processes, adopt new platform capabilities, and drive the platform roadmap forward in partnership with the BizTech BackOffice lead

Experience and qualifications 

Experience & Technical Acumen 

- 
AI Engineering (Required): Hands-on experience with AI-native platforms and building on them — Claude/Anthropic, MCP, agent frameworks (Rovo or equivalent), connectors, and prompt-based workflows. You've built and shipped something real, not just experimented.

- 
Atlassian Platform Expertise (Required): 5+ years hands-on administration of Jira Service Management (JSM), Jira Software, and Confluence Cloud in enterprise, multi-team environments. Deep knowledge of JSM request types, workflows, SLAs, queues, automations, and service catalog design.

- 
Automation & Integration Engineering: Proven experience building workflow automations using Atlassian Automation and/or third-party tools. Comfortable with REST APIs, webhooks, and JSON for system integrations. Scripting experience (Python, Groovy, JavaScript) is a strong plus.

- 
Enterprise Tool Breadth: Experience with adjacent enterprise systems — identity providers (Okta, JumpCloud), collaboration tools (Slack, Zoom), or business systems (NetSuite, BambooHR, Salesforce) — is a strong differentiator. We don't need deep expertise in all of them, but curiosity and adaptability across the stack matters.

- 
CMDB / Asset Management: Experience configuring and maintaining a CMDB or IT asset management system (JSM Assets, ServiceNow CMDB, or equivalent).

- 
ITSM & ITIL Knowledge: Strong understanding of ITSM processes and ITIL v3/v4 frameworks — including incident, change, problem, and request management — with the ability to configure platform workflows that enforce these processes at scale.

- 
Security & Compliance Awareness: Understanding of IT General Controls (ITGC), access governance, and audit-readiness requirements. Experience supporting external audit engagements is a plus.

- 
Atlassian Certifications (Plus): ACP-620 (Jira Service Management), ACP-120 (Jira Administrator), or ACP-420 (Confluence Administrator) are highly valued.

Leadership & Soft Skills 

- 
Exceptional analytical, strategic thinking, and problem-solving abilities — you see patterns others miss and turn complexity into clean solutions.

- 
Highly autonomous and pragmatic: you make concrete progress in the face of ambiguity and imperfect information, without waiting for perfect requirements.

- 
Strong decision-making skills, with the ability to prioritize across competing demands and manage multiple concurrent initiatives.

- 
Self-confident enough to challenge the status quo — and to give and receive direct feedback in the service of continuous improvement.

- 
Excellent communication skills for both technical and non-technical audiences. Fluent in English, written and verbal.

- 
Collaborative by nature: you share information and ideas freely, and you understand that the best solutions emerge from collective thinking.

- 
Leadership mindset: you take ownership of initiatives end-to-end and drive them to completion with accountability and autonomy.

- 
Values "done" over "perfect" — while continuously looking for ways to improve processes and deliver measurable impact.

In-office culture 

We're intentional about this. We believe the best teams are built in the room together. Three anchor days — Mondays, Tuesdays, and Thursdays — create the collaboration rhythm that makes a hub office worth having. 

Candidates need to be genuinely based in the location the role is posted — if that's not where you are today, we're happy to support relocation for the right person.

We value diversity, equity, and inclusion 

At Sonar, we believe that our diversity is our strength. We are a global company that values and respects different backgrounds, perspectives, and cultures. We are committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive work environment where everyone feels valued and empowered to contribute their best. We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer and welcome all qualified applicants, regardless of race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, or veteran status.

If you need any accommodation, please reach out to us at All offers of employment at Sonar are contingent upon the results of a comprehensive background check and reference verification conducted before the start date. 

Applications that are submitted through agencies or third party recruiters will not be considered.

- Build and maintain the dbt models behind client reporting, following our layered structure from source to report. 

- Develop Looker reporting end to end: LookML views and explores, dashboards embedded in our platform, and the client-specific logic behind them. 

- Turn client and Customer Success requests into reports, and push back when a definition or requirement is unclear.

- Help migrate client reporting models from Snowflake to Databricks, including clients with specific data residency needs. 

- Align client metrics with the shared definitions in our central data foundation, so customers and internal teams see the same numbers.

Nice to have

- Python. 

- Dutch. 

Our stack

- A competitive salary and real influence on how client reporting is built.

title: Architect
description:
Headquarters: Remote - US

Who we are 

At Twilio, we’re shaping the future of communications, all from the comfort of our homes. We deliver innovative solutions to hundreds of thousands of businesses and empower millions of developers worldwide to craft personalized customer experiences.

Our dedication to remote-first work , and strong culture of connection and global inclusion means that no matter your location, you’re part of a vibrant team with diverse experiences making a global impact each day. As we continue to revolutionize how the world interacts, we’re acquiring new skills and experiences that make work feel truly rewarding. Your career at Twilio is in your hands.
. 

Hiring and how we work 

We use Artificial Intelligence (AI) to help make our hiring process efficient. That said, every hiring decision is made by real Twilions! 

Also, while we are a remote-first company, you may be asked to report in person on an ad-hoc basis for team gatherings, functional off-sites or customer meetings.
. 

See yourself at Twilio 

Join the team as Twilio’s next Architect on our Data Substrate team

About the job 

Twilio runs on data, and the platform underneath it is entering a major shift. Open table formats, the convergence of lakes and warehouses, tightening privacy regulation, and AI workloads are all changing what a data platform has to do. We’re hiring an Architect to set our direction through that shift and to make sure the systems we build over the next 3-5 years are the right ones.

You’ll own the technical strategy for our data platform, spanning storage, lake and lakehouse architecture, catalog and governance, and privacy-by-design. You’ll work across org boundaries, setting standards that dozens of teams build on and raising the technical bar for the engineers around you.

Responsibilities 

In this role, you’ll:

- Own the architecture and multi-year technical strategy for the data platform, including the lake/lakehouse, ClickHouse, Elasticsearch, and governance, and keep them coherent as one platform rather than separate systems. Define where each engine fits (for example, ClickHouse versus open table formats on object storage) and the migration path between them.

- Make and document the major design decisions (ADRs, RFCs) on storage and open table formats, catalog strategy, compute engines, tenancy, data placement, and build-versus-adopt tradeoffs, with cost and performance at petabyte scale as explicit design constraints.

- Set the reference architectures for how our core storage and query engines (ClickHouse, Elasticsearch, and lake engines) are deployed, tuned, scaled and operated as shared platforms, including capacity, cost, tenant isolation, and upgrade strategy.

- Define the reliability model for the platform: availability targets, failure domains, disaster recovery, observability, and incident response patterns that teams can adopt.

- Build privacy and compliance into the architecture, not onto it. Design deletion and right-to-erasure, retention, data residency, and PII classification so they work across the platform’s storage layers, backups, and derived datasets, including data that arrives from upstream streaming systems.

- Drive data governance: classification, catalog and metadata, lineage, access control integrated with our authentication and authorization systems, data contracts, quality and integrity standards, and a catalog teams actually use.

- Review designs and technical direction across the org, and act as the escalation point on hard distributed-systems and performance problems.

- Mentor principal and senior engineers, and grow architectural judgment across the org, not only within one squad.

- Partner with product, security, infrastructure and consuming teams to turn business needs into platform roadmaps, and say no or re-sequence when the tradeoffs require it.

- Track emerging data technologies (such as streaming-first architectures, federated query, and AI-ready data layers) and bring forward the ones worth adopting, with evidence from prototypes or benchmarks.

Qualifications 

Twilio values diverse experiences from all kinds of industries, and we encourage everyone who meets the required qualifications to apply. If your career is just starting or hasn't followed a traditional path, don't let that stop you from considering Twilio. We are always looking for people who will bring something new to the table!

Required: 

- Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

- 15+ years of experience in software development or a related field, with at least 8 years in an architecture or senior technical leadership role.

- Proven track record of architecting and delivering large-scale data platforms and setting their technical strategy, on cloud infrastructure such as AWS, deployed with Kubernetes, Terraform and Helm.

- Deep expertise in storage and compute for analytical data: columnar and open table formats, lake and lakehouse architecture, partitioning, indexing, query planning, and how the choices affect cost and performance at petabyte scale.

- Breadth across data storage and retrieval technologies, with hands-on depth in at least two of: analytical/OLAP engines (e.g., ClickHouse), search engines (e.g., ElasticSearch/OpenSearch), and lake or distributed processing engines (e.g., Spark, Trino, Flink). You can reason about when to use each, how they interoperate, and how to migrate between them.

- Working knowledge of streaming systems (e.g., Kafka) and how they interact with downstream storage.

- Practical experience designing data governance at scale: data classification, catalog and metadata management, lineage, and access control integrated with authentication and authorization systems.

- Practical experience implementing privacy and compliance requirements (deletion, retention, residency) across a large, heterogeneous data estate.

- Proficiency in one or more of Python, Java, and Go.

- Track record of writing and driving architecture decisions across multiple teams, and of changing the direction of an organization’s technical roadmap through influence rather than authority.

- Experience elevating engineering standards and mentoring senior engineers across teams.

- Demonstrated commitment to operational excellence: architecting for high availability, observability and incident response in distributed systems, and being credible when a platform is failing in production.

- Strong written and verbal communication, including making a complex tradeoff clear to engineers and to senior leadership.

Desired: 

- Experience operating one of these engines (e.g., ClickHouse, ElasticSearch) at scale, including replication, sharding, ingestion behavior, and multi-tenant isolation.

- Experience with catalog and metadata systems (e.g., Unity Catalog, Glue, Polaris, DataHub) and open table format catalog strategy.

- Experience with a platform migration across domains or ownership models, such as moving from central to domain-owned data.

- A track record of measurable cost optimization on large data platforms.

- Networking and network security knowledge.

Location 

This role will be remote, and based in the United States. 

Travel 

We prioritize connection and opportunities to build relationships with our customers and each other. For this role, you may be required to travel occasionally to participate in project or team in-person meetings.

What We Offer 

Working at Twilio offers many benefits, including competitive pay, generous time off, ample parental and wellness leave, healthcare, a retirement savings program, and much more. Offerings vary by location 

Compensation 

*Please note this role is open to candidates outside of California, Colorado, Hawaii, Illinois, Maryland, Massachusetts, Minnesota, New Jersey, New York, Vermont, Washington D.C., and Washington State. The information below is provided for candidates hired in those locations only. 

The estimated pay ranges for this role are as follows:

- Based in Colorado, Hawaii, Illinois, Maryland, Massachusetts, Minnesota, Vermont or Washington D.C. : $211,920 - $264,900. 

- Based in New York, New Jersey, Washington State, or California (outside of the San Francisco Bay area): $224,400 - $280,500.

- Based in the San Francisco Bay area, California: $249,360 - $311,700.

This role may be eligible to participate in Twilio’s equity plan and corporate bonus plan. All roles are generally eligible for the following benefits: health care insurance, 401(k) retirement account, paid sick time, paid personal time off, paid parental leave.

The successful candidate’s starting salary will be determined based on permissible, non-discriminatory factors such as skills, experience, and geographic location.

Application deadline information 

Applications for this role are intended to be accepted until 1/4/2027 but may change based on business needs. 

. 

Twilio thinks big. Do you? 

We like to solve problems, take initiative, pitch in when needed, and are always up for trying new things. That's why we seek out colleagues who embody our values — something we call Twilio Magic . Additionally, we empower employees to build positive change in their communities by supporting their volunteering and donation efforts.

So, if you're ready to unleash your full potential, do your best work, and be the best version of yourself, apply now! If this role isn't what you're looking for, please consider other open positions. 
. 

Stay alert to recruitment fraud 

We care about your safety. Scammers sometimes impersonate Twilio recruiters through fake job postings, emails, websites, or messages. Please ensure you are engaging with an official @ twilio.com email address. We will never ask for payment, gift cards, cryptocurrency, or banking information during the recruiting process. We do not make job offers without a formal interview process or conduct interviews exclusively through text-based messaging apps.
. 

Twilio is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, reproductive health decisions, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, genetic information, political views or activity, or other applicable legally protected characteristics. We also consider qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law. Qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers and the California Fair Chance Act. Additionally, Twilio participates in the E-Verify program in certain locations, as required by law.

title: Senior PMO Analyst

About the Role 

Imagine this. You are joining Destinus at a pivotal moment, helping build a Project Management Office (PMO) from the ground up while supporting multiple fast-moving aerospace and defense programs. As a Senior PMO Analyst, you will play a key role in bringing structure, visibility, and execution discipline to complex programs, ensuring our Program Managers can focus on delivering groundbreaking technologies.

Destinus is scaling multiple aerospace and defense programs in parallel, and we are looking for a proactive, hands-on professional who can take real workload off our Program Managers from day one. You will be embedded directly in our programs while helping establish the cross-functional processes, tools, and governance needed to support our growth.

Reporting to the Head of PMO and working in close collaboration with C-level leadership, you will have the opportunity to shape how our programs are planned, monitored, and delivered. From building integrated schedules and managing risks to introducing AI-powered tools and automations, your work will have a direct and visible impact across the organization.

At Destinus, we are revolutionizing the defense industry with cutting-edge Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAVs). Our innovative technologies are designed to meet the unique demands of modern defense operations, delivering unparalleled speed, precision, and cost effectiveness. Destinus partners with government agencies and defense organizations worldwide to provide advanced solutions for mission-critical operations, enabling a new era of efficiency and technological superiority. Join us in shaping the future of defense with groundbreaking aerospace innovations.

What You'll Do 

Program Planning & Execution 

- Proactively step in alongside Program Managers and take ownership of core PMO activities, including integrated program plans, milestones, critical paths, and schedule control.
- Support one or several programs simultaneously, ensuring effective coordination and acting as a connector between teams and programs.
- Track program dependencies, budgets, and resources across multiple initiatives, identifying potential conflicts and escalating issues early.
- Help Program Managers maintain clear visibility over progress, priorities, and delivery commitments, enabling them to focus on critical program execution.
PMO Development & Cross-Functional Processes 

- Work closely with the Head of PMO to build the PMO foundation from scratch, developing standards, templates, governance frameworks, and practical ways of working that teams actually use.
- Lead the development and implementation of cross-functional processes spanning programs and departments, from Engineering and Supply Chain to Production, Quality, and Delivery.
- Establish scalable processes that improve collaboration, consistency, and operational efficiency as Destinus continues to grow.
- Help create a structured yet pragmatic PMO environment that supports fast decision-making without introducing unnecessary complexity.
Risk, Issue & Performance Management 

- Drive program risk and issue management by proactively identifying, assessing, tracking, and escalating potential challenges.
- Coordinate and follow up on mitigation actions, ensuring risks and issues are addressed effectively and on time.
- Prepare clear program reports, dashboards, and decision-making materials for program reviews and senior leadership.
- Provide accurate and actionable insights into program performance, highlighting key milestones, risks, dependencies, and areas requiring management attention.
AI, Automation & Continuous Improvement 

- Develop and apply AI-supported tools and automations to make PMO activities faster, more efficient, and more reliable.
- Identify opportunities to automate repetitive activities, including reporting, status consolidation, and action tracking.
- Explore and implement practical solutions using AI tools, workflow automation, scripting, and low-code platforms where appropriate.
- Continuously improve PMO tools, processes, and reporting methods to reduce administrative workload and increase visibility across programs.
Stakeholder Management & Leadership Collaboration 

- Work closely with Program Managers, the Head of PMO, and C-level leadership to support program execution and strategic decision-making.
- Act as a central point of coordination across programs and functions, ensuring information, priorities, and dependencies remain aligned.
- Translate complex program information into structured, concise, and actionable updates for different stakeholders.
- Build strong working relationships across Engineering, Supply Chain, Production, Quality, and other business functions to drive effective collaboration.
Requirements 

What You'll Need 

Required Qualifications & Experience 

- At least 5 years of experience in PMO, Program Management, or Project Controls.

- Strong command of PMO fundamentals, including scheduling, risk management, reporting, and stakeholder management.

- A proactive, structured, and pragmatic approach to work, with a strong sense of ownership and the ability to operate at pace.

- Confidence working from a blank page and building structure in a fast-moving, ambiguous scale-up environment.

- Fluency in English and German, both written and spoken.

- Familiarity with project management and collaboration tools such as MS Project, Jira, Microsoft Dynamics and other ERP systems, Smartsheet, Confluence, or similar platforms.

- Strong Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint skills, with the ability to create clear reports, dashboards, and leadership presentations.

- Eligibility to work in Switzerland.

- Willingness to travel occasionally to other Destinus locations.

Strong Plus 

- Previous consulting experience, ideally involving PMO setup, transformation, or hands-on PMO support for client companies.

- Practical experience using AI tools and automation technologies, including Large Language Models (LLMs), workflow automation, scripting, or low-code platforms.

- Experience designing, implementing, and improving cross-functional business processes.

- Understanding of hardware development and engineering environments, including product lifecycle management, gate reviews, and change management.

Nice to Have 

- Project management certification such as PMP, PRINCE2, or SAFe.

- Experience in aerospace, defense, automotive, or other complex hardware industries.

- Technical skills in Python, SQL, Power BI, or API-based integrations.

Who You Are 

- You are proactive by nature and do not wait for instructions to make things happen. You identify what needs to be done, take ownership, and deliver results.

- You thrive in fast-paced environments where priorities evolve quickly, ambiguity is part of the challenge, and building structure from scratch is an opportunity rather than an obstacle.

- You combine strong analytical thinking with a practical, hands-on approach, knowing when to dive into the details and when to focus on the bigger picture.

- You enjoy bringing clarity to complexity, transforming scattered information, competing priorities, and challenging timelines into actionable plans.

- You are comfortable working closely with Program Managers and senior leadership, communicating confidently and turning complex program information into clear recommendations.

- You are naturally collaborative and know how to connect people, teams, and functions to keep programs moving forward.

- You challenge inefficient processes and actively look for smarter ways of working, especially through technology, AI, and automation.

- You are organized, detail-oriented, and reliable, with the ability to manage multiple priorities without losing sight of deadlines or deliverables.

- You bring a continuous improvement mindset, balancing the discipline of structured program management with the flexibility required in a rapidly growing company.

- You are comfortable taking initiative, making decisions, and working independently while knowing when to involve others or escalate critical issues.

- You value transparency, accountability, and teamwork, and you are motivated by making a tangible impact on complex aerospace and defense programs.

What We Offer 

- A founding role in building the PMO of a fast-growing aerospace company, with the opportunity to shape its structure and future direction.

- The freedom to develop and influence the tools, processes, standards, and ways of working that will support our continued growth.

- Direct access to senior leadership, including close collaboration with the Head of PMO and C-level executives, and the opportunity to make a visible impact across multiple programs.

- The chance to join a high-performing, international team working on advanced aerospace and defense technologies that matter.

title: Senior Data Engineer
description:
Data die het verschil maakt 

Data is pas waardevol als een organisatie erop kan bouwen. Als Senior Data Engineer bij LINKIT zorg jij daarvoor: je ontwerpt platformen die schaalbaar, betrouwbaar en toekomstbestendig zijn, en je kijkt verder dan de losse pipeline. Klinkt dat als jouw volgende stap?

De uitdaging 

Als Senior Data Engineer kom je in dienst bij LINKIT en ga je aan het werk bij toonaangevende opdrachtgevers in mobiliteit, energie en financiële dienstverlening. Je draagt bij aan platformen die er echt toe doen: data-oplossingen voor internationale treinreizen bij NS, moderne beleggingsplatformen bij Robeco en schaalbare data ecosystemen bij EDSN en Stedin. Je ontwerpt en bouwt schaalbare data pipelines in Cloud omgevingen, ontwikkelt betrouwbare datamodellen die organisatiebreed worden gebruikt en denkt actief mee over architectuur, performance en onderhoudbaarheid. Je werkt nauw samen met analytics- en data science-teams om data ML-ready te maken en verbetert bestaande oplossingen waar dat waarde toevoegt. Als Senior Data Engineer maak je zo het verschil op zowel technisch als strategisch niveau.

Je plek binnen LINKIT 

Je werkt in de Data Engineering squad: een groep Explorers (zo noemen wij onze collega’s) die elkaar scherp houdt op vakmanschap en samen bouwt aan oplossingen voor complexe dataomgevingen. Kennis delen is de norm, niet de uitzondering. Om de twee weken kom je op vrijdag terug naar het hoofdkantoor in De Meern voor de clubdag, waarin we tijd investeren in leren, verbinden en vooruitkijken.

Lees hier meer over de Data Engineering squad.

Wat we vragen 

- 5+ jaar ervaring in data engineering binnen complexe omgevingen.

- Sterke programmeervaardigheden in talen zoals Python, Scala en SQL.

- Kennis van of ervaring met distributed data processing frameworks/datalakes/orchestrators zoals Spark, Flink, Delta Lake, Iceberg, Airflow, dbt, etc.

- Ruime ervaring met production ELT/ETL-pipelines.

- Ervaring met batch/streaming dataverwerking.

- Ervaring met CI/CD op cloudplatformen.

- Ervaring met een cloudplatform zoals Azure, AWS of GCP.

- Je communiceert goed in het Nederlands en spreekt vloeiend Engels.

- Pré: ervaring met Databricks, Snowflake, MS Fabric of BigQuery.

Voldoe je niet aan elk punt, maar wel nieuwsgierig? Dan komen we alsnog graag met je in contact.

Wat je krijgt 

- Salaris tussen €5.700-€7.400 per maand (o.b.v. 40 uur, afhankelijk van kennis & ervaring) + 8% vakantiegeld.

- Jaarlijkse winstdeling en pensioenregeling.

- Hybride werken: op ons hoofdkantoor in De Meern, bij de klant of vanuit huis.

- 25 vakantiedagen en de mogelijkheid om tijdelijk vanuit het buitenland te werken.

- Elektrische leaseauto of mobiliteitsvergoeding.

- Netto thuiswerkvergoeding, een goed ingerichte thuiswerkplek en een laptop en telefoon, die je ook privé kunt gebruiken.

- Om de twee weken op vrijdag komen alle collega's terug naar ons hoofdkantoor in De Meern, dan investeren wij tot 10% van jouw werktijd in kennisdeling, leren en verbinden (dit noemen wij de clubdag).

- Extra's zoals onbeperkt opleidingsbudget, dagelijkse verse lunch, jaarlijks wintersport en wellbeing-activiteiten, zoals een wijnproeverij en yoga.

Sollicitatieprocedure 

We willen je leren kennen, en jij ons. Daarom houden we het persoonlijk en concreet.

- Kennismaking: Een eerste gesprek over wie je bent, wat je drijft en of er een match is.

- Verdiepende gesprekken: Twee gesprekken over je ervaring, werkwijze en hoe jij past binnen de squad en bij onze klanten.

- Aanbieding: Als het klikt, volgt een concreet aanbod.

Vragen vooraf? Neem contact op met Tabea Hensel via 

Over ons 

LINKIT is opgericht in 1998 en gegroeid van IT-bemiddelaar naar kennisgedreven IT-organisatie, met ruim 250 Explorers uit meer dan 25 nationaliteiten. We werken voor grote organisaties in overheid, finance en logistiek als partner die meedenkt van vraagstuk tot oplossing. Als Senior Data Engineer ga je aan het werk bij toonaangevende opdrachtgevers, met een contract bij LINKIT. Je bepaalt je eigen richting, met een ongelimiteerd opleidingsbudget en de ruimte om te groeien op een manier die bij jou past.

Rethink it with LINKIT.

title: Software Engineer - PlanetScale Postgres
description:
Headquarters: Remote

PlanetScale is growing rapidly and reinventing the database space. The PlanetScale platform delivers a fully managed, multi-cloud Postgres service designed for the most demanding production workloads. We handle the complexity of provisioning, scaling, replication, and failover - so engineering teams can focus on building their products.

Our customers entrust us with their most precious digital asset, their data, so the stakes couldn't be higher. We're looking for a Software Engineer to join our Postgres engineering team and help us build a world-class managed Postgres offering.

What's the job to be done?

- You will design and build the control plane that provisions, scales, and heals Postgres clusters with minimal customer-visible downtime.

- You will build and maintain high availability, disaster recovery, and data protection solutions that keep customer databases safe through infrastructure failures.

- You will tune Postgres to operate at scale for some of the largest and most demanding workloads in the world.

- You will build tooling and automation for database operations, backup, restore, and migration workflows - and participate in an on-call rotation.

- You will work directly with customers to understand their workloads and translate real-world needs into platform improvements.

These attributes best describe you…

- You have strong experience building, operating, or maintaining large-scale Postgres deployments in production.

- You have an excellent understanding of low-level operating systems concepts including multi-threading, memory management, networking, storage, and performance.

- You have strong fundamental computer science skills and can reason about distributed, fault-tolerant systems.

- You thrive in a collaborative environment, enjoy mentoring other engineers, and communicate complex technical tradeoffs clearly.

- You are self-motivated and can work independently with minimal guidance while making sound technical decisions.

What you will need

- 5+ years of software engineering experience designing, building, and supporting large-scale systems in production.

- Strong proficiency in Go, with experience in other languages like Ruby, Python, Zig or Rust.

- Experience building and maintaining distributed, fault-tolerant services.

- Working knowledge of Kubernetes and containerized applications.

- Experience building and operating distributed systems at scale.

What else will help you be successful

- Experience building or operating a database-as-a-service or managed database platform.

- Experience with connection pooling and proxy layers for Postgres.

- Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, Azure) and infrastructure-as-code.

- Contributions to open-source projects, especially in the Postgres or database infrastructure space.

- Experience working with remote, geographically distributed teams.

- Previous experience at a high-growth technology company.

Why PlanetScale

We're redefining how high-growth companies manage data at scale—and we work with some of the most exciting brands in gaming, consumer tech, and B2B SaaS. As a Software Engineer, you'll be at the core of building the platform that powers world-class apps used by hundreds of millions of users worldwide. PlanetScale is a profitable company with a philosophy centered around building small teams of p99 individuals and is recognized as one of the fastest growing companies in America.

At PlanetScale we believe in supporting people to do their best work and thrive no matter the location. Our mission is to build a diverse, equitable, and inclusive company. We strive to build an inclusive environment where all people feel that they are equally respected and valued, whether they are a candidate or an employee. We welcome applicants of any educational background, gender identity and expression, sexual orientation, religion, ethnicity, age, citizenship, socioeconomic status, disability, pregnancy status, and veteran status.

If you have a disability, please let us know if there's any way we can make the interview process better for you; we're happy to accommodate!

Total Compensation and Pay Transparency

An employee's total compensation consists of base salary + variable comp where appropriate + benefits + equity. A member of our Talent Acquisition team will be happy to answer any further questions when we engage with you to begin the interview process.

Base salary range: $120,000 - $290,000 USD

title: Data Platform Lead
description:
Studytube maakt professionele ontwikkeling toegankelijk. Klanten willen zien wat hun leren oplevert, de business wil sturen op cijfers die kloppen en onze AI-ambities staan of vallen met goede data. Daarom zoeken we een Data Platform Lead die het fundament bouwt waar heel Studytube op draait. 

De rol 

Data werkt bij Studytube als hub-and-spoke. Jij leidt de hub: het gedeelde dataplatform binnen Engineering, met infrastructuur, pipelines, het lakehouse en de gedeelde datamodellen. De spokes zitten in de business, van finance en product tot Customer Success en GTM. Zij bouwen de analyses en dashboards, jij zorgt dat de data eronder klopt, vindbaar is en meebeweegt met het product. 

Je rapporteert aan de Head of Engineering en geeft leiding aan de data engineer. Op termijn breiden we het team uit met een analytics engineer. Je bent een player-coach: je zet de koers uit en bouwt zelf mee. 

Wat je doet 

- Je bent eigenaar van het dataplatform en de architectuur, en stelt de roadmap op samen met de spokes. 

- Je zorgt voor één versie van de waarheid. De spokes bepalen wat een actieve learner is, jij zorgt dat die definitie één keer gebouwd wordt en overal hetzelfde getal oplevert. 

- Je bouwt het platform als product: self-service, documentatie en heldere afspraken, zodat analisten zelfstandig vooruit kunnen. 

- Je legt het datafundament voor AI, voor features in het product en voor interne toepassingen op bedrijfsdata. Je team bouwt zelf sneller met AI-tools. 

- Je neemt het Databricks-platform over van een externe partij, inclusief een high-security omgeving, en denkt mee over de toekomst van onze stack. 

- Je richt governance in het platform in: toegang, datakwaliteit, lineage, retentie en verwijdering, GDPR-proof. 

- Je weegt verzoeken van de spokes tegen elkaar af en legt je keuzes uit, ook als het antwoord nee is. 

- Je coacht het team, werft mee aan de uitbreiding en spreidt kennis, zodat niets van één persoon afhangt. 

Je hebt eerder een dataplatform opgezet of volwassen gemaakt, het liefst in een scale-up. Je bent technisch diep, maar denkt vanuit je gebruikers: een analist die een tabel niet vindt of niet vertrouwt, is voor jou een platformprobleem. Je legt trade-offs uit aan zowel de directie als een developer. 

Je bent pragmatisch, nieuwsgierig naar wat AI verandert aan het vak en haalt energie uit het laten groeien van anderen. 

Must-haves 

- 8+ jaar ervaring in data, waarvan minimaal 2 jaar als lead van een team of platform. 

- Hands-on ervaring in de hele keten: een cloud data platform en pipelines, en SQL, dbt en Python in productie. 

- Databricks in productie (Delta Lake, Unity Catalog), bij voorkeur op Azure. 

- Terraform of andere infrastructure-as-code en CI/CD met GitHub. 

- Dimensioneel modelleren, een semantische laag en data governance in de praktijk. 

- Praktische ervaring met AI-tools in data-ontwikkeling of met data voor AI-toepassingen. 

- Stakeholders tot op directieniveau meenemen in een roadmap. 

- Engels op professioneel niveau; Nederlands is een pré. 

- Bereid tot een Nederlandse veiligheidsscreening (VGB). 

Mooi meegenomen: een warehouse-migratie, data contracts, B2B SaaS of edtech, gereguleerde of publieke omgevingen. 

Stack 

Snowflake, Databricks (Azure), Fivetran, dbt, GitHub, Metabase, Looker. 

Wat we bieden 

- Een competitief salaris en de ruimte om data bij Studytube neer te zetten. 

- Hybride werken: 3 dagen op kantoor in de Houthavens, 2 dagen thuis. 

- 25 vakantiedagen plus een vrije dag op je verjaardag. 

- 3% pensioen via a.s.r., volledig betaald door Studytube. 

- € 1.000 leerbudget per jaar, waarvan de helft voor welzijn of je thuiswerkplek. 

- LevelUp Academy, Studygym, MacBook Air en € 10 telefoonvergoeding. 

- Verzorgde lunches tegen een kleine bijdrage, kwartaaluitjes en een jaarlijks bedrijfsfeest. 

Studytube is het all-in-one leerplatform voor meer dan 600 organisaties, onder wie Bol.com, a.s.r., CZ, Manpower en VolkerWessels. Met 200+ collega’s willen we het nummer 1-platform voor professionele ontwikkeling in Europa worden.

title: Senior Software Engineer - Cloud Partner Integrations
description:
About the team

Most providers make customers migrate their data to them. We're doing the opposite: bringing ClickHouse Cloud into the environments our customers already trust, so their data stays useful right where it lives.

Those environments come in a few shapes. Some are major cloud data platforms that run ClickHouse as a native service, so customers get it without leaving the tool they already use. Some are BI and visualization tools that need ClickHouse to show up as a fast, first-class data source behind their dashboards. And some are developer and data platforms we connect through marketplaces and identity federation with a couple of clicks or agentic calls. Every integration is unique, but the goal is the same every time: ClickHouse should feel like a first-class citizen in every environment.

The craft is finding the patterns underneath different integrations. As one of the first backend engineers, you'll help shape the technical defaults for this team. You'll have end-to-end ownership, but you'll also work inside the constraints of platforms you don't own: thin documentation, unfamiliar deployment topologies, and timelines governed by partner approval cycles. A lot of the challenge is engineering across trust boundaries you don't fully control.

You won't be doing it alone. You'll work closely with your engineering manager, the product manager, a growing team, and experienced engineers across the broader org. If that sounds like your kind of challenge, let's talk.

What you'll do

You'll own an integration end to end: the design, the code, and the production system that keeps running after launch. The patterns you set there become defaults the rest of the team builds on.

Day to day, that looks like:

- Owning the architecture: auth and identity flows, multi-tenancy, how data moves and where it's allowed to live, performance, and what happens in production

- Running what you build. Which means owning the infrastructure, CI, deployment, observability behind it and on-call

- Working on top of external platforms you can't change, and being straight about which risks are yours to manage and which aren't

- Partnering closely with the internal teams whose services you depend on: iterating on product requirements, agreeing on interfaces and protocols, and proactively finding ways to keep moving

About you

These are the attributes of someone who will perform well in this role:

- 8+ years building software, with a good chunk of it on data-heavy or integration-flavored systems

- Preferably proficient in TypeScript or Go or comfortable contributing to each

- Solid backend and systems instincts. You can reason about deployment topology, multi-tenancy, and data movement, and you're comfortable owning architectural tradeoffs you'll have to live with later

- You've worked with modern auth protocols, service principals, and identity federation, and you know how to get it right across a trust boundary

- You've built on someone else's platform and know what that's actually like: incomplete docs, unintended breaking changes, etc.

- You're comfortable in ambiguity. You can ship before the spec is finished, make sensible calls under uncertainty, and flag the decisions that'll be hard to undo to your team before we bake them in.

- You're good with other engineers. Much of the work runs through teams you don't own, and you earn their trust by how you think, not just what you commit.

- You're mainly a backend engineer, but you're comfortable enough to touch a modern React app

- You use AI tools well and honestly. Reach for Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot, or whatever helps, and be clear about where you did and didn't

- You write well. Most of how we coordinate happens async in chats, design docs and RFCs

Nice to have

None of these are required, but any of them would be a bonus:

- Close familiarity with a major cloud data or analytics platform ecosystem

- Real depth in auth and identity federation, or experience building to a partner's security review, marketplace requirements or certification requirements

- Hands-on experience designing multi-tenant SaaS platforms, or the isolation and deployment topology behind them

- Working knowledge of ClickHouse, or another columnar / OLAP engine

Perks 

- Flexible work environment - ClickHouse is a globally distributed company and remote-friendly. We currently operate in over 25 countries.

- Healthcare - Employer contributions towards your healthcare.

- Equity in the company - Every new eligible team member who joins our company receives equity.

- Time off - Flexible time off in the US, generous entitlement in other countries.

- A USD$500 Home office setup if you’re a remote employee.

- Global Gatherings – We believe in the power of in-person connection and offer opportunities to engage with colleagues at company-wide offsites.

Culture - We All Shape It

As part of a rapidly scaling start-up, you will be instrumental in shaping our culture.

Are you interested in finding out more about our culture? Learn more about our values here . Check out our blog posts or follow us on LinkedIn to find out more about what’s happening at ClickHouse.

Equal Opportunity & Privacy

ClickHouse provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type based on factors such as race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws.

title: Tech Lead Manager, Mid Market & Celebrity - LATAM
description:

Backed by Bessemer Venture Partners and other top investors, we're a Series C company that has hit $100M in annual recurring revenue. More than 100,000 real estate professionals, including over 30% of the WSJ Real Trends top 100 agents in the United States, use us to run and grow their business.

The Opportunity 

We don't just use AI. We build with it, ship with it, and think with it. With a generous budget for tokens, our engineers use AI agents to write, review, and ship production code every day. We are building toward a world where humans design systems and AI builds them, and we are already far along that path.

We are hiring a hands-on Tech Lead Manager to lead our Mid Market & Celebrity (MMC) team. This team works side by side with our celebrity and mid market customers and the MMC sales org to build the features and customizations that help those customers grow on the platform. You will be the technical voice in the room from the first conversation. The team vets customization use cases on inbound leads before deals close, builds the agreed functionality after close, and turns the best of that work into capabilities every Luxury Presence customer can use.

This role pairs technical leadership with solution engineering. You will work directly with customers and sales to shape what we build, then lead the team that builds it.

Be the technical partner to MMC sales and customers. Join conversations with prospects, customers, and vendors. Vet customization use cases quickly and explain what is possible, what it takes, and what the tradeoffs are, so deals move forward with confidence.

Practice solution engineering. Turn ambiguous customer needs into clear, scoped, supportable solutions. Translate between customers, sales, product, and engineering, and keep every party aligned.

Build and deliver after close. Plan and schedule the work, and deliver customer functionality with high quality.

Turn one-off builds into platform capabilities. Spot the solutions worth generalizing and graduate them into reusable capabilities for all customers, not only MMC.

Lead and grow the MMC team. Manage 2-4 direct reports. Own coaching, 1:1s, direct feedback, and career development. Treat management as a craft.

Deliver the MMC charter. Partner with product and design to deliver the engineering commitments in the current MMC charter.

Own system health. Be accountable for DORA metrics and the health of all MMC-related services.

Stay hands-on. Contribute through code and design reviews, architecture, and thorny debugging, and go deep with architecture leads on the path to mature solutions.

- You lead from the front. You are close to the code, technically respected, and you grow engineers through clear feedback.

- You communicate clearly and directly. You explain complex tradeoffs to customers, vendors, sales, and executives, and you build trust quickly with external parties.

- You think like a solution engineer. You can listen to a customer, find the real need, and shape a solution that is realistic to build and support.

- You build with AI daily and expect your team to do the same.

- You hold strong opinions, loosely. You have a view on how AI changes architecture, team structure, and engineering culture.

- You think in systems and connect technical decisions to customer outcomes and business value.

- You are energized by ambiguity and speed. Ownership here is real.

- You like to have fun at work. We take our craft seriously, but not ourselves.

Skills and Experience 

- 8+ years of professional software engineering experience with meaningful senior or staff-level time, plus 2+ years managing engineering teams.

- Experience in a customer-facing technical role, such as solution engineering, scoping, or vetting customer requirements before a sale.

- Track record of turning custom or one-off work into reusable platform capabilities.

- Deep expertise in TypeScript, Node.js, and React, with the full-stack fluency to reason about the request path from UI to data.

- Experience designing and operating scalable microservice architectures in cloud-native environments (AWS preferred).

- Strong understanding of GraphQL, event-driven systems (Kafka), and PostgreSQL.

- Experience operating production systems with SLOs and incident response, and familiarity with DORA metrics.

- Experience leading high-impact initiatives from concept through production in a SaaS environment.

Tech Stack

- Backend: Node.js / TypeScript microservices

title: Full Stack Engineer
description:
About BJAK 

The original mission of BJAK is we believe people deserve smarter ways to plan, save and grow their money. This is the origin of our name.

Started in 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, its the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

Today, we are expanding ways to help people in the region — this includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our mission is help people get more from their money every day.

We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities from our offices and remotely, who truly enjoys their work. We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.

The Role 

We are looking for full stack engineers to build fast across BJAK's AI Neobank app.

This role is for product-minded engineers who can move across frontend, backend, internal tools and customer journeys to turn ideas into working products quickly.

What You'll Own 

- 
Build and ship full product features across frontend, backend, APIs and databases.

- 
Create customer and internal workflows for onboarding, accounts, payments, rewards, travel, FX, support automation, KYC and risk.

- 
Turn ambiguous product problems into working systems with clean UX and reliable backend logic.

- 
Work closely with product, design, mobile, backend and AI engineers to launch fast and improve after release.

- 
Build internal tools and automation that reduce manual work and help teams operate at scale.

- 
Own your work beyond release: monitor, debug, learn and improve.

What We're Looking For 

- 
Strong full stack engineering experience with real shipped products.

- 
Comfortable across frontend, backend, APIs, databases and production debugging.

- 
Good frontend execution using React, Next.js, Vue or similar modern stack.

- 
Good backend fundamentals around APIs, data models, authentication, integrations and reliability.

- 
Strong product sense and ability to simplify messy workflows.

- 
Able to work fast with ambiguity and own outcomes end-to-end.

This Role Is Not For 

- 
Engineers who only want to work on one narrow layer.

- 
People who need complete specs before starting.

- 
Developers who ship UI without understanding backend or operations impact.

- 
Candidates who avoid production support.

- 
People who make vague claims without showing real shipped work.

The Bar 

We are looking for engineers with real technology career highlights. A strong highlight is not just working at a famous company. A strong highlight means you personally helped build, ship or scale a serious product, platform or system.

Location 

This role is remote, but candidates must be based in Spain . We are hiring for this market specifically, so applicants should already be based in Spain .

Language 

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

Interview Process 

Our process is designed to move fast:

1. Online assessment or practical task

2. Technical interview

3. CEO / final round

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

title: Staff Software Engineer (Interfaces)
description:
Headquarters: Remote

About the Team 

As a Staff Software Engineer at Netlify, you'll join a collaborative team that values continuous learning, mutual support, and shared growth. Together, we create tools that help developers build faster, more intuitively, and with greater impact. Our Experience team owns the core product experience at Netlify, which is every way a human or an agent interacts with the platform, from our React-based web application to CLI, MCP, SDK, and API. If users interact with it directly, it's likely ours. We're reimagining how developers experience web development by thoughtfully integrating AI into our workflows - not as a novelty, but as a practical tool that enhances how we build the web.

With our team, you'll help set technical direction for our product area, mentor a highly senior team of engineers, and shape user experiences that serve millions of developers. You'll work closely with Product, Design, and engineering leadership, and partner with teams across the organization to build, iterate, and scale meaningful solutions. You'll have the autonomy to guide what we build and how, and the influence to bring others along with you, all while staying hands-on in the codebase.

We're looking for thoughtful engineers who enjoy owning problems end to end, collaborating across disciplines, and solving complex technical challenges for products that millions of developers rely on every day. AI is a foundational part of how we build, so we value engineers who are excited to thoughtfully incorporate AI-assisted workflows while continuing to apply strong engineering fundamentals. We believe the best engineering happens when talented people are trusted to solve difficult problems together, share what they're learning, and create space for different perspectives to shape better solutions. With our team, you'll have real ownership from day one - not a tiny slice of a massive codebase. Engineers here are trusted to make decisions, shape technical direction, and move quickly while collaborating closely with Product and Design.

What You'll Do 

- Use your deep expertise in full-stack development (TypeScript, JavaScript, Go, and React) to ship reliable, scalable, performant code across our product suite, and set the patterns that others on the team and across the org follow. 

- Own the technical direction for our product area, including the web app, CLI, MCP, SDK, API, and docs, by defining architecture and roadmap alongside your manager, Product, and Design, and make tradeoffs explicit so decisions are easy to understand and revisit

- Lead large, ambiguous projects that span multiple teams from conception to delivery, such as our application rewrite and upcoming CLI rework, writing RFCs, driving alignment, and managing risk and timelines

- Design and evolve user-facing features and product APIs for both humans and agents, recognizing that the best interface isn’t always a React application. Build them to scale to millions of developers worldwide, with a clear view of reliability, performance, and long-term maintainability.

- Make thoughtful product and interface decisions on your own with the overall customer experience top of mind

- Set the bar for engineering practices - testing, documentation, observability, and performance optimization - and lead how the team pragmatically uses AI tools, sharing what works and what doesn't

- Turn ambiguity into clear plans, guiding both early-stage prototypes and production-ready applications that directly impact user experience and business metrics

- Mentor and grow engineers through code reviews, design reviews, pairing, and sponsorship, raising the technical level of the whole team

- Practice proactive async communication and create visibility across projects by documenting your workflows and decision-making clearly

- Participate in on-call rotations, lead incident follow-up, and drive continuous improvement efforts that reduce technical debt and prevent recurring problems

- Collaborate with cross-functional teams and engineering leadership to shape user flows that enhance the developer experience across our platform, and contribute to hiring and team growth

What You'll Bring 

- Deep expertise in TypeScript and JavaScript, with a long track record of designing, shipping, and maintaining production-quality software in modern full-stack environments

- A history of building interfaces developers use directly, such as web apps, CLIs, APIs, SDKs, or other dev tools, and a strong sense of what works well for developers (and, by extension, agents)

- Passion for building strong user-facing experiences, including working with React and modern frontend architecture and making architectural decisions that hold up as products and teams grow, paired with the backend knowledge to design software well beyond the UI

- Strong product and design instincts. This isn’t about visual polish - it’s about making thoughtful decisions about how users interact with a product.

- Strong proficiency with Go and/or Ruby for backend services and API development, with a thoughtful approach to reliability and performance

- Hands-on experience with React and modern frontend architecture, including making architectural decisions that hold up as products and teams grow

- Demonstrated ability to raise the technical bar: providing direction to senior and staff-level engineers, distributing ownership, mentoring, shaping standards, and influencing decisions beyond your own team

- Extensive experience delivering features and services that serve large user bases, including designing for scale and operating systems in production

- Demonstrated ability to raise the technical bar: mentoring senior and mid-level engineers, shaping standards, and influencing decisions beyond your own team

This Role is a Great Fit If

- You thrive in collaborative environments, working closely with your team and cross-functionally to turn ideas into reality

- You enjoy the autonomy and influence of staff-level work - setting technical direction, writing RFCs, and driving decisions across teams while staying connected to the people doing the work

About Netlify

Our hiring range for this role is targeted at $182,000 - $248,000 for most US-based locations, $175,000 - $235,000 CAD in most Canada-based locations, and £105,000 – £144,000 GBP for most UK-based locations. Candidates outside the US, Canada, UK, or in premium markets should consult with their Talent Acquisition partner regarding location-based ranges, as they may be higher or lower than the average US range listed.
