title: Marketing Operations Manager
description:
Join Pigment: The AI Platform Redefining Business Planning 

Pigment is the AI-powered business planning and performance management platform built for agility and scale. We connect people, data, and processes in one intuitive platform, with AI agents that work alongside every team, from Finance to HR, to build, adapt, and align strategic plans in real time.

Founded in 2019, Pigment is one of the fastest-growing SaaS companies globally, passing $100M in ARR in 2026 and doubling revenue for the second year in a row. Industry leaders like Unilever, Uber, Anthropic, Snowflake, and Siemens use Pigment every day to make better-informed decisions and navigate any scenario with confidence.

In October 2026, we raised a $250M Series E at a $2.3B valuation, bringing our total funding to $650M+. Today we’re a growing team of 700+ across Paris, London, New York, Toronto, San Francisco, and Austin, and we’ve been named a Visionary in the Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for Financial Planning Software two years running.

At Pigment, we take smart risks, celebrate bold ideas, and challenge the status quo - all while working as one team. If you’re driven by innovation and ready to make an impact at scale, we’d love to hear from you.

About the Role 
Pigment is scaling rapidly, and we are looking for a high-impact Marketing Operations Manager to architect, optimize, and scale our global revenue generation machine. You won't just keep the lights on, you will sit at the intersection of Marketing, Sales, and Analytics to build the infrastructure that accelerates top of the funnel velocity and powers our growth engine.

If you thrive on turning complex marketing journeys into clear revenue paths, automating away friction, and building with a world-class tech stack, this is your canvas.

This is a hybrid role based in either our New York City office or Paris office. 

What You'll Do 

- 
Architect the Demand Engine: Own the end-to-end systems to support our demand generation efforts with a full stack of enterprise tools at your disposal.

- 
Supercharge Top of the Funnel Velocity: Partner directly with Marketing and Sales leadership to eliminate pipeline bottlenecks, elevate conversion rates, and accelerate pipeline progression at every stage of the funnel.

- 
Build Best-in-Class Marketing Infrastructure: Design scalable data architectures that translate platform-specific data (paid advertising, website, lead generation, and opportunity reporting) into actionable strategic insights.

- 
Master & Modernize the Marketing Stack: Architect Pigment’s marketing systems, continuously optimizing systems integrations and AI implementations to maximize performance and automate away friction.

- 
Drive Cross-Functional Alignment: Connect the dots between Marketing, Sales, Customer Success, and Analytics teams to ensure seamless campaign execution and organizational visibility into business drivers.

Who You Are 

- 
An Innovative Systems Thinker: Skilled in converting ambiguous, legacy workflows into scalable operations by integrating AI and leveraging low-code automation, reducing operational drag across systems.

- 
Data-Obsessed & Outcome-Driven: You don't just report on metrics; you craft cohesive narratives bringing context from the field to the numbers in order to influence strategic decision-making.

- 
Thrives in Dynamic Environments: You excel in fast-paced, high-growth environments where speed, initiative, and adaptability are rewarded.

- 
3–5 years of hands-on experience in Marketing Operations, Revenue Operations, or similar, ideally within high-growth SaaS or Tech ecosystems.

- 
Expert on standard B2B tech stack (e.g., Salesforce, HubSpot, LeanData, Qualified, n8n).

- 
Proven capability in campaign operations and marketing automation design.

- 
Exceptional communication skills with a proven ability to bridge business strategy with technical execution.

What We Offer 

- 
Competitive compensation package (Highly competitive base salary, equity package, and comprehensive benefits).

- 
We encourage you to take the time you need. When you work hard, we know you also need to rest, which is why we offer generous time off and parental leave policies.

- 
High-end equipment to do your work in the best conditions.

How We Work 

Thrive Together: We can only win as a team. We are all founders and do the right thing for our peers, Pigment customers, partners, and the planet.

Never Settle: We aim to become the best at what we do by delivering with rigor and ambition every day. Delivering means building a passionate Pigment community.

Go for it: We are biased toward action. Every action leads to learning, and these learnings get us one step closer to our mission.

Be real, be humble: We are generous with our feedback, open to changing our views, and approach conversations with empathy, knowing everyone is trying to do the best for Pigment.

Champion our Customers: We lead with empathy, solve what matters, and deliver clarity in a complex world to make our customers heroes in their organizations.

We conduct background checks as part of our hiring process, in accordance with applicable laws and regulations in the countries where we operate. This may include verification of employment history, education, and, where legally permitted, criminal records. Any checks will be conducted lawfully prior to formal employment contracts being signed, with candidate consent, and information will be treated confidentially. 

Pigment is an equal opportunity employer. We believe diversity is a strength and fosters innovation. We are committed to enabling everyone to feel included and valued at the workplace. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, color, family, gender identity, marital status, national origin, physical or mental disability, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, social origin, or any other characteristic protected by applicable laws. We may process your personal data in accordance with our HR Data Protection Notice .

title: Forward Deployed Engineer
description:
Who We Are 

Our mission is to make the world programmable. Sight is one of the key ways we understand the world, and soon this will be true for the software we use, too.

We’re building the tools, community, and resources needed to make the world programmable with artificial intelligence. Roboflow simplifies building and using computer vision models. Today, over 1M+ developers, including those from half the Fortune 100, use Roboflow’s computer vision AI open source and hosted tools. That includes counting cells to accelerate cancer research, improving construction site safety , digitizing floor plans , preserving coral reef populations , guiding drone flight , and much more .

Roboflow is supported by great customers and investors, having raised over 63 million from Y Combinator, Google Ventures, Craft Ventures, Sam Altman, Lachy Groom, amongst other leading software investors.

Roboflowers are passionate builders who value ownership, accountability, and a bias toward action. We’re curious, hands-on with new tech, and prefer showing our work over talking about it. Many of us have a founder mindset and thrive in our high-autonomy environment.

What You’ll Do 

We’re hiring Forward Deployed Engineers (FDEs) to be the first technical hands on our new customer’s Roboflow deployments. After our Sales and Solutions Architecture team closes a deal and validates the technical approach, you step in to take it from proof-of-concept to production, the critical 0-to-1 phase where vision meets reality.

You’ll embed directly with new Customers, working alongside their engineering and operations teams to build and deploy their first production computer vision workflows on Roboflow. This is the most difficult, important and rewarding phase of the customer journey. Infrastructure is unfamiliar, data pipelines need to be built, edge devices need to be configured, and models need to perform in real-world conditions, not just in a demo or a lab.

The FDE role is more than just execution, you are also our eyes and ears in the field. You'll see the gap between what a Customer thinks they want, and what they actually need. That insight is invaluable, and you'll feed it directly back to our Product and Engineering teams, shaping the Roboflow platform and solution offerings. The best FDEs don't just deploy solutions; they surface the problems worth solving next.

Once you’ve proven the deployment works in production and the customer’s team is equipped to operate it, you hand off to our Implementation Engineers who scale, optimize, and expand the solution across additional use cases. You’re the tip of the spear, the person who makes the first deployment work, no matter what it takes; the adventurer, the explorer, the builder.

Five years from now, FDE at Roboflow on a resume should mean what a few years at Palantir or a FAANG company means. That's the bar we're hiring against.

Role and Responsibilities 

- 
0-to-1 Deployment: Take validated proof-of-concepts from the pre-sales process and build the first production deployment. This includes data pipeline setup, model optimization, edge device configuration, and integration with customer infrastructure.

- 
Edge-First Engineering: Deploy and operate computer vision systems on edge hardware in physical environments. Where conditions are unpredictable and connectivity is unreliable. This is hands-on, hardware-heavy work.

- 
Embed with Customers: Work on-site or deeply embedded with the customer’s engineering team during the initial deployment phase (typically 4–12 weeks per engagement). Build trust, transfer knowledge, and establish the foundation for long-term success.

- 
Production Engineering: Write production-grade code that will live in the customer’s environment. Handle the messy realities of real-world computer vision: lighting variability, camera calibration, model drift, network latency, and edge hardware constraints.

- 
Be Our Eyes and Ears in the Field: You'll be closer to the customer's real problems than anyone else at Roboflow. You'll surface the gap between what the customer says they want, what they actually need, and what the machine operators on the floor think. That feedback loop back to Product and Engineering shapes what we build next, and it's one of the most valuable things FDEs bring back to the company.

- 
Knowledge Transfer & Handoff: Document your deployment architecture, create runbooks, and train the customer’s team so they can operate the system independently. Provide a clean handoff to Roboflow’s Implementation Engineers for scaling and expansion.

- 
De-risk New Deployments: Identify and resolve technical risks early. If a customer’s environment won’t support the planned architecture, you find the alternative before it becomes a project failure.

- 
Shape the Deployment Playbook: Codify repeatable deployment patterns, starter templates, and reusable artifacts that make future deployments faster and more reliable.

The Skillset You’ll Bring 

- 
Meaningful experience deploying technology in physical-world environments. We value breadth, working across different industries, hardware platforms, and deployment contexts, over depth at a single company. The best FDEs we've hired have built things in factories, warehouses, construction sites, or labs before ever touching a vision model.

- 
Strong proficiency in Python; experience with systems-level work (Docker, Kubernetes, networking, Linux) is highly valued.

- 
Hands-on experience deploying machine learning or computer vision models to production; you understand the gap between a working notebook and a reliable pipeline.

- 
Experience with edge computing hardware and constraints (NVIDIA Jetson, industrial cameras, limited connectivity, on-premise security requirements).

- 
Excellent troubleshooting and debugging skills; you’re the person who figures out why it works in staging but not in production.

- 
Strong interpersonal skills - you'll be embedded with customer teams and need to build trust quickly while navigating their internal dynamics. You'll talk to executives, engineers, and machine operators, sometimes in the same meeting.

- 
Experience in one or more of Roboflow’s target verticals: manufacturing, logistics, food processing, automotive, or retail.

- 
Willingness to travel ~40–50% for on-site customer deployments.

Preferred Attributes 

- 
Experience in a professional services, deployment engineering, or forward deployed engineering role.

- 
Familiarity with CV/MLOps tooling and practices (model versioning, monitoring, retraining pipelines).

- 
Deep industrial subject matter expertise. The kind of person who can walk onto a production line and immediately start asking the right questions about throughput, defect rates, and inspection points.

- 
Background in IoT, embedded systems, or infrastructure engineering alongside hands-on deployment experience.

- 
You're a tinkerer outside of work. You own a 3D printer, you've got Raspberry Pis running something in your house, you're constantly tweaking your home network or smart home setup. You enjoy figuring out why something doesn't work as much as you enjoy building it in the first place.

Who You’ll Be Working With 

Our team of ~120 attracts talent like executives that wanted to return to building, founders with a 100M+ exit, Roboflow users turned team members, open source contributors, a cyclist who biked across the United States, prolific high school hackers, a CTO from 100+ engineering organization, amongst many exceptional others.

As a Forward Deployed Engineer, you’ll be partnering directly with our co-founder/CEO and Sales leadership to not only do great work in the role, but shape how this function works for the future of Roboflow.

Where You’ll Work 

Roboflow is distributed across the US and Europe. We currently have Hubs in New York City, San Francisco and São Paulo (with plans to open more as we grow density in new cities). We provide opportunities (like team onsites in different cities) and resources (like a $4000/yr travel stipend) to work in person with other team members as much as you’d like, while also supporting remote team members. You can work from one of our Hubs (we offer a relocation bonus), work from home, work at co-working spaces, etc. We want you to work where you work best!

When You’ll Work 

Roboflow primarily operates during the daytime hours in the US and there are some synchronous meetings you’ll be expected to attend each week. Apart from that, we have a flexible schedule that allows you to work collaboratively with other team members and asynchronously when needed.

What You’ll Receive 

To determine your salary, we use a number of market and data-driven salary sources. We review all salaries every six months to ensure we stay in line with the market.

The target base compensation for this role is $180,000–$250,000, with additional equity compensation. 

Compensation and scope of ownership will be determined based on demonstrated capability, expected impact, and the needs of the business.

Target OTE: $ 

In addition to our cash compensation, we offer generous perks and benefits:

- 
$4000/yr Travel Stipend to travel anywhere anytime to work alongside other Roboflowers

- 
$350/mo Productivity stipend to spend on things that make your work environment more productive, like high-speed internet at home or a co-working space

- 
$350/mo AI Tools

- 
$150/mo Team lunch

- 
$500/one time Home office

- 
Cover up to 100% of your health insurance costs for you and your partner or family

- 
Equity in the company so we are all invested in the future of computer vision

Interview Process (~5 hours) 

Below is the interview process you can expect for this role. We are all motivated to work with an exceptional team, who you’ll be speaking directly with about what it’s like to work and thrive at Roboflow. We like to be decisive and work fast, so don’t be surprised if all the below conversations happen over a few days.

Before the Interview: 

- 
We’ll review your application, LinkedIn, Github, etc.

- 
The best way to stand out is to write about something you’ve built with Roboflow or contribute to one of our open source projects.

- 
We may send you a technical screen if applicable.

Introduction Phase: 

- 
[45m] Meet with hiring manager to assess for overall mindset and skillset

Team Interview Phase: 

- 
[60m] Technical Assessment - live coding or architecture session

- 
[30m] Demo - build a project with Roboflow and share your work

Final Interview Stage: 

- 
[30m] Meet with Head of Operations, for a culture discussion

- 
[30m] Meet with Joseph Nelson, CEO

Note: you are welcome to request additional conversations with anyone you would like to meet and we will accommodate as best we can. 

Not Sure If This Is You? 

We want a diverse, global team with a broad range of experience and perspectives. If this job sounds great, but you’re not sure if you qualify, look into our Former Founders role or subscribe to our career newsletter by emailing “Subscribe” to operations@roboflow.com. We carefully consider every application and will either move forward with you, find another team that might be a better fit, keep in touch for future opportunities, or thank you for your time.

Learn More About Us 

We are building a diverse Distributed team that is distributed across the globe. Roboflow is an equal opportunity workplace; we welcome people from all backgrounds, communities, and experiences.

We provide competitive compensation and stellar benefits to accelerate your personal and work life. Learn more about what it is like to work at Roboflow by reading these blog posts .

Equal Employment Opportunity 

At Roboflow, we believe great ideas come from everywhere, and everyone. We’re proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer committed to building a diverse and inclusive team. We consider all qualified applicants regardless of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gende

title: Software Engineer, Web Development
description:
Titanom ist ein KI- und Softwareunternehmen mit Fokus auf digitale Produkte in Bildung, öffentlichem Sektor und angrenzenden Bereichen. Unsere Mission ist es Lösungen zu entwickeln, die nicht nur technisch funktionieren, sondern im Alltag bestehen – langfristig, sicher und nutzerorientiert.

Deine Rolle als Software Engineer: Mit Code innovative Lösungen gestalten 

In unserem agilen Team entwickelst du moderne Webanwendungen und KI-Features. Du baust skalierbare Architekturen, integrierst Machine-Learning-APIs und schaffst intuitive User Experiences. Wir arbeiten hauptsächlich mit TypeScript, Next.js und React bzw. mit Python und FastAPI – aber neue Ideen und ein cooler TechStack sind immer willkommen. 

Dein Impact bei Titanom: 

- Entwicklung & Optimierung moderner & nutzerzentrierter Web-Apps (Frontend & Backend) mit Technologien wie z. B. Next.js, TypeScript und Python
- Integration von KI-Technologien zur Verbesserung der User Experience in enger Zusammenarbeit mit anderen Teams, um innovative Lösungen für reale Probleme zu entwickeln
- Optimierung von Webanwendungen für Skalierbarkeit, Geschwindigkeit und Performance und sichern der Codequalität durch Tests, Debugging, Optimierung
- Erstellung von Libraries & Packages , die echten Mehrwert schaffen
- Erforschung & Umsetzung innovativer Use-Cases mit modernsten KI-Technologien von Large Language Models bis zu Vision Transformers
- Teilnahme an Code-Reviews und aktive Mitgestaltung der Entwicklungsprozesse
- Kreative Problemlösung – auch für Machine-Learning-Aufgaben
- Lernen & Wachsen : Teilnahme an wöchentlichen Workshops zu Software Engineering & Machine Learning
Requirements 

Wir suchen Entwickler:innen mit Ownership-Mindset & Umsetzungsstärke: 

- Abgeschlossenes Studium der (Wirtschafts-) Informatik, Mathematik oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation
- Praxiserfahrung in der Web- oder Softwareentwicklung mit Interesse an Fullstack-Entwicklung
- Freude daran, Features von der Idee bis zum sauberen Production-Release zu bringen
- Erfahrung mit CI/CD und automatisierten Tests
- Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse (min. C1) und gute Englischkenntnisse (min. B2)
- Eigeninitiative, Verantwortungsbewusstsein und Hands-on-Mentalität
- Interesse an KI-Themen wie LLM-APIs, RAG, Vector Search und Motivation, sich in Vision-Modelle einzuarbeiten

Deine Vergütung

Für diese Position bieten wir ein Fixgehalt im Bereich von 50.000 bis 60.000 EUR pro Jahr , abhängig von deinen individuellen Stärken und Erfahrungen. Uns ist wichtig, dass du von Anfang an weißt, woran du bist – deshalb kommunizieren wir die Gehaltsrange offen und transparent. Im persönlichen Gespräch finden wir gemeinsam heraus, welche Einstufung am besten zu dir passt. Denn wir glauben daran, dass Transparenz und Wertschätzung mehr sind als Worte.

Benefits 

- Flexibilität und Zeit für dich: Flexible Arbeitszeiten (keine Kernarbeitszeit), 30 Tage Urlaub und eine transparente Überstundenvergütung.
- Lernen als Teil deines Arbeitsalltags: Alle zwei Wochen erwarten dich Workshops zu verschiedenen aktuellen Top-Themen - damit du Neues lernst und dich kontinuierlich weiterentwickeln kannst.
- Raum für deine Entwicklung: Übernimm Verantwortung und gestalte deinen Karriereweg in einem wachsenden Unternehmen aktiv mit.
- Gute Ausstattung und Extras: Arbeite mit einem MacBook und profitiere von steuerfreien Zusatzleistungen wie 50-Euro-Gutscheinen oder einer Urban-Sports-Club-Mitgliedschaft.
- Ein Kühlschrank voll mit deinen Lieblingsgetränken: Wir bieten eine umfangreiche Getränke-Flat!
- Ein Büro mit vielen Möglichkeiten: Unser gut erreichbares Büro bietet Gym, Sauna, Ruheraum und Dachterrasse - dazu Nintendo, Tischtennis, Kicker.
- Gemeinsam etwas bewegen: Arbeite in einem ambitionierten Team, das eine gemeinsame Vision verfolgt.
- Erfolge zusammen feiern: Freu dich auf gemeinsame Events - vom Ski- und Wellnesswochenende über den Oktoberfestbesuch bis zu weiteren Firmenfeiern.

FAQ – Häufige Fragen zur Stelle bei Titanom

Welche Technologien kommen in dieser Position zum Einsatz? 

Du arbeitest mit einem modernen Tech-Stack, der unter anderem Next.js, TypeScript, Python und React umfasst. Außerdem setzen wir auf innovative KI-Technologien wie Large Language Models und Vision Transformers.

Brauche ich Vorerfahrung mit KI-Technologie 

Nein, Software-Entwicklung-Erfahrung reicht. Wir bieten umfassende Einarbeitung und 10% Education Time für kontinuierliche Weiterbildung.

Welche Qualifikationen sind erforderlich? 

Ein Studium in einem passenden Bereich (z. B. Informatik, Mathematik) ist von Vorteil, aber kein Muss. Quereinsteiger:innen , die sauberen Code zu schätzen wissen und praktische Erfahrung in der Softwareentwicklung mitbringen, sind bei uns ebenfalls herzlich willkommen.

Welche Soft Skills sind wichtig? 

Wir suchen jemanden mit Motivation und Drive, Leidenschaft für Softwareentwicklung, einem hohen Qualitätsbewusstsein, einer Hands-On-Mentalität und der Fähigkeit, kreativ Probleme zu lösen – auch im Bereich Machine Learning. Zudem solltest du Lust auf deine persönliche Entwicklung haben und Lernbereit sein! 

Gibt es Möglichkeiten zur Weiterbildung? 

Ja, absolut! Bildung und Weiterentwicklung haben bei uns höchste Priorität – nicht nur extern, sondern auch intern. description:

Real innovation starts with a strong foundation, and at commercetools, that comes from the perfect balance of our product and our people.

My team builds the core retrieval layer behind product discovery for the world’s most demanding commerce brands. As we take semantic and hybrid search to general availability, we’re tackling hard engineering problems at every layer: from query understanding and vector indexing down to latency, measurable relevance, and the cost of a single query. We’re looking for a Senior Search Engineer to build across Elasticsearch, Kubernetes, and our functional Scala backend—whether you already love functional programming or are excited to master it with us. 

You will: 

- Design and implement search functionalities in a PaaS ecommerce Scala backend

- Develop search capabilities that combine lexical, semantic, and hybrid retrieval

- Develop search-related libraries based on ElasticSearch and MongoDB

- Contribute to search relevance and quality, and to how we measure it

- Run and maintain a scalable search “infrastructure as code” on top of Kubernetes using terraform and multi-tenant architecture

- Test software components regarding usability, functionality, and performance, and work closely with Product Management and DevOps

- Learn Scala and functional programming as your new main development tools

- Take part in on-call rotation with a worldwide distributed team for production systems

This role is hybrid, with three days a week spent in our Munich, Berlin, London or Valencia office. 

What Sets You Apart 

You're a creative problem-solver who is wired to find solutions. You confidently dive into complex challenges and have a talent for making them simple for others. Your curiosity drives you to constantly grow and contribute to an environment of trust and teamwork.

Great ideas come from many paths, and your unique perspective matters more than checking every box. What matters most is the mindset you bring to the work. You do not need to be an ML researcher for this role. You need to be a strong backend engineer who is genuinely interested in retrieval quality.

You bring:

- At least 5 years of experience as a Software Engineer, with production experience on the JVM

- Solid understanding of parallel and asynchronous programming, as well as non-blocking I/O

- Experience developing REST APIs and knowledge of scalable architectures, including sharding, replication, load balancing, and failover

- Interest in working with Scala using pragmatic functional programming patterns. If you come from another JVM language, we will support you in picking it up.

- Fluent English for work in international teams

- Experience operating multi-tenant SaaS where one tenant’s load must never affect another’s

- Knowledge of scalable event-driven architectures, including queues and notification topics

- A genuine curiosity for using AI tools to work smarter and more effectively, paired with a drive to learn and put them into practice in your role.

Nice to Have: 

- Hands-on search experience, preferably ElasticSearch or OpenSearch, including a working understanding of how an inverted index scores and ranks documents

- Practical exposure to vector retrieval, such as embeddings, approximate nearest neighbor indexes, and hybrid ranking, and a sense of where each approach breaks down. A deep lexical search background plus a clear appetite to go into this territory also works.

- Comfort reasoning about relevance with data, including precision and recall tradeoffs, ranking metrics, and behavioral signals

- Experience with infrastructure work and other technologies like Helm, Kubernetes, and Rust

title: Senior Geodesist
description:
Senior Geodesist 

This is a future role. We're building a shortlist now and will contact you when it opens. 

About us 

Foundational is building the most precise picture of Earth and orbit, using lasers fired from the ground. We call it ground truth for orbit.

We design and run low-cost, autonomous satellite laser ranging stations. They measure the distance to satellites with extreme precision, day and night. Our data platform turns those measurements into tracking data and orbit products for satellite operators, space agencies and governments. We also build our own flight-proven laser retroreflector arrays, so any satellite can be tracked.

Our station network is expanding across continents. The data supports resilient navigation, Earth observation and the safe, sustainable use of space.

We're a small, fast-moving team of engineers, scientists and operators in London. We're backed by venture investors and supported by ESA, the UK Space Agency, and Innovate UK.

Position Overview 

London · Full time · On-site

You'll lead our geodesy work. That means making sure our ranging data meets the standards of the international geodetic community, and turning it into products that scientists and operators trust.

What you'll do 

- Lead geodetic processing and analysis of our satellite laser ranging data

- Contribute to reference frame and Earth orientation products

- Define data quality standards, and validate our data against international analysis centres

- Represent Foundational in the ILRS, IAG and wider geodetic community

- Guide our data scientists and software engineers on models and algorithms

- Publish and present at conferences

What you'll bring 

- A PhD or equivalent experience in space geodesy or a related field

- Deep knowledge of SLR and at least one other space-geodetic technique (GNSS, VLBI or DORIS)

- Experience with reference frames (ITRF), Earth orientation and IERS conventions

- Experience with geodetic analysis software such as GEODYN, Bernese or GipsyX

- A publication record or equivalent track record

Nice to have 

- Experience at an ILRS analysis or data centre

- Gravity field modelling or precise orbit determination

- Python

What We Offer 

- A high-impact role with real ownership at an early-stage, venture-backed spacetech company

- EMI share options (UK employees)

- Cycle to work schemes

- Work alongside engineers and scientists across optics, lasers, software and astrodynamics

- Offices in central London, with snacks, tea, coffee and regular socials

title: Senior Platform Engineer
description:
Senior Platform Engineer
We are looking for a passionate and collaborative Senior Platform Engineer to join our Platform Core team. At Treatwell we follow Team Topologies principles: our platform exists to enable stream-aligned teams to move faster and more autonomously, through self-service capabilities, reliable infrastructure and a great developer experience, built in partnership with our Developer Experience and Data Platform teams.

The Platform Core team provides the foundational infrastructure and tooling that enables Treatwell's engineering organisation to ship value quickly and safely. As a Senior Platform Engineer you will own the ambiguous platform problems nobody has scoped yet. You will shape them with the team before they become work, design solutions at service level and make the technical calls in your domain. 

We want product teams to experience Platform Core as a strategic partner: a trusted advisor involved early, not a ticket resolver. We deliver value in small increments, own outcomes together with the teams we support, and measure success by the impact we enable across Engineering

You will be responsible for: 

- Owning core platform capabilities (AWS and GCP foundations, identity and access, networking and the AI layer on Bedrock), from ambiguous problems to production, delivered in small slices.
- Design delivery and operation of our EKS platform in partnership with DevX, including upgrades, add-ons and autoscaling.
- Building self-service tooling, such as OpenTofu pipelines and GitLab CI/CD components, so teams can provision infrastructure themselves.
- Running GitLab and other shared platform services: upgrades, patching, monitoring and recovery.
- Making sure every platform change goes through a reviewed pipeline.
- Making and owning the technical decisions in your domain, using spikes to test options and escalating early when needed.
- Commanding platform incidents, and following through on post-mortems.
- Improving the security of the services you own, in line with the AWS Well-Architected Framework.
- Using AI tools in your daily work and helping others do the same.
- Mentoring engineers, giving useful feedback.
- Shaping engineering standards through our guilds
- Partnering with product teams early, understanding their plans before they need us, and making Platform Core easy to work with.
- Aligning teams on approach before work starts, and explaining trade-offs in terms of risk and value.
- Using platform metrics and support data to argue for what to do next, and shaping new work with your team before it is defined
About you 

- Several years in platform, infrastructure, with clear ownership of production platforms used by other engineering teams.
- Deep hands-on Terraform (or OpenTofu) on AWS, including module design and multi-account or multi-tenant setups.
- Expert with Kubernetes (EKS) and containers; experience running cluster upgrades and Helm or Kustomize at scale.
- Strong in GitLab CI and designing reusable pipelines and templates for many teams.
- Professional depth in core AWS (EC2, VPC, IAM, Route53, CloudFront, S3, RDS, EKS). GCP exposure is a bonus.
- Experience with, or strong interest in, modern cloud networking such as AWS VPC Lattice and service mesh with support for identity-based access between services
- Fluent in Bash and Python for automation; comfortable on Linux 
- Practical observability experience with Datadog, Prometheus, CloudWatch or Grafana, including defining SLIs and alerting.
- Security-minded: IAM least privilege, secrets management, container supply-chain security, and applying the AWS Well-Architected Framework and DSOMM.
- Experience leading production incidents and making technical decisions you own, including when they turn out wrong.
- Have grown other engineers and can explain complex trade-offs clearly to technical and non-technical audiences.
We’ll treat you with: 

- 28-days holiday, plus bank holidays 
- Monthly £/€40 Treatwell vouchers so you can treat yourself too 
- Market-specific benefits that will be discussed in the interview process
Equal Opportunities 

Treatwell is an 'Open to All' employer and warmly welcomes everybody to the team. We are committed to making reasonable adjustments to the recruitment process as required. Please add any adjustment requests to your application.

title: AI/ML Engineer - Production AI & LLM Systems (India)
description:
Headquarters: India

URL: https://jobs.workable.com/company/vBHEuzwk8ghJwdk43HHAzt/jobs-at-volga-partners 

AI Engineer | India 

Department: Engineering 
Reports To: Product & Engineering Leadership 
Location: India - Fully Remote 
Employment Type: Full-Time 
Experience Level: Mid-Level 
Compensation: ₹15,00,000 – ₹22,00,000 per year (15–22 LPA), commensurate with experience and technical expertise 

Position Overview 

The AI Engineer at Volga Partners will design, develop, and deploy advanced, production-ready AI solutions, including Large Language Models (LLMs), Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) systems, agentic AI workflows, and intelligent automation technologies.

This role requires a strong combination of AI research, hands-on model training and optimization, and software engineering expertise, with the ability to translate innovative AI concepts into scalable, reliable, and practical business applications.

Working closely with software engineers, product teams, and leadership, the AI Engineer will lead the development and integration of high-performance AI solutions that solve complex business challenges, enhance operational efficiency, and deliver measurable value to our global clients.

Key Responsibilities 

AI System Development 

- Design, develop, and deploy AI systems, including LLMs, RAG, agentic workflows, and ML/DL solutions. 
- Select appropriate models and architectures while balancing accuracy, latency, cost, and complexity. 
- Train and fine-tune models using PyTorch or Keras, including data preparation and evaluation. 
- Implement and benchmark research methods before adoption. 
- Build APIs, inference pipelines, and backend integrations. 
Production & Optimization 

- Own evaluation of metrics and track quality, latency, and cost. 
- Monitor, debug, and optimize AI systems post-launch. 
- Ensure production readiness and identify regressions before they impact users. 
Collaboration

- Partner with software engineers and product teams to integrate AI into applications. 
- Contribute to technical discussions and technical decision-making. 
- Document architecture, implementation approaches, and key technical decisions. 
Research & Experimentation 

- Read and evaluate ML research papers. 
- Implement promising methods and reproducing results where applicable. 
- Adapt emerging techniques into production-ready systems. 
- Contribute to continued innovation across AI and engineering initiatives. 

Working Relationships 

The AI Engineer will collaborate with: 

- Engineering leadership and product teams. 
- Software engineers and backend developers. 
- Global AI research and development teams. 

Success in This Role 

Success means you can build with AI and deliver reliable production solutions, not simply experiment with AI models. 

You should be able to: 

- Deliver production-ready AI systems with measurable impact. 
- Translate research into practical engineering solutions. 
- Collaborate effectively across distributed teams. 
- Document and share technical knowledge for scalability. 
- Adapt to evolving technical and business priorities. 

Work Environment 

This is a fully remote position based in India. Candidates should be comfortable working independently and collaborating with globally distributed teams across different time zones. 

Required Work Schedule 

This AI Engineer role requires working Monday through Friday, 7:30 PM–4:30 AM or 8:30 PM–5:30 AM IST in India, depending on U.S. daylight saving time?

The ability to consistently work the assigned schedule is a required and non-negotiable condition of this role. Candidates must be comfortable working overnight hours and maintaining reliable availability throughout the assigned shift.

Due to project deadlines, production needs, client requirements, or other business priorities, occasional weekend availability or schedule adjustments may be required. Weekend work is not intended to be the standard schedule but flexibility to support business needs when necessary is expected

Our Hiring Process 

We value your time and aim to keep our recruitment process transparent, efficient, and engaging. 

1. Initial Recruiter Screening 

An introductory video call with a member of our Recruiting team to discuss your background, experience, career goals, salary expectations, and any initial questions you may have about the role or Volga Partners. 

2. Practical Skills Assessment 

Candidates who successfully complete the initial screening will receive a practical assessment to complete asynchronously. 

The assessment is designed to evaluate technical knowledge, problem-solving ability, and how you approach a real-world engineering scenario. 

3. Assessment Review 

Our team will review your submission against the technical requirements of the role. 

Candidates who meet the required criteria will advance to the final interview stage.

4. Technical / Coding Interview
Candidates who pass the assessment will meet with our Engineering team to further evaluate their technical skills, experience, and AI Engineering knowledge

5. Final Interview – CTO 

A deep-dive conversation with our Chief Technology Officer focused on technical alignment, your assessment approach, architectural thinking, problem-solving, and overall alignment with the role and team. 

Required Qualifications 

- 3+ years of hands-on AI/ML engineering experience, with at least one system deployed to production. 
- Strong NLP fundamentals, including tokenization, embeddings, classification, NER, and information extraction. 
- Strong engineering skills across coding, Git, testing, API/system design, and debugging. 
- Hands-on model training experience using PyTorch or Keras. 
- Understanding generative model architectures, including Transformers and VAEs. 
- Production experience with LLMs, including RAG, embeddings/vector databases, and prompt/evaluation design. 
- Experience with FastAPI or similar frameworks, Docker, and at least one cloud platform such as AWS, GCP, or Azure. 
- Ability to read ML research papers and translate ideas into working code. 

Preferred Qualifications 

- Experience with LLM fine-tuning, including LoRA and RL-based methods. 
- SQL database knowledge. 
- Familiarity with agent frameworks such as LangGraph or LangChain. 
- Experience with Kubernetes, CI/CD, and model-serving infrastructure. 
- Open-source contributions or experience reproducing research results. 

Compensation & Benefits 

- Annual Compensation: ₹15,00,000-₹22,00,000 (15-22 LPA), based on experience and technical expertise. 
- Contract and payment administration facilitated through Deel. 
- 90-day probationary period. 
- Benefits eligibility upon successful completion of probation, including: 
- Paid Time Off (PTO) in accordance with company policy. 
- Holiday pay for company-observed holidays. 
- Career growth and professional development opportunities.

title: Embedded Software Engineer – Wireless Systems
description:
You want to help build Europe’s resilience? You want to protect people and critical infrastructure – ultimately saving the lives of thousands?

You want to work at the frontier of high-performance autonomous systems?

Join CDDS to push the limits of wireless communication and build dependable connectivity for our next-generation counter-drone systems. 

CDDS specializes in developing low-collateral kinetic interceptors designed to neutralize malicious drones (Mavics, FPV racers and fast fixed wings). Our solutions are built for precision and safety, minimizing risk to surroundings while effectively countering unauthorized or threatening unmanned aerial systems. We work at the cutting edge of counter-drone technology, delivering reliable protection for critical assets and environments.

Tasks

You mission 

We are looking for an exceptional Embedded Software Engineer – Wireless Systems to take ownership of the software connecting our ground stations and drone platforms.

Our requirements go beyond what standard radio products offer. You will dig into existing software and firmware, understand the assumptions behind their design, and rework them to meet our needs. This requires someone who can navigate unfamiliar code, reason across software and hardware boundaries, and turn elusive failures into understood, tested solutions.

You will work closely with our RF/electrical and software engineers, with the autonomy to make architectural decisions and the responsibility to prove them in the field. We are looking for technical depth, curiosity, and the persistence to follow a problem through - from its first symptom to a reliable fix.

Core Responsibilities 

- Investigate, modify, and extend existing radio software and firmware beyond their standard functionality.

- Develop and maintain embedded communication software across ground stations, radio equipment, and onboard systems.

- Diagnose complex failures across firmware, networking, operating systems, and hardware interfaces, working closely with our RF/electrical engineer.

- Improve communication reliability, latency, throughput, connection establishment, and recovery from interruptions.

- Build diagnostic tools, logging, and automated tests that make failures reproducible and improvements measurable.

- Own software integration and validation, from controlled lab experiments to real-world field testing.

- Maintain our modifications to supplier code, document architectural decisions, and work with suppliers to resolve platform limitations.

Requirements 

Your Profile 

You combine strong software fundamentals with hands-on engineering judgment. You are comfortable working with incomplete documentation, questioning existing implementations, and designing experiments to establish why a system fails.

- Strong professional experience developing and debugging embedded software in C and/or C++.

- Demonstrated ability to understand and substantially modify complex existing codebases, such as vendor firmware, drivers, or communication stacks.

- Hands-on experience with embedded Linux and/or RTOS-based systems.

- Strong understanding of networking and communication protocols, including IP and serial interfaces.

title: Senior Frontend Engineer (All Genders)
description:
At Stark, we forge the future of European and national security through cutting-edge, AI-driven technology and unmatched engineering precision. As a premier defence technology company, our mission is clear: to equip NATO Allies and their partners with next-generation autonomous defence platforms and advanced AI-driven software built to perform in the world’s most demanding environments. 

We believe that true security stems from relentless innovation. By combining elite engineering talent with agile technology and an AI-native operational culture, Stark turns complex defence challenges into field-tested, multi-domain solutions. 

WHY JOIN US 

- The software and systems you work on directly protect personnel and defend European and national sovereignty. 

- You will work alongside industry-leading minds on autonomous systems, advanced propulsion, and secure cyber platforms. 

- We foster a fast-paced, collaborative environment where bold ideas are supported by serious R&D backing. 

ABOUT THE TEAM 

Minerva Frontline is STARK's command and control software — the brain that connects operators to autonomous systems across multiple domains in real time. The Frontline team is based across Europe & the UK, working with our hardware teams to build mission-critical C2 capabilities for use in active operational environments. 

We move fast, ship real software, and operate under constraints most engineers never encounter — low-bandwidth networks, air-gapped devices, high-stakes decision loops. We are a tight-knit team of zero-ego, mission-driven developers. There is no room for abstraction for its own sake. Everything we build ends up in the hands of real operators in the field. 

If you want to build software which will make a tangible difference to the security of Europe, we want to hear from you. 

YOUR MISSION 

STARK is looking for a Senior Software Engineer (Frontend Systems) to expand our mission management software. We are not looking for someone who just works on Jira tickets. We need a frontend systems thinker who balances rapid delivery with the deep system understanding required to answer: 'What is the right solution for the overall system, and what is the frontend's role in it?' 

You will build and evolve the frontend as a robust, high-performance architecture. You have the high-agency to navigate the physical constraints of our hardware, challenge the backend with hard questions, and translate complex data streams into a clear, calm UI for operators under extreme cognitive load. While you actively provide impulses for our overall system evolution, your core focus remains hands-on engineering. 

We consistently rely on agentic AI workflows. While these agents accelerate development, they also introduce entirely new classes of technical challenges. Your role is to set strict architectural guardrails, rigorously orchestrate these agents, and collaborate with the team to solve the novel integration and quality problems that arise in this new engineering paradigm. 

WHAT YOU WILL DO AT STARK 

- System Thinking through the Frontend Lens: You don't need to write path-planning algorithms, but you must understand how they constrain the UI. You engineer highly optimized frontend solutions that handle high-frequency telemetry and asynchronous data streams while strictly minimizing computational load to preserve critical battery life on field devices. 

- Mission-Critical UI & UX: You translate complex data into immediate situational awareness. You understand UX as cognitive load management for operators under stress. You implement interfaces that are deterministic, error-tolerant, and relentlessly focused on providing clarity out of chaos. 

- Strategic Sparring Partner: You align rapid delivery with long-term system health. Instead of just accepting what the backend provides, you proactively challenge APIs and data structures if they threaten frontend performance or the operator's experience. 

- Mastering Agentic Workflows: You don't just prompt; you engineer alongside AI. You set strict architectural guardrails, rigorously validate outputs, and proactively solve the novel integration and quality challenges that arise in this new paradigm. 

- Engineering for Extreme Constraints: Build high-performance, framework-less user interfaces (Vanilla TS, Web Components) that function flawlessly under extreme real-world conditions (low bandwidth, air-gapped networks). 

- Collaborative Excellence: You are a team multiplier. You raise the level of the entire team by sharing knowledge, providing valuable impulses for our system design, and facilitating open, fact-based discussions with zero ego. 

WHAT YOU BRING TO THE MISSION 

- System-Level Frontend Seniority: Deep, practical expertise in Vanilla TypeScript/JavaScript and the native web platform (DOM API, Event Loop, Memory Management). You view the frontend not as a collection of pages, but as a complex, stateful system interacting with the physical world. 

- Constraint-Driven Engineering: The ability to engineer solutions that anticipate and mitigate hardware realities—specifically managing latency, handling data bursts, and optimizing for constrained compute and battery life. 

- AI-Engineering Competence: Practical experience integrating agent-based coding tools into your workflow. You understand how to structure architecture for AI, rigorously validate its output, and solve the novel integration challenges these tools create. 

- Mission-Oriented Execution: You balance the drive for rapid delivery with a critical mindset. You proactively question requirements and always evaluate technical decisions from the operator's perspective on the ground. 

- Strong Team Player & Zero-Ego: You have the maturity to moderate technical decisions, compromise, and always put the mission above your own ego. 

- Mobility: Ability to travel as needed. 

NICE TO HAVE 

- Practical experience building comprehensive design systems (ideally using native Web Components). 

- Experience with real-time data streaming architectures (WebSockets, WebRTC) or handling high-frequency telemetry. 

- Experience in geographic mapping, GIS, or complex Canvas/WebGL rendering in the browser. 

- Experience working with unmanned systems, ideally in command-and-control, mission management, or operator-facing software. 

If you're interested in building the future of European Defence with us, and you see yourself reflected on the description above, please send us your CV in English . We're looking forward to meeting you! 

SECURITY CLEARANCE 

Due to the nature of our work in the defence sector, candidates must be eligible to obtain and maintain the appropriate security clearance required for this position. Details will be provided during the recruitment process. 

EQUAL OPPORTUNITY 

We are an equal-opportunity employer committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive workplace. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, colour, religion, sex, national origin, disability, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

title: Computer Vision and Machine Learning Engineer
description:
We are looking for a Computer Vision and Machine Learning (CV/ML) Engineer to develop and deploy intelligent perception systems for our autonomous drone-in-a-box platform. You will work on challenging real-world computer vision problems, from real-time object detection and tracking on embedded devices to advanced scene understanding and cloud-based inference. As part of a small, technical team, you will own solutions across our software stack, taking algorithms and models from prototype to deployment. This position is for an on-site employee for our Zurich office.

Responsibilities

- Design and develop a wide variety of computer vision and machine learning features for unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) applications

- Monitor ML model performance in real-world deployments and set up workflows for continuous improvement (data collection, curation, labeling, retraining, evaluation)
- Evaluate and integrate large/vision language models for scene understanding, situational awareness, and hazard analysis, including prompt design, performance benchmarking, and production deployment
Qualifications

- Degree in Computer Science, Robotics Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience)

- Strong programming skills in Python and C++, with experience developing production-grade software that powers CV/ML systems
- Experience with PyTorch or TensorFlow, ONNX, TensorRT, CUDA
- Experience with end-to-end model development: from dataset curation, labeling strategies, active learning workflows to deployment and optimization for edge devices
- Excellent oral and written skills in English
- Work permit in Switzerland required
Bonus Points

- Good understanding of 3D vision and robotics perception, along with hands-on experience with OpenCV and ROS/ROS2, is a strong plus
- Experience with NVIDIA Jetson and Qualcomm edge devices, and their CV/ML SDKs
- Experience with transformers, large/vision language models and prompt design for perception tasks
- Experience with complex GStreamer pipelines and custom plugin development
100% · On-site

title: Associate Technology Consultant - Galaxy Graduate Program
description:
Celonis is the trusted platform to industrialize Enterprise AI. At our core is the Celonis Context Model — which combines process data, business knowledge, and intelligence into a living digital twin of the enterprise that AI can actually understand, turning AI's operational blind spots into operational clarity. World's leading companies trust Celonis and its global ecosystem of partners to make their AI agents, people, systems, and processes work together, achieving transformational outcomes. We believe there's a massive opportunity to unlock global productivity and sustainability by giving AI the context to understand how every business process really works. Join our mission to make processes work for people, companies, and the planet.

The Team 

Celonis makes processes work for people, companies, and the planet. As the Celonis Services organization, we are the strategic implementation consulting & transformation arm of a unified Customer Organization aligned to four core mandates:

- Make Celonis Business Critical: Transform the platform into the central nervous system of our customers’ operations.

- Scale Customer Health: Drive full platform adoption to ensure long-term value and stability.

- Focus on High-Value Activities: Prioritize complex, high-impact technical work that moves the needle for Focus & Strategic customers.

- Empower Career Growth: Foster an environment where every Celonaut owns customer success while accelerating their own professional trajectory.

We deliver production-ready Celonis Platform implementations that drive measurable top, bottom, and green-line impact. Moving beyond “point-in-time” analysis, we utilize a Discover-and-Build approach to solve the world's most complex operational challenges.

In close partnership with Value Engineering, we perform data-driven discovery to validate business hypotheses against real-world data. We then build and deploy operational, AI-enriched solutions on top of the Celonis Platform that automate decisions and optimize workflows at an enterprise scale.

We don't just implement AI for our customers; we live it. Our project delivery lifecycle is accelerated by state-of-the-art AI augmentation , allowing our consultants to focus on high-level, strategic problem-solving. By serving as the "eyes and ears" in the field, we maintain a continuous innovation loop with our Product & Engineering teams, ensuring our frontline learnings directly shape the future of the Celonis Platform.

The Role 

As an Associate Deployment Engineer within the Galaxy Graduate Program , you will support the end-to-end "Discover-and-Build" journey for our global customers. The Galaxy program unites Celonauts across different locations into one dedicated onboarding program which develops recent graduates into well rounded, skilled Services professionals in 12 months. As part of a consulting team, collaborating with more experienced consultants, you will bridge the gap between complex data landscapes and strategic business value. This role is designed for high-potential university graduates who possess a "Business-Critical Mindset" and the ability to understand how technical solutions can impact customer operations and improve efficiency, resulting in platform adoption and long-term ROI for our customers. 

The Work You’ll Do 

- Support Strategic Implementations: Support the implementation of Celonis Platform as a business-critical tool by connecting customer data to actionable strategic outcomes.

- Execute Discover-and-Build: As part of a project team, participate in process mining discovery activities, data transformation (SQL/Python), and the creation of AI-driven analyses to identify execution gaps.

- AI-Forward Solutioning: Leverage your technical background to build and deploy "AI-forward" solutions, utilizing Machine Learning and LLM integrations for our most strategic customers.

- Stakeholder Engagement: Actively participate in discovery and requirement workshops, practicing a consulting mindset to communicate technical findings to business stakeholders and continue building the solution with a strong customer centric mindset.

- Operational Excellence: Contribute to project speed and efficiency by maintaining high-quality documentation and ensuring "Built-in Quality Control" in every line of code or analysis produced.

- Cross team collaboration: Have the opportunity to collaborate with various teams within the Celonis organization, including but not limited to:

- Business Analytics, Academy and Global Programs

- Business Apps & Product and Engineering

- Solution Architecture & Celonis Support

The Qualifications You Need 

- Academic Background: A recent graduate (or final year student) with a degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Engineering, Business Information Systems, or a related technical field.

- Technical Foundation: Proven experience building technical solutions during your studies or internships. You should be comfortable with Python, SQL, and have a foundational understanding of Machine Learning and AI architectures.

- Business-Critical Mindset: A strong interest in how technology creates financial value. You are driven by outcomes like ROI, efficiency, and process improvement.

- Consulting DNA: You are curious, solution-driven, and outspoken. You possess the confidence to manage stakeholders and the skills required to navigate complex corporate environments.

- Analytical Rigor: The ability to not only focus on "What is the data saying?" and also to recommend "What should the business do, based on the findings?" 

- Communication: Excellent communication skills in English and German (native/proficient on both) , with the ability to translate technical concepts into business impact.

- You are available to start working full time from February 1st, 2027 onwards, with the rest of our global cohort. 

What Celonis can offer you: 

- Pioneer Innovation: Work with the global leader in Process Mining and the Process Intelligence Graph to shape the future of AI-driven business operations.

- Ownership from Day 1: Every full-time "Celonaut" is an owner, receiving Restricted Stock Units (RSUs) and merit-based refresh grants.

- Unrivaled Family Support: Benefit from our inclusive parental leave policy—24 weeks of fully paid leave for primary carers and 12 weeks for supporting carers, available from your first day of employment.

- Work-Life Integration: Enjoy Unlimited PTO (in applicable regions) and generous PTO globally, as well as a flexible hybrid work model that balances remote focus with vibrant office collaboration.

- Continuous Growth: Elevate your skills through our 70-20-10 learning framework, mentorship programs, and access to a dedicated learning platform.

- Holistic Well-being: Prioritize your health with subsidized Wellhub memberships, mental health counseling, and dedicated "Wellness Weeks" that prioritize work/life balance.

- Drive Sustainability: Participate in annual Impact Days, where you receive paid time off to volunteer for community and environmental causes with your local office, or virtually.

- Global Inclusion & Belonging: Find community through our Inclusion Think Tank and participate in our annual Inclusion Days, ensuring every voice is heard and valued.

- Value-Driven Impact: Join a mission-led organization where our core values—Live for Customer Value, The Best Team Wins, We Own It, and Earth Is Our Future—drive every decision.

About Us: 

Celonis is the trusted platform to industrialize Enterprise AI, empowering organizations to analyze, design, and operate AI-driven processes. The Celonis Platform is powered by the Celonis Context Model, which combines process data, business knowledge, and intelligence to create a living digital twin of the enterprise that AI can understand — turning AI’s operational blind spots into operational clarity. Industry-leading companies around the world trust Celonis and its global ecosystem of partners to make their AI agents, people, systems, and processes work together, achieving transformational outcomes. Celonis is headquartered in Munich, Germany, and New York City, USA, with more than 20 offices worldwide.

Get familiar with the Celonis Process Intelligence Platform by watching this video .

Celonis Inclusion Statement: 

At Celonis, we believe our people make us who we are and that “The Best Team Wins”. We know that the best teams are made up of people who bring different perspectives to the table. And when everyone feels included, able to speak up and knows their voice is heard - that's when creativity and innovation happen. 

Your Privacy: 

Any information you submit to Celonis as part of your application will be processed in accordance with Celonis’ Accessibility and Candidate Notices 

By submitting this application, you confirm that you agree to the storing and processing of your personal data by Celonis as described in our Privacy Notice for the Application and Hiring Process .

Use of Artificial Intelligence Tools 

We rely on an artificial intelligence tool to match the information from your resume to the relevant Celonis job descriptions. This processing is limited to the information provided in your resume or in your candidate profile. The tool produces a match score per candidate for a role, suggests preliminary ranking, and provides recommendations.

The tool is only used for support in parts of the job application process, including to facilitate the identification of the relevant Celonis Jobs for candidates and recruiters. All final decisions are made by hiring managers and the Celonis talent acquisition team. Hiring managers and HR specialists use this tool responsibly, are aware of the risk of potential bias, and are equipped to mitigate it.

Please be aware of common job offer scams, impersonators and frauds. Learn more here .

title: Founding Tech Lead (GrowthBricks)
description:
Founding Tech Lead (GrowthBricks) 

Are you a hands-on engineer who loves zero-to-one challenges? Do you want to build systems with real context and memory that do more than reason, use tools, and drive actual business outcomes? 

About JetBrains 

We create intelligent software development tools for developers and teams. More than 15 million users, over 300,000 companies, and 88 of the Fortune Global Top 100 rely on our products to solve real, complex problems. Our mission is simple: make development teams more productive and AI adoptable at scale.

GrowthBricks is a new project at JetMinds, backed by JetBrains, designed to give GTM teams and AI agents a shared business brain. Business context usually gets fragmented across CRMs, documents, dashboards, and people's heads. GrowthBricks brings that context together so agents and people can make decisions and execute effectively across the sales, marketing, and product stack.

About GrowthBricks 

GrowthBricks is a shared business brain for GTM teams and AI agents.

It brings together the context that usually lives across CRM, docs, dashboards, tools, and people’s heads: who we sell to, why customers buy, what matters now, what we tried, and what worked. Agents and people use that context to decide what to do next and execute across the GTM stack.

GrowthBricks is a new project at JetMinds, backed by JetBrains.

About the role 

We’re looking for a hands-on Founding Tech Lead to build GrowthBricks from zero.

You’ll work directly with the product founder and own the technical side of the product: architecture, core systems, integrations, and the agent layer.

The core challenge is turning fragmented, changing business context into reliable memory and agent actions across tools and measuring whether those actions actually drive business outcomes.

You’ll write a lot of the early code yourself, make the key technical decisions, and shape the product as we learn what works.

What you’ll work on 

- Design the core architecture: business context, agents, tools, integrations, and feedback loops.

- Build agentic workflows that can reason over company context and act across CRM, sales, marketing, and product systems.

- Build context extractors from GTM team artifacts like sales calls, emails, internal documents, CRM state, marketing campaigns, etc.

- Work on prompting, context management, memory, tool use, and orchestration.

- Connect GrowthBricks to the existing GTM stack rather than rebuilding everything around it.

- Decide where to use MCP, APIs, frameworks, or third-party tools and where a custom solution is worth it.

- Prototype fast, discard weak ideas, and turn the useful ones into product primitives.

We expect that you 

- Are a strong hands-on engineer who enjoys zero-to-one work.

- Have built with LLMs, agents, or agentic workflows used by real people, and improved them based on failures, evaluations, and user feedback.

- Understand how context, prompting, tools, and agent behavior fit together.

- Can design backend systems, APIs, data models, and integrations.

- Are comfortable making decisions before all the answers are known.

- Prefer simple, pragmatic solutions over unnecessary complexity.

We’re especially interested if you 

- Have worked in solution engineering, sales engineering, pre-sales, or built software for GTM teams.

- Understand the modern GTM stack: CRM, enrichment, outbound, automation, and product signals.

- Have automated sales or marketing workflows, ideally with agents or LLMs.

- Have owned a technical product from a blank repo to something people actually used.

GTM experience is not mandatory, but if you already understand how sales and marketing teams work, that is a strong advantage.

What we offer 

- A competitive salary and strong benefits package.

- The runway and resources of an established company, with startup-level autonomy.

- A founding role with direct influence over both product and architecture.

- Real users and real workflows from day one.

- Freedom to choose the stack, tools, and technical approach.

- A chance to help define what an agent-native GTM product should look like.

title: Senior IT Engineer
description:
Health can’t wait . 

Not for symptoms to get worse. Not for a six‑month appointment. Not for a system to catch up. But that’s exactly how healthcare works today. You wait, until you can’t.

Alan exists to end the wait.

Health is a universal right, and we believe this right can only become real when it’s coupled with prevention. We need to stop treating health as something we repair and start treating it as something we build, every day. It’s not solely a question of willpower. It’s the healthcare system itself that needs to work for everyone, in a sustainable way.

So we are building the new standard in prevention insurance. Alan is the first company that integrates insurance, prevention, and care into a single, acclaimed user experience.

We are on an incredible journey to build a global leading company, with a unique culture . We already partner with 40K+ companies of all sizes, serving more than 1M+ members, and have reached €800M+ in ARR.

Prevention as the new norm. That's what we're building with our team of 1000+ people. If it speaks to you: we're hiring across France, Spain, Belgium, and Canada. And beyond.

Mission 

Alan is scaling internationally (800+ employees, 100+ healthcare professionals, 5+ countries) and needs IT Engineers to build and own the internal technology platform every Alaner works on: identity and provisioning, endpoint and SaaS security, the tooling behind our clinics, and the automation that keeps IT from scaling linearly with headcount.

The scope below is what the team owns, not a checklist for one person. You'll be staffed on one or two of these areas at a time, according to your strengths and interests, and it will evolve through time based on company needs and personal appetite.

Staying close to users keeps us building the right things: you'll spend up to 2-3 days a month on IT support, seeing first-hand where friction lives and what's worth automating next.

Scope 

⚙️ Platform & automation 

- Own and extend automations on Alan Home, our internal provisioning engine

- Maintain, extend and improve helpdesk automation, SaaS provisioning flows, and onboarding/offboarding pipelines

- Own the meeting room AV and room-booking platform as a product, replicable across offices

🔑 Identity & access 

- Own the IT side of the employee lifecycle (onboarding, offboarding, mobility between jobs and countries) across Google Workspace, SSO/SAML and our SaaS ecosystem.

- Grow our role-based access model: extend it to more tools and refine the permission groups, so access is granted by role rather than case by case

- Make employee lifecycle events reliable, fast and auditable end-to-end

- Own access reviews and least-privilege models; produce and maintain the evidence our auditors rely on

- Own SaaS procurement and license management: vendor relationships, renewals, and cost optimization across our stack

🔒 Endpoint & SaaS security 

- Own the Mac fleet in Kandji: enrollment at scale, role-based blueprints, fleet compliance

- Cloudflare WARP, SaaS security controls

- Maintain and strengthen our ISO 27001 certification and drive ACPR and pentest remediation on the endpoint and platform scope

🩺 Health Professionals IT 

- The IT layer behind Alan's clinics: practitioner tooling, equipment, access

- Role and permission automation for healthcare professionals, and their support and escalation process

🌍 Internationalisation 

- Make international expansion something IT accelerates, not something it slows down: a repeatable process where every new market (Canada, KSA, Armenia...) launches on our standard stack from day one

- Bring acquired entities onto that same platform

Milestones 

First 3 months 

- Acquire technical knowledge on Alan's platform: Alan Home, Google Workspace/SSO, Kandji, Cloudflare WARP

- Take one project end-to-end and ship a first increment

- Join the IT oncall team as technical escalation

First 6 months 

- Own a workstream end-to-end

- Deliver one automation or hardening initiative end-to-end

- Take up documentation and automation on your scope and reduce significantly the bus factor on it

- Mentor IT teammates on your core expertise

First year 

- Deliver measurable IT toil reduction on your scope

- Set the technical standards on your domain: how we build, document and review it

- Build strong cross-functional partnerships (Engineering, Security, Workplace, Clinic, People, Audit)

- Contribute to hiring and onboarding new teammates

3 years 

- Lead major projects end-to-end across several communities

- Be the reference the team relies on across at least two domains

- Mentor the IT team and beyond, and scale IT without a linear increase in manual work

As the community grows, there is room to take on more responsibility: leading a crew, owning cross-community projects, mentoring, hiring.

What we're looking for 

Must-have - Technical/hard skills: 

- 5+ years in IT engineering, platform, systems or corporate engineering , with real ownership of production-facing systems

- Depth in at least one area (platform & automation, identity, endpoint & security) and demonstrated range beyond it. 

- You write code: not necessarily as a full-time software engineer, but Python, APIs and pull requests in a shared repo should feel normal

- Structured problem-solving: diagnoses methodically, asks the right clarifying questions, thinks about failure modes and rollback

- Comfort with regulated environments: health data, ACPR, ISO 27001, HDS

- Automation & AI appetite : uses AI tools smartly to accelerate their own delivery, with an instinct for what should be automated or delegated to AI rather than repeated

Must-have - Behavioral / soft skills: 

- Ownership & autonomy: drives topics forward without hand-holding, including when they cross into someone else's perimeter

- Written communication: Alan is written-first; decisions get argued in public documents and challenged by people outside your team

- Pragmatic judgment: balances "perfect" vs. "good enough", decides with incomplete information

- Documentation culture: reduces bus factor through clear documentation and knowledge sharing

Nice-to-have skills / Bonus points if you have: 

- Experience with an internal provisioning or IdP-driven automation platform

- Kandji or another MDM at scale

- Cloudflare Zero Trust / WARP, Datadog

- Audit remediation experience (ISO 27001, HDS)

- Multi-country rollouts, or IT integration after an acquisition

- Having mentored, coached or led a (small) crew

- Health or healthtech ecosystem familiarity

Languages: Fluent English & Professional French
