This role presents an exciting opportunity to thrive in a dynamic, fast-paced environment within a rapidly growing team, with abundant prospects for career advancement. This position will own the data pipelines, transformations, and reporting processes that support accurate, complete, and timely furnishing of customer account information to credit bureaus.

This role presents an opportunity to work in a fast-paced, high growth environment while taking hands-on ownership of a critical customer-facing data function. You will dig into account data and code, debug SQL and Python workflows, and carry issues from investigation through verified resolution. You will partner with Customer Service to resolve technical dispute escalations, with Compliance to apply approved reporting requirements, and with Engineering when a fix is needed in production services or the consumer app. We are looking for an independent problem solver who can manage recurring reporting operations while improving the systems behind them.

What You’ll Do: 

- Own recurring credit bureau furnishing operations, including data preparation, validation, submissions, bureau feedback, exception resolution, and reconciliation 

- Build, maintain, and debug SQL transformations, Python scripts, and data pipelines that produce credit reporting data

- Trace discrepancies from account activity and source records through transformation logic to furnished outputs; identify root causes and implement lasting fixes 

- Investigate escalations from Customer Service, explain what happened to account data and what should be reported under approved policies, and provide evidence to support their dispute responses 

- Identify all accounts affected by reporting defects, implement corrections and controlled reprocessing, and verify the resulting reporting outcomes 

- Develop automated tests, reconciliations, monitoring, and alerts to catch inaccurate, incomplete, duplicate, or unexpected reporting before submission 

- Partner with Engineering on defects in production services or the consumer app, providing reproducible examples, affected-account analysis, and clear requirements; validate fixes through the reporting pipeline 

- Work with Compliance to translate approved reporting requirements into technical rules and escalate ambiguous reporting scenarios 

- Document reporting logic, data lineage, procedures, and incident resolutions so the process is repeatable and can be supported by others 

What We Look For: 

- Degree in computer science, engineering, data science, or a related quantitative discipline

- 5+ years of relevant experience in data engineering or software engineering, including hands-on ownership of production data pipelines and operational workflows

- Advanced SQL skills, including complex joins, account-level reconciliation, data profiling, and troubleshooting transformation logic

- Strong Python skills, including the ability to read unfamiliar code, debug existing scripts, and implement maintainable fixes

- Demonstrated ability to independently investigate ambiguous problems, prioritize recurring operations and incidents, and carry issues through to verified resolution 

- Experience with version control, code review, automated testing, monitoring, and safe deployment and reprocessing of data workflows

- Excellent problem-solving skills, with a track record of tracing data defects across systems and preventing recurrence

- Strong business judgment and communication skills; able to explain technical findings to Customer Service and Compliance and work effectively with Engineering 

- Fluent in English

- Demonstrated experience working with Claude or equivalent large language model tools is required; candidates must be comfortable leveraging AI to enhance productivity, research, and communication.

Preferred Knowledge and Skills: 

- 
Experience with credit reporting dispute workflows, e-OSCAR, Metro 2 format, and investigating escalations from customer support teams

- 
Experience with dbt, Redshift, PostgreSQL, AWS, and workflow scheduling or orchestration tools

- 
Experience in consumer lending, servicing, payments, financial services, banking, fintech, or BNPL

The Tech You’ll Work With: 

- Python

- Redshift, PostgreSQL

- Data build tool (dbt) 

- WS, G Suite, Mac

- Coding agents Claude, ChatGPT

Interview Process: 

- Application submitted (you are here)

- Wonderlic test (30-40 min)

- Interview with recruiters (30 min)

- Online coding assessment focused on SQL, Python, and debugging

- Verbal case study interview. Walk through a credit reporting discrepancy, trace the data and code, and explain how you would correct and prevent the issue.

- Verbal behavioral interview. Share examples of independently resolving data incidents, improving reliability, and partnering with Engineering and Customer Service.

- Offer

About You: 

- You have relentlessly high standards - many people may think your standards are unreasonably high. You are continually raising the bar and driving those around you to deliver great results. You make sure that defects do not get sent down the line and that problems are fixed so they stay fixed.

- You’re not bound by convention - your success—and much of the fun—lies in developing new ways to do things

- You need action - speed matters in business. Many decisions and actions are reversible and do not need extensive study. We value calculated risk-taking.

- You earn trust - you listen attentively, speak candidly, and treat others respectfully.

- You have backbone; disagree, then commit - you can respectfully challenge decisions when you disagree, even when doing so is uncomfortable or exhausting. You have conviction and are tenacious. You do not compromise for the sake of social cohesion. Once a decision is determined, you commit wholly.

- You deliver results - you focus on the key inputs and deliver them with the right quality and in a timely fashion. Despite setbacks, you rise to the occasion and never settle.

What Makes Working at Sezzle Awesome? 

At Sezzle, we are more than just brilliant engineers, passionate data enthusiasts, out-of-the-box thinkers, and determined innovators; we are skilled musicians, yogis, cyclists, chefs, golfers, dog-lovers, and rock-climbers. We believe in surrounding ourselves with not only the best and the brightest individuals, but those that are unique and purpose-driven in all that they do. Our culture is not defined by a certain set of perks designed to give the illusion of the traditional startup culture, but rather, it is the visible example living in every employee that we hire.

title: Software Engineer AI Tooling
description:
About Supabase 

Supabase is the Postgres development platform, built by developers for developers. We provide a complete backend solution including Database, Auth, Storage, Edge Functions, Realtime, and Vector Search. All services are deeply integrated and designed for growth.

About the Role 

Weâre looking for a Software Engineer to join our AI Tooling team and help shape how developers and agents build with Supabase. You'll build and own our AI tooling, including agents, the MCP server, agent skills and the dashboard assistant, and as the space moves you'll build the tooling for new technologies too. You'll build it all eval-first: every tool ships with evals and metrics, so we know, with evidence, that it makes agents better rather than worse.

You'll work closely with the Docs, CLI, Frontend and SDK teams, and with the AI Tooling Infrastructure engineers who run these services in production. Other teams contribute to AI Tooling to improve Supabase's agentic capabilities, and you'll help them do that while keeping the quality bar high.

This role is ideal for someone who thrives in async, fast-paced environments and is excited about building developer tools that scale to millions.

What Youâll Be Responsible For

- Build and improve the AI tooling we run today, including the MCP server, agent skills, agents and the Assistant.

- Make new Supabase products usable by agents from day one: tools, skills and evals for new product surfaces. Also build tooling for new AI technologies as they emerge: prototype quickly, evaluate honestly, and decide with the team what is worth taking to production.

- Drive an eval-first approach: build and improve evals, instrumentation and feedback loops, measure tools against a no-tool baseline, and help define the quality KPIs and gates that stop regressions shipping.

- Understand how customers and agents actually use what we ship, and turn that into improvements to our tooling, interfaces and documentation.

- Design how documentation and product knowledge are exposed to agents, and measure whether it works.

- Build patterns and tools that help customers add AI to their own apps, such as MCP on Edge Functions, vector embeddings and agents running on Edge Functions.

- Enable teams to improve Supabase's agentic capabilities through contributions to AI Tooling: clear contribution paths, templates, documentation and review practice.

- Centralise shared AI logic so teams reuse it rather than duplicate it.

- Ship tools that are battle-tested, with strong tests, benchmarking and stress testing where it counts.

- Work with the AI Tooling Infrastructure engineers on reliability, auth and hosting.

- Work across Docs, CLI, Frontend, SDK and other teams to deliver one coherent developer experience, and stay close to the fast-moving AI ecosystem.

You Might Be a Good Fit If You 

Must have:

- Have 5+ years of experience in professional software engineering experience.

- Write strong TypeScript and know the JavaScript ecosystem well: npm, ES modules, bundlers, compatibility.

- Are deeply familiar with the AI ecosystem: current tools, agent patterns and practical trade-offs. You can tell a durable pattern from hype.

- Have built developer tools, product interfaces or platform primitives used by other engineers.

- Have designed or used evaluation frameworks to measure AI quality, reliability and task success, and understand baselines, variance and cost.

- Have strong judgement about where AI improves workflows and how to avoid fragile or gimmicky experiences.

- Write tests and validate reliability in real-world conditions.

- Know Postgres and relational database practice.

- Communicate clearly in writing, work across product, engineering and docs, and thrive in async, globally distributed teams.

- Are comfortable navigating ambiguity and moving quickly.

Nice to have:

- Experience with vector databases and embeddings, ideally pgvector.

- Examples of customer-facing AI features or agents you've shipped.

- Examples of documentation or structured knowledge designed for developers or agents.

- Experience with Braintrust or a similar eval and tracing platform, or setting up CI quality gates.

- Open-source contributions or developer tooling you've maintained.

- Experience across several product surfaces or teams.

What We Offer

We hire globally. We believe you can do your best work from anywhere. There are no Supabase offices, but we provide a WeWork membership or co-working allowance you can use anywhere in the world.

- ESOP 

Every team member receives ESOP (equity ownership) in the company. We want everyone to share in the upside of what weâre building together.

- Tech Allowance 

Use this budget to set up your ideal work environmentâlaptop, monitor, headphones, or whatever helps you do your best work.

- Health Benefits 

Supabase covers 100% of health insurance for employees and 80% for dependents, wherever you are. Your wellbeing and your familyâs health are important to us.

- Annual Off-Sites 

Once a year, the entire company gathers in a new city for a week of connection, collaboration, and fun. Itâs a highlight of our year.

- Flexible Work 

We operate asynchronously and trust you to manage your own time. You know what needs to be done and when.

- Professional Development 

Every team member receives an annual education allowance to spend on learningâcourses, books, conferences, or anything that supports your growth.

About the Team 

Supabase was born-remote and open-source-first. We believe our globally distributed team is our secret weapon in building tools developers love.

- ~400 team members

- 60+ countries

- 20+ languages spoken

- Over $1B raised (including our $500M Series F)

- 540,000+ community members

We move fast, build in public, and use what we ship. If itâs in your project, we probably use it in ours too. We believe deeply in the open-source ecosystem and strive to supportânot replaceâexisting tools and communities.

Our cutting-edge solutions empower businessesâfrom exchanges and wallets to payment processors and ATMsâto seamlessly integrate reserve-backed tokens across blockchains. By harnessing the power of blockchain technology, Tether enables you to store, send, and receive digital tokens instantly, securely, and globally, all at a fraction of the cost. Transparency is the bedrock of everything we do, ensuring trust in every transaction. 

Innovate with Tether 

Tether Finance: Our innovative product suite features the worldâs most trusted stablecoin, USDT , relied upon by hundreds of millions worldwide, alongside pioneering digital asset tokenization services. 

But thatâs just the beginning: 

Tether Power: Driving sustainable growth, our energy solutions optimize excess power for Bitcoin mining using eco-friendly practices in state-of-the-art, geo-diverse facilities. 

Tether Data: Fueling breakthroughs in AI and peer-to-peer technology, we reduce infrastructure costs and enhance global communications with cutting-edge solutions like KEET , our flagship app that redefines secure and private data sharing. 

Tether Education : Democratizing access to top-tier digital learning, we empower individuals to thrive in the digital and gig economies, driving global growth and opportunity. 

Tether Evolution : At the intersection of technology and human potential, we are pushing the boundaries of what is possible, crafting a future where innovation and human capabilities merge in powerful, unprecedented ways. 

Why Join Us? 

Our team is a global talent powerhouse, working remotely from every corner of the world. If youâre passionate about making a mark in the fintech space, this is your opportunity to collaborate with some of the brightest minds, pushing boundaries and setting new standards. Weâve grown fast, stayed lean, and secured our place as a leader in the industry. 

If you have excellent English communication skills and are ready to contribute to the most innovative platform on the planet, Tether is the place for you. 

Are you ready to be part of the future? 

About the job 

QV.AC is a general purpose AI assistant that runs locally on your devices. It gives people real control over their data and how they use AI. No cloud dependency, no data harvesting, and no one else's servers between you and your assistant. Our focus is local, on-device, privacy-preserving AI, connected across Tether's peer-to-peer ecosystem. We're building the AI assistant people actually own. Product sets the direction. 

We're looking for a Product Engineering Lead to turn that direction into features people love, built to a standard that holds up on real devices with real constraints. You lead the teams that build QV.AC's features and app experience on top of our local AI stack, each with its own lead. You report directly to the CTO and take direction from product. Product owns the what and the why. You own the how and the engineering bar. 

The split is roughly 70% engineering leadership and 30% product. You're a combination of three things. You're an engineering leader who has helped teams ship consumer products at speed. You have real product sense and can partner with PMs as an equal, shaping what gets built, not just executing it. And you have an intuition for AI systems and their limits, so you can turn emerging capabilities into features that work reliably on-device, without needing to build the models yourself. 

Responsibilities 

- Engineering - Run the app and feature teams day to day: unblocking, reviewing, and keeping them shipping.- Set and hold a high engineering bar for performance, reliability, and clean APIs.- Own the technical design of features and the API surface between our AI core and the app.- Make sure your teams work closely with our AI research and deep tech teams on code reviews, design, and anything that touches models or inference. 

- Product Partnership - Work alongside QV.AC's product managers to turn vision and roadmap into scoped, buildable work.- Push back when scope and reality don't match, and propose better paths when they exist.- Bring an engineering perspective to product decisions, especially on what local models can do well today and what they can't yet.- Help the team move fast, using AI tools and quick prototypes to validate ideas before committing to them. 

- Leadership - Create clarity around team goals and make sure everyone knows what success looks like.- Mentor team leads to build strong team operating systems, improve how their teams work with others, and grow as leaders.- Lead by example: roll up your sleeves when the team needs it, and step back when they're ready to own it. 

Mandatory: 

- Experience managing engineers or engineering leads who ship consumer product, ideally AI-powered apps. 

- Strong product sense : you can tell a good feature from a busy one. 

- Intuition for applied AI and on-device constraints : model size, latency, memory, battery, and the gap between a good demo and a reliable feature. You don't need ML research expertise, because our core abstracts it away. 

- You use AI tools heavily in your own work and enjoy experimenting with new models and capabilities. 

- Deep JavaScript and React . 

- Initiative, curiosity, resilience , and the ability to give and receive direct critique. 

Preferred: 

- Bonus: Experience with local or on-device inference, LLM evals, cross-platform mobile and desktop apps, or open source .

Recruitment scams have become increasingly common. To protect yourself, please keep the following in mind when applying for roles: 

- Apply only through our official channels. Â We do not use third-party platforms or agencies for recruitment unless clearly stated. All open roles are listed on our official careers page:Â https://tether.recruitee.com/ 

- Verify the recruiterâs identity. Â All our recruiters have verified LinkedIn profiles. If youâre unsure, you can confirm their identity by checking their profile or contacting us through our website.

title: Backend Developer
description:
About BJAK 

The original mission of BJAK is we believe people deserve smarter ways to plan, save and grow their money. This is the origin of our name.

Started in 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, its the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

Today, we are expanding ways to help people in the region — this includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our mission is help people get more from their money every day.

We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities from our offices and remotely, who truly enjoys their work. We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.

The Role 

We are looking for backend engineers to build the core systems behind BJAK's AI Neobank app.

This role is for engineers who can build reliable APIs, workflows and financial product infrastructure that can scale across markets, partners and millions of users.

What You'll Own 

- 
Build backend services and APIs for onboarding, accounts, payments, cards, transfers, rewards, travel, FX, KYC and risk flows.

- 
Design reliable systems that can support real customer transactions, operational workflows and future financial products.

- 
Integrate with internal systems, financial partners, payment providers, AI services and third-party platforms.

- 
Own backend quality across reliability, security, latency, observability, data integrity and incident handling.

- 
Work with product, frontend, mobile and AI teams to launch features quickly and safely.

- 
Improve existing systems by simplifying flows, removing manual work and automating repeatable processes.

What We're Looking For 

- 
Strong backend engineering experience in production systems.

- 
Good understanding of APIs, databases, authentication, authorization, queues, jobs, events and integrations.

- 
Experience building services used by real customers or internal operations at meaningful scale.

- 
Strong debugging, reliability, security and data quality mindset.

- 
Able to make practical trade-offs between speed, correctness, scalability and maintainability.

- 
Fintech, payments, banking, wallet, KYC, fraud or risk experience is a strong plus, but not required if fundamentals are strong.

This Role Is Not For 

- 
Engineers who only want isolated backend tasks.

- 
People who ignore security, data consistency, monitoring or operational risk.

- 
Developers who cannot work with fast-changing product requirements.

- 
Candidates who talk about scale but have not handled production systems.

- 
People who exaggerate impact without being clear on ownership.

The Bar 

We are looking for engineers with real technology career highlights. A strong highlight is not just working at a famous company. A strong highlight means you personally helped build, ship or scale a serious product, platform or system.

Location 

This role is remote, but candidates must be based in Poland . We are hiring specifically for this market, so applicants should already be based in Poland .

Language 

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

Interview Process 

Our process is designed to move fast:

1. Online assessment or practical task

2. Technical interview

3. CEO / final round

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

About Edconic 

Edconic is a leading player in the alternative, experiential education space. We partner with the world's largest and most well-known brands to create and run schools that capture the legacy and value of each brand. Our students get truly unique, once-in-a-lifetime experiences that help shape their future and give them the skills they need to reach their goals.

Our Mission: 

Edconic exists to help learners stand out, move forward, and build meaningful futures in the fields that inspire them. We bring together education and industry, partnering with iconic global organizations to create transformative learning experiences. Our programs are created and delivered by educators and industry practitioners, giving learners access to professional experts, real world challenges, and practical skills. As early career opportunities shrink, we offer credibility, connections, and hands on experience that internships once provided. We prepare learners not simply for their first job but for a lifetime of growth. 

Our values 

• Transformative education: relationship-rich, experiential learning that draws out each learner’s potential.

• Belonging: a community where learners, educators, experts, and staff can bring their authentic selves and support one another.

• Stewardship: as a family-owned organization, we think in generations, developing talent, caring for our partnerships, and building an impact that lasts.

The Role 

We're looking for an experienced Front-End Developer to join our web team, which owns every Edconic digital property – from our school websites to landing pages and email templates. You'll work alongside designers, IT, and MarTech to build solutions that serve real business needs while protecting each brand's unique identity.

You'll be one of two developers on the team, working directly with our lead developer. That means real ownership of your work, a genuine voice in how we build, very little process overhead, and a codebase that is actively moving toward a modern, standardized WordPress stack. We value craft: fast pages and code that the next developer can read.

What You'll Do 

- Build and maintain public-facing websites, micro-sites, and landing pages in collaboration with our lead developer, IT, and MarTech.

- Work with UX/UI designers to confirm the technical feasibility of designs, then translate them into polished, responsive pages that stay true to each brand.

- Build and maintain custom WordPress themes across both of our stacks: modern block-based builds (ACF Blocks, core blocks, block patterns, theme.json) and established classic themes built on PHP templates, Advanced Custom Fields, and Sass.

- Collaborate with our lead developer to shape the team's coding standards, tooling, and workflow, and help migrate our existing sites toward our new modern stack.

- Stay current on emerging web standards and bring ideas to the table where they genuinely fit.

What You Bring 

- 4+ years of front-end web development experience, with strong skills in semantic HTML, CSS, JavaScript, PHP, and WordPress.

- The ability to build a custom WordPress theme from scratch using PHP templates and Advanced Custom Fields.

- Strong CSS skills across Sass and modern native CSS (custom properties, nesting), and solid vanilla JavaScript.

- Comfort working in Git/GitHub with pull requests and code reviews, and with npm-based build tools and the command line.

- A habit of writing semantic, well-structured HTML that covers accessibility basics, with an eye for reuse, cross-browser compatibility, performance, and SEO.

- Experience building and testing HTML emails.

- Strong UX/UI sensibilities and a desire to sweat the small stuff.

- A proactive, self-directed working style – you can run with a project independently and prioritize across several at once.

- Excellent written and verbal communication – you're positive, collaborative, objective, and solution-oriented.

Bonus Experience

- CRM and marketing automation integration (Salesforce, Pardot/Account Engagement).

- UX or UI design, and design tools such as Figma and Adobe Creative Suite.

How We Use AI 

AI-assisted development is a new and evolving part of our workflow. We use AI coding tools to speed up research, scaffolding, review, and routine work, and you're welcome to do the same.

AI is a tool here, not a substitute for expertise. You are accountable for every line of code that you ship, which means you must be able to write, review, debug, and explain production code entirely on your own. Expect to demonstrate those skills without AI assistance during the interview process.

Location, Travel & Eligibility

- Must be legally authorized to work in the US.

- Bachelor's degree preferred (Computer Science, Interaction Design, Graphic Design, Communications, or a related field); equivalent professional experience is equally welcome.

Our Commitment 

Edconic supports and embraces diversity and inclusiveness, and we encourage candidates from all backgrounds to apply, even if you don't meet every requirement listed here. In this role, you will own automated test suite development and maintenance across Oracle ERP Cloud (Fusion) and Salesforce, with a focus on Tosca-based regression and progression testing. You will embed automated testing into CI/CD pipelines and partner closely with ERP Functional, Technical, and DevOps teams to ensure every release is tested consistently and defects are caught early.

What you'll be doing 

- Run Oracle ERP Cloud and Salesforce QA automation suites for all quarterly patch upgrades end-to-end.

- Review new Oracle and SFDC release features and recommend improvements to existing testing processes.

- Build and improve regression and progression test automation in the Tosca environment for Oracle Fusion and Salesforce.

- Create, maintain, and update Tosca scripts to reflect system and process changes across GL, AP, AR, and FAH modules.

- Lead feature enhancement reviews as part of quarterly patch assessment cycles and new enhancement projects.

- Integrate automated test suites into CI/CD pipelines; trigger regression suites automatically on every release candidate build.

- Maintain test infrastructure and environments in collaboration with DevOps and ERP Technical teams.

- Document test coverage, defect trends, and release readiness in Jira and shared reporting dashboards.

Automation Use Cases 

- FAH Process Automation: Auto-test Financial Accounting Hub on each new sales item addition to eliminate manual unit testing.

- AR Regression Suite: Automated flows for invoicing, receipts, and customer setup across every release.

- AP Regression Suite: Payment runs, supplier invoices, holds, and approvals tested automatically on each patch cycle.

- Salesforce Tosca Automation: Develop, maintain, and expand automated SFDC test suites in Tosca, integrated with release pipelines. 

What you should have 

- 3-5+ years of QA automation experience.

- Hands-on Tosca experience for regression and progression test suite development and maintenance.

- Experience executing and maintaining automated test cycles for quarterly Oracle patch upgrades.

- Familiarity with Oracle ERP Cloud and SFDC release feature review and technical impact assessment.

- Experience integrating automated test suites into CI/CD pipelines (Jenkins, GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, or equivalent).

- Familiarity with pipeline configuration: triggering regression runs on pull requests and release candidate builds.

- Working knowledge of version control (Git / GitHub or GitLab): branching, pull requests, and code review workflows.

- Basic scripting capability in Python, Shell, or PowerShell for test utility automation and pipeline support.

- Understanding of containerized test environments (Docker); experience running tests in ephemeral containers is a plus.

- Jira for defect tracking, test coverage reporting, and sprint participation.

- Experience writing and maintaining test documentation: test plans, test cases, regression logs, and release readiness summaries.

- Ability to work cross-functionally with ERP Functional Analysts, ERP Technical Developers, and DevOps engineers.

- Familiarity with SOX compliance, ITGC controls, and ERP change management practices.

Preferred Qualifications 

- Oracle Fusion certification or formal training in Oracle ERP Cloud modules.

- Experience with SaaS QA automation in a high-growth technology company environment.

- Exposure to OIC (Oracle Integration Cloud) or MuleSoft integration testing.

- Familiarity with Salesforce test automation frameworks beyond Tosca (Selenium, Provar, or equivalent).

- Prior experience working with AMS or managed services vendors in an ERP context.

- Knowledge of Oracle quarterly release cycles and technical impact assessments.

- Exposure to infrastructure-as-code or environment provisioning concepts (Terraform, Ansible).

This position is US-based and can be remote but if you live in the Bay Area, you’re welcome to work from our beautiful SF office.

title: Senior AI Engineer (m/w/d) – Agentic & Applied AI
description:
Über uns: 

HyPlus ist Dein Wegbegleiter im digitalen Wandel. Gemeinsam mit unseren Kund:innen entwickeln wir strukturiert, partnerschaftlich und mit klarem Fokus auf nachhaltigen Mehrwert, deren digitale DNA. Wir begleiten Unternehmen von der Anforderungsanalyse über Architektur, Softwareentwicklung und Implementierung bis hin zum Betrieb. Mit rund 800 Kolleg:innen in Deutschland, Polen, Litauen, Rumänien und Indien verbinden wir technologische Exzellenz mit Branchenkompetenz in Automotive, Handel, Banken & Versicherungen sowie dem öffentlichen Sektor.

Bei uns ist KI kein Innovationstheater. Wir betreiben einen eigenen GPU-Server, hosten Modelle selbst, betreiben einen eigenen AI Gateway und bauen für Kunden – insb. aus der Versicherungswirtschaft - Prozesse, die täglich echte Fälle entscheiden. Unser Center of Excellence AI ist die Stelle, an der neue Technologien zuerst ankommen, bewertet und dann in Projekte und in eine Guidance für unsere Mitarbeitenden übersetzt werden.

Wir suchen dafür jemanden, der/die wirklich tief drin ist: eine Person, die neue Modelle, Frameworks und Werkzeuge früh entdeckt, sie selbst ausprobiert und danach begründen kann, was davon in einem regulierten Unternehmensumfeld trägt und was nicht. Ungefähr 70 % der Zeit arbeitest du direkt in Kundenprojekten, rund 30 % gehören dem Center of Excellence (CoE) und damit der Frage, wo wir in achtzehn Monaten stehen.

Deine Aufgaben in Kundenprojekten: 

- Agentische Prozessautomatisierung: Du entwirfst und entwickelst Agenten und Workflows entlang realer Fachprozesse, beispielsweise für Schadenmeldungen, Dokumentenprüfungen oder Kunden-Onboarding, und entscheidest, wann KI oder klassische Logik sinnvoll ist

- LLM- und Bild-KI-Module: Du integrierst Text-, Dokumenten- und Bildverarbeitung als API-basierte Module in produktive Anwendungen und sorgst für eine zuverlässige Datenanreicherung

- Qualität messbar machen: Du entwickelst Testdatensätze, definierst Qualitätsmetriken und etablierst Regressionstests, um die Leistung von Modellen und Prompts messbar und zuverlässig zu machen

- Architektur und Integration: Du integrierst KI-Komponenten in bestehende IT-Landschaften und triffst nachvollziehbare Architekturentscheidungen

- Betrieb, Sicherheit und Compliance: Du verantwortest das Hosting von KI-Modellen auf eigener GPU-Infrastruktur sowie den AI Gateway und berücksichtigst Datenschutz, Sicherheit und EU AI Act

- Inferenz-Betrieb und AI-DevOps: Du betreibst und optimierst offene KI-Modelle mit Technologien wie Ollama, vLLM, SGLang und TGI sowie Docker und Kubernetes und verantwortest automatisierte Deployments, Monitoring und Kostenkontrolle

- Sparring im Presales: Du begleitest Kundentermine und Workshops, berätst Fachbereiche und bewertest technische Möglichkeiten, Kosten und Risiken

Deine Aufgaben im Center of Excellence: 

- Technologie-Radar: Du beobachtest technologische Entwicklungen, testest neue Lösungen und bewertest deren Nutzen für unser Unternehmen

- Referenzimplementierungen: Du entwickelst wieder verwendbare KI-Bausteine, Blueprints und Best Practices für unsere Projektteams

- Eigene Inferenz-Plattform weiterentwickeln: Du entwickelst unseren Modell-Stack und AI Gateway weiter, vergleichst Modelle und Inferenz-Technologien und schaffst Grundlagen für fundierte Technologieentscheidungen

- Standards und Kostenkontrolle: Du definierst Standards für Prompt- und Agent-Engineering, Modellauswahl, Betriebskosten und Sicherheit und dokumentierst diese zentral

- Befähigung in die Breite: Du vermittelst dein Wissen durch Schulungen, Demos und praxisnahe Leitlinien an unsere Mitarbeitenden

- Vom Wissen zum Angebot: Du entwickelst gemeinsam mit uns aus neuen Erkenntnissen marktfähige KI-Angebote und Services

- Abgeschlossenes Studium im IT- oder MINT-nahen Umfeld oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation

- ≥ 5 Jahre Erfahrung als Software-, Data- oder ML-Engineer, davon mindestens 18 Monate mit produktiven LLM-basierten Systemen

- Erfahrung mit mindestens einem produktiv eingesetzten agentischen System oder Workflow sowie mit RAG-Architekturen und der Bewertung ihrer Retrieval-Qualität

- Deutschkenntnisse auf C1/C2 Niveau und Englischkenntnisse auf B2 Niveau

- 20% Reisebereitschaft zu unseren Kunden bei Bedarf

- Deutscher Wohnsitz

- Sehr gute Python-Kenntnisse und sicherer Umgang mit APIs, Integrationen, Git, CI/CD, Containern und SQL

- Praxis im Betrieb offener KI-Modelle wie vLLM, Ollama, TGI oder SGLang sowie Kenntnisse in GPU-Dimensionierung, Quantisierung und Sprachmodellen wie Whisper

- Erfahrung mit DevOps und MLOps im KI-Umfeld, insbesondere Docker, Kubernetes, Helm, Infrastructure as Code, GitOps, CI/CD und Monitoring

- Verständnis von Modell-Adaption und Fine-Tuning, beispielsweise LoRA, Datenaufbereitung und Evaluation, sowie die Fähigkeit, den tatsächlichen Nutzen einzuschätzen

- Selbstverständlicher Einsatz von Coding-Agenten wie Claude Code und ein gutes Verständnis ihrer Möglichkeiten und Grenzen

- Fähigkeit, Benchmarks kritisch zu bewerten, eigene Evaluationen durchzuführen und fundierte Technologieentscheidungen zu treffen

- Grundkenntnisse in Datenschutz und Informationssicherheit im Unternehmensumfeld, insbesondere DSGVO, Auftragsverarbeitung und Mitbestimmung

Nice to have: 

- Erfahrung mit Versicherungs-, Schaden- oder Gutachterprozessen oder vergleichbaren regulierten Branchen

- Kenntnisse in Computer Vision zur Schaden- und Zustandserkennung auf Bildern und Videos

- Erfahrung mit anspruchsvollen Dokumenten- und OCR-Pipelines

- Kenntnisse in Oracle, APEX, .NET/C# oder Azure

- Erfahrung mit skalierbarem Inferenz-Betrieb, GPU-Sharing, Multi-GPU-Serving, Autoscaling und Performance-Optimierung

- Erfahrung im eigenen Modelltraining oder Fine-Tuning inklusive Datenaufbereitung

- Engagement in der KI-Community durch Open-Source-Beiträge, Vorträge, Veröffentlichungen oder eigene Experimente

Das erwartet dich: 

- Attraktive Vergütung & Benefits – wettbewerbsfähiges Gehalt und Gesundheitsbudget, Team-Offsites, moderne Tech-Ausstattung, Mobilitätspaket, Jobrad etc.

- Karriereperspektive – klar definierte Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten & Jahresgespräche

- Weiterentwicklung – kontinuierliche Trainings, Zertifizierungen und Zugang zu Branchen-Events

- Flexibilität – Hybrid-/Remote-Modell, flexible Arbeitszeiten

- Unternehmenskultur – kollegiales, politikarmes Umfeld, in dem deine Ideen und Ergebnisse zählen

- Innovation mit Freiraum – eigene GPU-Infrastruktur und ausdrücklich geschützte Zeit zum Experimentieren. Innovation ist Teil deiner Rolle, nicht Freizeitbeschäftigung

- Gestaltungsspielraum & Verantwortung – ein CoE-Mandat mit echtem Einfluss: Du prägst Standards und Guidance für rund 800 Mitarbeitende

Chancengleichheit: 

HyPlus ist ein Arbeitgeber der Chancengleichheit. Wir schätzen Vielfalt und setzen uns aktiv für ein inklusives Arbeitsumfeld ein, in dem sich alle Mitarbeitenden willkommen und wertgeschätzt fühlen.

-> Statt eines Anschreibens interessiert uns, wie du denkst: 

Schicke uns zusammen mit deinem Profil bitte eine knappe Seite mit drei Punkten:

- Drei Technologien, Modelle oder Werkzeuge, die dir in den letzten sechs Monaten wichtig geworden sind und was sie konkret für ein Unternehmen wie uns bedeuten

- Eine Sache, die du ausprobiert und danach bewusst verworfen hast, mit deiner Begründung

- Einen Link auf etwas Eigenes: Code, Demo, Repository, Artikel oder Projektbeschreibung

title: Principal Simulations Software Engineer
description:
Please review the job details below.

Intuitive Machines - West (formerly Lanteris Space Systems) is currently seeking a Principal Software Engineer to join our Simulations team in San Jose, CA, or a US remote location. In this role, you will provide technical leadership in designing and implementing software for spacecraft simulators used by internal and external customers, while shaping the technical direction of our simulation architecture and mentoring engineering staff across the organization.

Responsibilities

Technical Leadership & Strategy

- 
Define and drive the technical vision and architecture for spacecraft simulation systems across multiple programs and projects

- 
Lead the evaluation and adoption of new simulation technologies, frameworks, and methodologies to advance organizational capabilities

- 
Serve as the subject matter expert on simulation architecture, distributed systems, and real-time modeling for the organization

- 
Identify and resolve complex technical issues that span multiple subsystems and require evaluation of intangible factors and trade-offs

- 
Create and maintain formal networks with key technical decision-makers across engineering disciplines, program management, and customer organizations

Technical Execution

- Design and implement sophisticated models of spacecraft components and/or subsystems for all-software spacecraft simulators, addressing significant and unique technical challenges

- Read, interpret, and provide authoritative guidance on spacecraft hardware specifications, Interface Control Documents (ICDs), and technical documentation

- Architect and enhance complex simulation codebases, making critical decisions on system architecture, design patterns, and long-term maintainability

- Champion satellite and software industry best practices and drive their adoption across simulation projects

- Establish standards and best practices for CI/CD pipelines, automated testing frameworks, and software quality

Leadership & Influence

- 
Mentor and provide technical guidance to engineers at all levels, from entry-level through senior staff

- 
Lead technical design reviews and serve as the authoritative voice on simulation architecture decisions

- 
Coordinate activities across multiple engineering teams to ensure coherent system designs and successful integration

- 
Represent the organization externally as a technical spokesperson at customer meetings, industry conferences, and technical forums

- 
Contribute to business development by providing technical expertise for proposals and customer engagements

- 
Drive innovation in simulation methodologies and contribute to the company's technical roadmap

Collaboration & Communication

- Communicate cross-functionally with software, systems, hardware, and program management to ensure alignment on technical objectives

- Lead customer-facing design reviews and technical discussions with senior stakeholders

- Exercise independent judgment in determining methods, techniques, and evaluation criteria for solving complex simulation challenges

- Build and maintain formal networks involving coordination among multiple engineering groups

Minimum Requirements

Education & Experience

- Must be a U.S. citizen or permanent resident

- 
Requires a minimum of 15 years of related professional software development experience with a Bachelor's degree in Computer Engineering, Computer Science, Mathematics, Physics, Aerospace Engineering, or related disciplines 
- 
OR 10 years with a Master's degree

- 
OR 8 years with a PhD

- 
OR equivalent experience (four additional years of experience may be substituted for a degree)

- 
10+ years of demonstrated expertise in simulation of spacecraft or other complex physical systems

- 
Proven track record of technical leadership on multiple significant programs or projects

Technical Expertise

- 
Expert-level proficiency in reading, interpreting, and providing guidance on technical documentation (hardware specifications, ICDs, datasheets, system architecture documents)

- 
Deep expertise in software architecture for complex, real-time simulation systems

- 
Expert proficiency with Linux development environments

- 
Extensive experience with CI/CD pipelines, automated testing frameworks, and software quality practices at organizational scale

- 
Authoritative knowledge in the following: 
- Developing large-scale software systems in C++ and Python (expert-level C++ required)

- Architecting and debugging complex distributed systems

- Software development life cycle best practices and process improvement

- Agile methodologies and technical leadership within Agile teams

- Modern software engineering tools and practices

Leadership & Communication

- 
Demonstrated ability to lead technical initiatives that span multiple teams or disciplines

- 
Proven mentorship and technical coaching of engineers at various experience levels

- 
Strong executive communication skills with ability to present complex technical concepts to diverse audiences

- 
Track record of influencing technical direction at the organizational level

Preferred Qualifications

Advanced Technical Skills

- 
Deep expertise in applied mathematics with proven ability to architect and implement sophisticated mathematical algorithms (numerical methods, linear algebra, differential equations, computational physics, control theory)

- 
Expert knowledge of simulation standards and frameworks such as HLA (High Level Architecture), DIS, or TENA

- 
Extensive experience with distributed simulation architectures, real-time synchronization, and middleware (DDS, ZeroMQ, RTI)

- 
Advanced knowledge of TCP/IP network programming, including low-latency and real-time communication protocols

- 
Expert understanding of spacecraft hardware interfaces and protocols (UART, SPI, I2C, CAN, SpaceWire, MIL-STD-1553)

- 
Deep knowledge of spacecraft command and telemetry protocols (CCSDS, Space Packet Protocol)

- 
Mastery of software design patterns , object-oriented design, and software architecture principles

- 
Experience architecting containerized and cloud-native simulation systems (Docker, Kubernetes)

Domain Expertise

- 
Significant experience in spacecraft operations, design, testing, or mission support

- 
Published work or conference presentations in simulation, aerospace, or related technical fields

- 
Industry recognition or leadership roles in professional organizations related to simulation or aerospace

- Active U.S. citizenship and current or past security clearance (or ability to obtain TS/SCI for classified programs)

Leadership & Strategic Impact

- 
Track record of defining technical roadmaps for simulation systems or similar complex software

- 
Experience with business development , including technical proposal leadership and customer engagement at executive levels

- 
Demonstrated ability to identify and champion adoption of emerging technologies that create competitive advantage

- 
History of building and leading technical communities of practice or centers of excellence

- 
Cross-organizational influence with demonstrated ability to drive technical standards and best practices company-wide

Personal Attributes

- 
Strategic thinking with ability to balance long-term technical vision with near-term execution needs

Exceptional problem-solving ability for issues involving evaluation of intangible factors and complex trade-offs

- 
Passion for space exploration and commitment to mission success

- 
Executive presence and credibility with senior technical and business leadership

- 
Continuous learning mindset and drive to stay at the forefront of simulation and aerospace technology

description:

Damit diese Inhalte ihre Ziele erreichen, brauchen wir genau dich in unserem Team Data & Insights !

Aufgaben

- Datenanalyse & Performance-Optimierung: Du analysierst und verarbeitest große Datenmengen rund um Social Media, SEO, Paid Search und digitales Marketing, behältst alle relevanten KPIs im Blick und leitest konkrete Handlungsempfehlungen ab.

- Datenmodellierung & Automatisierung: Du baust saubere Datenmodelle in Google BigQuery , verarbeitest Daten mit SQL und Python , bindest Datenquellen über APIs an und entwickelst automatisierte Reportings sowie interaktive Dashboards in Looker .

Qualifikation

- Tech- & Daten-Skills: Sehr gute analytische Fähigkeiten sowie fundierte Kenntnisse in der Datenverarbeitung mit SQL und Python sowie Erfahrung mit Google BigQuery .

- Social- & Reporting-Tools: Sicherer Umgang mit YouTube Analytics , der Meta Business Suite und gängigen BI-/Reporting-Tools (z. B. Looker Studio ).

- Development-Grundlagen: Erste Erfahrungen oder ein gutes Grundverständnis im Bereich Software Engineering / API-Anbindung.

- Storytelling mit Daten: Du kannst komplexe technische Analysen so aufbereiten und erklären, dass auch nicht-technische Teams sie sofort verstehen und nutzen können.

- Mindset: Du arbeitest akribisch, gut organisiert und proaktiv, denkst gerne über den Tellerrand hinaus und hast ein echtes Gespür für Social Media und internationale Trends.

- Sprachen: Verhandlungssicheres Deutsch und Englisch.

Nice-to-have (kein Muss, aber ein großes Plus): 

- Erfahrung mit spezialisierten Python-Libraries (z. B. Mito oder Zeitreihenanalysen mit ARIMA ).

- Kenntnisse in Social-Intelligence-Tools wie Tubular oder Locowise .

Benefits

- Gestalte mit uns die Zukunft: Wir bieten dir die Möglichkeit, mit deinen Analysen aktiv an unserem Wachstum mitzuwirken, echte Verantwortung zu übernehmen und unsere strategischen Entscheidungen maßgeblich zu prägen.

- Liefere datenbasierte Impulse: Als wertvolles Mitglied unseres Teams hilfst du uns, Zielgruppen und Markttrends tiefgehend zu verstehen und unser Unternehmen gezielt weiterzuentwickeln. (Angepasst von „Trends deiner Generation“)

title: Senior/Lead Security Engineer - Pentester
description:
Menlo Security is the leader in Browser Security for human and agentic workforces. Our mission is to enable humans and agents to connect, communicate, and collaborate securely, without compromise. The Menlo Browser Security Platform protects organizations from cyberattacks by stopping threats across the web, documents, and email before they reach the user. With Menlo Agent Runtime Security (MARS), that protection now extends to the AI agents working alongside every employee. Menlo Security is trusted by major global businesses, including Fortune 500 companies and government agencies, to protect their most valuable asset, their data, and is backed by top-tier investors.

Summary 

We're looking for a forward-thinking Security Engineer to join our security team, focused on offensive and defensive testing, penetration testing of product features, and the cloud architecture behind the product. You'll operate across a complex multi-cloud environment (AWS & GCP) spanning traditional VMs and modern managed and unmanaged container-based architectures, partnering with fellow Penetration Testing and Cloud Security engineers to run targeted assessments during the testing window immediately before each release. The role reaches beyond the application layer into the Control Plane, reviewing cloud configurations, IAM policies, and orchestration layers against security baselines, and extends to the frontline of external defense by triaging bug bounty submissions and outside vulnerability reports. AI and large language models are core to how this team works day to day — you'll use them to accelerate reconnaissance, generate attack vectors, analyze configurations, and draft vulnerability reports, while applying human judgment to validate findings and communicate risk clearly to product teams. Speed matters here: the team's operating cadence is built around identifying, validating, and reporting vulnerabilities quickly enough to keep pace with release velocity.

Outcomes & KPIs 

Key Outcome(s) Owned: 

- Ensure new product features and the underlying multi-cloud (AWS/GCP) infrastructure are rigorously security-tested before release, and that vulnerabilities surfaced internally or via bug bounty are triaged and communicated with speed and precision.

Success Metrics / KPIs :

- Percentage of roadmap features assessed within the pre-release testing window.

- Mean time to triage and validate bug bounty / external vulnerability reports.

- Reduction in critical/high-severity vulnerabilities escaping to production post-release.

- Time saved per assessment cycle through AI-assisted tooling and automation.

- Quality and actionability of vulnerability reports and PoCs, as rated by product teams.

What You'll Do 

- Conduct deep-dive penetration tests of products across a multi-cloud (AWS & GCP) environment, working in tandem with a peer pentester.

- Review IAM policies, service configurations, and cloud-native permission structures across the Control Plane to ensure cloud configurations meet security baselines.

- Execute dynamic testing against web interfaces and API endpoints (Data Plane & Web UI).

- Assess the security posture of hybrid infrastructure spanning containers and virtual machines.

- Triage findings, build clear and reproducible proofs-of-concept, and partner with product teams to explain risk and drive remediation.

- Use AI and large language models to automate reconnaissance, generate attack vectors, analyze configurations, and draft vulnerability reports, applying strong prompt-engineering skills to security contexts.

- Monitor bug bounty pipelines and external reports, validating findings and managing researcher communication.

Functional Competencies 

Required: 

- Multi-Cloud Fluency: Deep architectural understanding of GCP and AWS. Capable of pivoting seamlessly between providers, performing manual configuration reviews of complex IAM/Resource hierarchies, and leveraging native APIs or modern CSPM frameworks to validate security controls.

- Container Security: Proven experience auditing and hardening managed container services (GKE Autopilot/Standard, EKS, ECS) and self-hosted/unmanaged workloads (K8s, k3s, OCI-runc).

- AI Tooling: Demonstrated ability to integrate AI/LLM tools (e.g., Gemini, Claude) into the pentesting lifecycle to increase speed and coverage.

- Web Application Security: Expert-level knowledge of web application security principles and offensive testing methodologies, with deep proficiency in OWASP Top 10 vulnerabilities, modern web framework exploitation, and API security (REST, WebSockets). Extensive hands-on experience conducting manual security assessments using Burp Suite Professional, OWASP ZAP, or similar tooling. Strong understanding of browser security mechanisms (CSP, CORS, SameSite cookies, Subresource Integrity), secure authentication/authorization patterns (OAuth 2.0, OIDC, JWT), and security header configurations (HSTS, X-Frame-Options, Permissions-Policy). Proven ability to identify complex security flaws beyond automated scanner detection, validate findings through proof-of-concept development, and provide actionable remediation guidance to engineering teams.

- Security Automation: Proficiency in Python, Go, or Bash to eliminate "toil" — writing custom scripts and tooling to automate vulnerability discovery, validate security controls, and streamline testing workflows.

- Infrastructure as Code: Solid grasp of Terraform and cloud-native deployment patterns; able to interpret and audit complex HCL files to identify misconfigurations before they are provisioned.

- Communication: Ability to write high-quality technical reports that Product Teams can easily understand and act upon.

Preferred / Nice to Have: 

- Experience with Gatekeeper policies and Binary Authorization.

Our Compensation and Benefits 

At Menlo Security, Base Salary is one part of our competitive total compensation and benefits package and is determined using a salary range. The base salary range for this role is 158,000 CAD - 237,000 CAD.

In accordance with Canadian law, the range provided is Menlo Security’s reasonable estimate of the base compensation for this role. The actual amount may be higher or lower, based on non-discriminatory factors such as experience, knowledge, skills, abilities, and location. We take ownership and drive outcomes without waiting to be told. We communicate directly and seek hard truths. We break down silos and win together. title: Senior Software Engineer, Hardware-in-the-Loop Systems (m/f/d)
description:
TYTAN Technologies

The PACE is fast. The expectations are high. The contribution matters. Working at TYTAN is more than a job, this is a mission. We push boundaries, think big, and hold ourselves to the highest standard. Our mission and values guide everything we do, and we're looking for people who are driven by ownership, embrace challenges, and are energized by meaningful work. If you're motivated by impact and thrive in dynamic environments, you'll fit right in. 

At TYTAN , we aim to set a global standard in autonomous air defense with AI-driven, cost-efficient systems that counter unmanned aerial threats at scale. We protect people. We protect critical infrastructure. We protect European sovereignty. 

We are seeking a Senior Software Engineer, Hardware-in-the-Loop Systems to join our Platform Team. Our interceptors fly autonomous missions from launch to intercept. Before a software change flies in the air, we want to see it fly on the bench: the real mission computer and flight controller, flying a full simulated mission in real time against simulated physics, sensors and targets. We are taking our hardware-in-the-loop testing to full closed-loop missions, and you lead that build. 

You are a builder, not a test author. You design the rigs, couple the simulation to the hardware, and build the framework so that our autonomy and perception engineers write and run their own HIL scenarios on every change. 

Your roadmap to make an impact

- The closed loop: Couple real-time physics, sensor and target simulation to real flight hardware. Inject IMU, GNSS, camera and other sensor data at the interface the hardware expects, close the loop on actuator commands, and keep latency, jitter and time synchronisation within budget, so a flight on the rig behaves like a flight in the air. 

- Fault injection: Sensor failures, GNSS denial and spoofing, link loss, bus errors and power faults, reproducible on demand. 

- System rigs: Rigs for the current and next generation mission computer and for full system configurations with ground station, radio link and interceptors. Provisioned as code, with automated deployment of builds, remote power control, health monitoring and self-recovery. 

- HIL in CI: Merge-gating regression suites, nightly and long-running mission suites, rig scheduling across pipelines, flaky test detection, and structured results traceable to requirements. 

- Test framework: Fixtures for devices, instruments and simulators, so that a domain engineer writes a HIL test as easily as a unit test, and the same scenario runs in SIL and HIL. 

- HIL as a product: Your users are our autonomy, perception and systems engineers. Availability and time to result are your metrics, also in restricted and air-gapped lab networks. 

- 4+ years building HIL or hardware test systems for embedded or autonomous systems, including at least one closed-loop rig you designed and built yourself, not only operated or wrote test cases for 

- Real-time simulation coupled to hardware: plant and sensor models running in real time against real hardware, on commercial HIL platforms or custom Linux-based rigs 

- Expert Python, plus C or C++ for real-time components 

- Strong Linux and CI: self-hosted runners with hardware in the loop, containerised test environments, device management, remote power and console control 

- Debugging across the hardware and software boundary: embedded interfaces such as CAN, UART, SPI and Ethernet, and timing problems you have measured, not guessed 

- Degree in Electrical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent experience 

Nice to haves

- Flight or vehicle dynamics models, and PX4 or ArduPilot SITL/HITL 

- HIL platforms such as dSPACE, NI PXI/VeriStand or Speedgoat 

- Sensor stimulation at the hardware interface: IMU, GNSS, camera and video injection 

- Time synchronisation (e.g. PTP), real-time Linux and jitter measurement 

- Test frameworks at scale (pytest or Robot Framework) and instrument control via SCPI or VISA 

- FMI/FMU or Gazebo-based simulation 

- MAVLink and flight controller interfaces 

- GNSS simulators (e.g. Spirent, Safran Skydel) and RF environment simulation 

- Camera and image generation pipelines for perception testing 

- Requirements-based testing in DO-178C or ISO 26262 contexts 

- Rust for performance-critical test components 

- Firmware for test fixtures on microcontrollers 

- End-of-line test stations 

Why TYTAN? 

- Build technology with real operational impact: Develop autonomous defense systems designed to protect lives and strengthen Europe’s security 

- Shape scalable defense capabilities: Work on solutions built for mass deployment, cost efficiency, resilience, and reliable production at scale 

- Contribute to networked air defense: Help integrate our systems into multi-layered defense architectures alongside sensors, command systems, and effectors 

- Develop for real-world operations: Build capabilities together with end users and improve them continuously based on direct operational feedback 

- Move fast and take ownership: Work in a focused, high-performance team where decisions are made quickly and individual contributions have immediate impact 

- Define a new generation of defense technology: Join early and help shape the products, engineering standards, culture, and direction of a fast-growing deep-tech company 

- Work with an international mission-driven team: Collaborate with experienced specialists united by the goal of creating sovereign and effective security capabilities for Europe 

Our Benefits 

- Virtual stock options: Participate in our success through virtual stock options (VSOPs) at the company's current valuation 

- Monthly allowances: €106/month in flexible benefits including lunch discounts and EGYM Wellpass or shopping credit 

- Regular health care events: Health check-ups, skin screenings, mental health workshops, and an annual vitamin infusion on us 

- Referral bonus: Earn a reward when someone you refer joins the team 

- Regular team events: On- and off-site activities to connect and celebrate together 

- Corporate discounts: Exclusive employee discounts across a wide range of partner brands 

- Flexibility : Flexible working hours and hybrid work model, plus a modern Munich office built for focus and collaboration 

About us 

At TYTAN, it is more than just a job; it is about embracing autonomy, personal growth, and purpose. Make a lasting impact in the new era of defense! Join us to create a safer world for all. 

WE are an equal-opportunity employer committed to fairness and inclusivity. We do not prioritize any specific religion, gender, nationality, or background. Due to security clearance requirements, affiliations with countries listed under § 13 para. 1 no. 17 SÜG may affect the application process. 

Please note that we currently do not offer visa sponsorship, so we’re only able to consider candidates who already have a valid work permit. All qualified applicants are hereby encouraged to apply.

description:
Your wellbeing, our mission. Join a company shaping a healthier world. 

GET TO KNOW US 

At Wellhub we're revolutionizing workplace wellness. Our platform connects employees worldwide to the best partners for fitness, mindfulness, therapy, nutrition, and sleep—all in one simple subscription. Headquartered in NYC with team members in Europe, North America and South America, we’re on a mission to make every company a wellness company.

We believe work should be fulfilling, inspiring, and balanced. Here, you’ll find a team that values wellbeing, collaboration, and different perspectives, where passion and creativity push boundaries to create real impact. Your contributions will help shape a healthier, more balanced world for you and millions of people globally. 

Join us in redefining the future of wellbeing! 

THE OPPORTUNITY 

We are hiring a Software Engineer to our Professional Services Engineering team in Brazil ! 

This is a Remote – Brazil position, meaning you can work from anywhere within the country. Please note that this role is only open to candidates in Brazil.

Within our Revenue organization, Professional Services Engineering builds and maintains the custom integrations that connect Wellhub to enterprise clients' own HR, payroll, and benefits systems (eligibility feeds, payroll deductions, leavers, custom reports, and remittance files), through an internal Node.js/TypeScript ETL platform. You'll join a small team supporting major global accounts, including Fortune 500 enterprises, leading global financial institutions, and large-scale retail conglomerates. This role is centered on two things: keeping existing client integrations healthy in production, and building and launching new ones as we bring on new clients.

YOUR IMPACT 

- Lead backend development within an international team, building and maintaining robust, high-traffic APIs and custom system integrations to ensure successful project implementations.

- Establish and promote best practices in backend development, database management, and technical documentation across deliverables.

- Partner with Product Managers in internal and external meetings to discuss complex scenarios, map technical demands, and perform end-to-end validations.

- Own data manipulation and transformation workflows tailored to enterprise client requirements, ensuring accuracy and reliability in production.

- Drive the creation of detailed reports and operational insights for stakeholders while monitoring business metrics and KPIs.

- Ensure rigorous tracking of tasks and proactively identify and implement technical process improvements to scale team efficiency.

- Live the mission: inspire and empower others by genuinely caring for your own wellbeing and your colleagues. Bring wellbeing to the forefront of work, and create a supportive environment where everyone feels comfortable taking care of themselves, taking time off, and finding work-life wellness.

WHO YOU ARE 

- A seasoned software engineer with solid, in-depth knowledge of backend development, TypeScript, and Node.js , backed by a Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or equivalent professional experience.

- An engineer with extensive experience in SQL technologies (such as PostgreSQL and MySQL), possessing a deep understanding of common use cases and performance optimization.

- A technical specialist with proven expertise in creating and maintaining high-traffic APIs capable of handling thousands of requests per second.

- A cloud-savvy professional with solid familiarity with containerization and orchestration tools, specifically Docker and Kubernetes.

- A data-driven problem solver skilled in system monitoring, observability, and KPI tracking using tools like Datadog and Grafana.

- A sharp analytical thinker with strong critical-thinking abilities, advanced/fluent English proficiency for international collaboration, and a preference for advanced Excel skills.

We recognize that individuals approach job applications differently. We strongly encourage all aspiring applicants to go for it, even if they don't match the job description 100%. We welcome your application and will be delighted to explore if you could be a great fit for our team. For this specific role, please note that prior experience in backend software engineering with Node.js/TypeScript and SQL databases are mandatory requirements.

WHAT WE OFFER YOU 

With thoughtful benefits, emotional wellbeing resources, and a culture that empowers you to take ownership of your role and your wellbeing, we create an environment where you can thrive in all dimensions of your life. 

Our flexible benefits program allows you to customize some of the benefits, according to your needs!

Our benefits include: 

WELLHUB: Free Gold+ membership with access to onsite gyms and studios, digital fitness programs, and online wellness resources for meditation, nutrition, mental wellbeing support, and more! Add up to three family members to your plan, ensuring access to wellness for those who matter most to you.

WELLZ: A complete emotional wellbeing program with a unique approach. It offers personalized journeys that combine individual therapy sessions (52 per year) and on-demand content. 

HEALTHCARE: Health, dental, and life insurance. 

FLEXIBLE WORK: As a Flexible First company, we offer hybrid and remote options to give you the freedom to work in a way that suits you. The model for this specific role can be discussed with your recruiter and hiring manager. When you join, use our home office reimbursement to set up your home office. 

FLEXIBLE SCHEDULE: Flexibility for us isn’t just about where we work—it also means being able to shape how and when we get things done. Together with their leaders, employees define schedules that align with their time zones, team needs, and personal routines.

PAID TIME OFF: It’s important to take time away from work to recharge.Employees receive vacations after 6 months and additional 3 days off per year + 1 day off for each year of tenure (up to 5 additional days) + an extra holiday for your birthday!

PAID PARENTAL LEAVE: Welcoming a new child is one of the most special moments in your life. Take the time to be present and enjoy your growing family. We offer 100% paid parental leave to all new parents. Parents giving birth are eligible for an extended leave and a ramp-back period to return part-time while they get settled. 

CAREER GROWTH: Access world-class platforms, participate in interactive sessions, build your personalized development roadmap, and explore internal opportunities. We focus on continuous learning and feedback to support your journey toward personal and professional success.

CULTURE: You’ll join a team of passionate people who come together to break boundaries, support each other, and create a meaningful impact in workplace wellness. Derrière cette ambition, une équipe d’environ 250 personnes, réunies autour d’un même objectif : accompagner les juristes et avocats à toutes les étapes de leur travail, de l’analyse à la rédaction.
