title: SIP Expert
description:
About ElevenLabs 

ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.

We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always.

We have expanded from voice into three main platforms:

- 
ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.

- 
ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.

- 
ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.

Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.

How we work

- 
High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.

- 
Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.

- 
AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.

- 
Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.

- 
Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.

What we offer

- 
Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.

- 
Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.

- 
Learning & development : ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.

- 
Social travel : We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.

- 
Annual team offsite: Each year, we bring your entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia, Italy and Cancún

- 
Co-working : If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.

About the role 

We are looking for a SIP Expert to own the telephony layer that connects ElevenAgents voice agents to the phone network. SIP traffic is moving from early adoption to large enterprise call volumes, so the hard problems are now reliability and latency at scale.

Your general responsibilities will include: 

- 
Owning SIP end to end, from design doc to implementation, testing and ongoing operation, for a product used by enterprises at scale.

- 
Making call flows such as warm transfers dependable, and simplifying how our call services communicate with each other.

- 
Diagnosing and fixing load-related failures such as resource exhaustion and dropped connections.

- 
Collaborating with support, infrastructure and other teams to turn customer needs into shipped features.

Specific responsibilities might include: 

- 
Making our SIP edge and routing layer production-ready for large enterprise traffic.

- 
Designing and shipping lightweight, lower-latency call-handling services.

- 
Supporting carrier and SIP trunk integrations for enterprise customers.

You will join a small team of five, reporting directly to the team lead, with a high degree of ownership and very little bureaucracy.

Requirements 

We do not require any formal experience, certifications, or degrees. Instead, we are seeking enthusiastic engineers who can showcase solving impressively hard problems with artifacts such as past projects, designs, or open source contributions.

We do require: 

- 
Experience building and operating large-scale SIP/VoIP systems in production, including debugging load-related failures such as port exhaustion, dropped connections and state shared across services

- 
Hands-on experience running LiveKit (or comparable real-time media infrastructure) at scale, with comfort in WebSockets, WebRTC and RTP

- 
Strong backend engineering in Go or a comparable systems language, and a record of owning projects from design document through launch and maintenance

- 
Based in Europe or a nearby time zone, with at least 2 to 3 hours of daily overlap with CET

Bonus: Hands-on experience with Kamailio (or OpenSIPS/FreeSWITCH), or carrier and SIP trunk interconnects.

Location 

This role is remote-first, so it can be executed from anywhere in Europe or nearby time zones, with the ability to operate in GMT to GMT+4 time zones preferred. If you prefer, you can work from our offices in Dublin, London and Warsaw.

We are an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability or other legally protected statuses.

title: Director of IT and Workplace
description:
The Role 

We've grown to roughly 265 people working onsite from our Menlo Park headquarters, supported by a large network of remote U.S.-licensed clinicians â and part of the Series C is earmarked for acquisitions. The systems and the spaces holding all of that together were built for a much smaller company. We're hiring a Director of IT & Workplace to own them properly.

You'll own two halves of the same problem: the employee technology platform â identity, endpoints, networking, the SaaS portfolio, and our IT security posture â and the physical environment the company runs on, from space planning and physical security to the AV that customer demos and all-hands depend on. You'll inherit a small, capable team and be accountable for leveling it up. You'll be the named owner for IT controls in our HIPAA and SOC 2 programs, you'll own the IT and workplace budget, and when we acquire a company, you'll be the one integrating it.

Our Environment 

- Identity and access: Okta for SSO, MFA, and lifecycle provisioning.

- Productivity: Microsoft 365 and Google Workspace, both in active use across the company.

- Endpoints: a Mac-primary fleet with Windows machines alongside it, managed through MDM. VDIs included.

- Internal systems: IRU, plus a growing portfolio of internal and third-party SaaS applications.

- Workplace: a Palo Alto headquarters with conference room AV and access control, plus a distributed clinician and staff population.

What You'll Do 

Strategy, budget, and team 

- Own a multi-year IT and workplace roadmap tied to the hiring plan, and bring it to leadership with clear tradeoffs and funding asks.

- Own the IT and workplace operating and capital budget: forecast it, defend it in planning cycles, and continuously rationalize license, vendor, and facilities spend.

- Lead, coach, and grow the existing team â set clear expectations, run honest performance conversations, hire as scope deepens, and build career paths that keep strong people.

- Define and publish service levels for ticket response, uptime, onboarding readiness, and workplace turnaround, and report against them to the executive team.

Technology and infrastructure 

- Own the identity platform: SSO, MFA, automated joiner-mover-leaver provisioning in Okta, and access governance across every connected application.

- Own the endpoint fleet and the SaaS portfolio â Microsoft 365, Google Workspace, IRU, and a long tail of business applications â with enforced MDM baselines for encryption, patching, and configuration.

- Own network and connectivity for the headquarters and the remote workforce, with redundancy appropriate to a company our customers depend on.

- Replace manual provisioning, access reviews, and device setup with scripted, auditable workflows.

- Lead major programs end to end: platform migrations, upgrades, office buildouts, and the IT and workplace integration of acquired companies.

Security, compliance, and risk 

- Serve as the accountable owner for IT controls in our HIPAA, SOC 2, and customer security review programs, including evidence collection and audit response.

- Enforce least privilege across the environment and run recurring access certifications with documented outcomes.

- Partner with Security on incident response and vulnerability remediation, and with Legal on data handling, retention, and discovery requests.

- Own business continuity and disaster recovery for corporate systems â write the plans, test them, and fix what the tests expose.

- Treat protected health information and confidential data with the care our customers and their patients expect. This is non-negotiable in everything we do.

Workplace and facilities 

- Own day-to-day operations of the headquarters, and lead space planning and buildouts against a hiring plan that keeps moving.

- Manage physical security â access control and badging, visitor management, cameras, and emergency preparedness â aligned with our compliance obligations.

- Own conference room and event AV, including all-hands and customer visits, to a standard where the technology is never the story.

- Support remote clinicians and staff with reliable equipment logistics, home office standards, and consistent service regardless of location.

- Manage facilities, AV, security, and food vendors, plus landlord and lease matters, in partnership with Finance and Legal.

What You'll Bring 

- 8+ years in IT , spanning hands-on administration or engineering and progressively senior ownership. You've done the work you'll now be leading.

- 3+ years managing IT or workplace teams , including hiring, performance management, and developing people into bigger roles.

- Proven ownership of an IT function through rapid growth. You've scaled systems and process ahead of headcount, not behind it.

- Deep technical expertise across identity (Okta or comparable), Microsoft 365 and Google Workspace, MDM at fleet scale, and corporate networking.

- Experience as a named control owner in a regulated environment â HIPAA, SOC 2, or HITRUST â including sitting across the table from auditors.

- Budget ownership and vendor negotiation experience , with the financial fluency to frame a risk or a funding ask so a CFO can act on it.

- Workplace or facilities exposure â buildouts, moves, physical security, or lease management â or a genuine appetite to own it and learn quickly.

- Willingness to stay close to the work. This is a leadership role at a company where the director still unblocks a broken demo when it matters.

- Education: Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related field, or equivalent experience. We weigh demonstrated ability over credentials.

Nice to Have 

- Healthcare, life sciences, or another environment handling sensitive personal data at scale.

- IT integration of an acquisition, or standing up a function's first access governance or asset management program.

- Automation depth (Python, Bash, PowerShell) and experience managing devices and infrastructure as code.

- Certifications such as Okta Certified Administrator, Microsoft 365 Enterprise Administrator, Jamf, CISM, CISSP, or ITIL.

Why Join Hippocratic AI 

Reinvent healthcare with AI that puts safety first. Weâre building the worldâs first healthcareâonly, safetyâfocused LLM â a breakthrough platform designed to transform patient outcomes at a global scale. This is category creation.

title: Senior Software Engineer, Verticals (AI Native)
description:
Headquarters: Canada

URL: http://www.life360.com 

About Life360

Life360’s mission is to keep people close to the ones they love. Our category-leading mobile app, Tile tracking devices, and Pet GPS tracker empower members to protect the people, pets, and things they care about most with a range of services, including location sharing, safe driver reports, and crash detection with emergency dispatch. Life360 serves approximately 107.7 million monthly active users (MAU), as of September 30, 2026, across more than 180 countries. 

Life360 delivers peace of mind and enhances everyday family life with seamless coordination for all the moments that matter, big and small. By continuing to innovate and deliver for our customers, we have become a household name and the must-have mobile-based membership for families (and those friends who are basically family).

Life360 has more than 500 (and growing!) remote-first employees. For more information, please visit life360.com .

Life360 is a Remote First company, which means a remote work environment will be the primary experience for all employees. All positions, unless otherwise specified, can be performed remotely (within the US and Canada) regardless of any specified location above. 

We are AI Native

We are building an AI native company where AI is an integral part of how we build and operate. AI tool usage during interviews varies by role. You may be asked to demonstrate proficiency with AI tools, discuss how you leverage AI, or complete interview exercises without AI assistance. Your Recruiter will provide clear guidance as you move through the interview process.

Undisclosed use of AI not previously discussed with or approved by your Recruiter may impact your candidacy.

About The Team

This role sits on the Verticals team within Life360 — the group building the next frontier of meaningful connection beyond the core family circle. This role's initial focus is Aging in Place: helping aging parents stay safely independent while giving the families around them real peace of mind. Over time, this role may flex to support other emerging verticals — Things (Tile, connected trackers) or Pets — as priorities shift, so we're looking for someone who wants to help define the pattern for new member segments, not just ship one feature set.

We are a product-minded, AI-Native engineering team. That means AI isn't just a tool we use — it's how we work. We've redesigned our team workflows around AI, treating it as a first-class collaborator at every stage: ideation, coding, testing, review, and iteration. We ship faster and go deeper because of it, and we're looking for someone who wants to help define what that looks like at scale.

About the Job

Life360 is hiring an AI Native Senior Software Engineer — a senior engineer who doesn't just use AI tools, but thinks natively in them. You'll be central to how the Verticals team builds products.

You'll design and build features that serve one of our most important and fastest-growing member segments: aging parents who want to stay safely connected with, and independent from, the families who care about them. As priorities change, you may also apply these same patterns to Things (connected trackers) or Pets.

You will take full ownership of what you build from the first line of code through production, on-call, and the member impact it has. You obsess over the humans on the other end of the product, not just the ticket.

Full-stack experience is required for this role — you should be comfortable moving between backend services and the mobile surfaces that expose them. Our stack spans Spring Boot microservices, Java, Kafka, and Kafka Streams on the backend, a modern cloud-native platform on AWS, and native iOS (Swift) and Android (Kotlin) apps on the client side.

In your first year, success looks like having shipped end-to-end features serving the Aging in Place member segment and establishing at least one AI-native workflow the broader team adopts.

For candidates based in the US, the salary range for this position is $103,500 to $192,000 USD. For candidates based out of Canada, the salary range for this position is 149,500 to 177,500 CAD. Note: Please be aware that the job title for positions in Canada will be "Developer" in lieu of "Engineer." We take into consideration an individual's background, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience in determining final salary. Base pay may also vary based on geographic location, with US work locations falling into one of three geographic tiers. 

Total compensation is inclusive of equity compensation in the form of Restricted Stock Units (RSUs) , as well as a comprehensive benefits package, including medical, dental, vision, financial, and other benefits. 

What You’ll Do

- Ship end-to-end across the stack — from backend services and APIs through to the iOS and Android surfaces members use, serving tens of millions of users — moving between layers as the feature demands.

- Work with AI (Claude Code) as a first-class collaborator — orchestrate agents to create specs, generate code, and perform reviews, moving faster without sacrificing quality.

- Define and codify AI-Native engineering practices for the Verticals team, establishing playbooks the broader org can adopt.

- Collaborate closely with product managers and designers to turn complex user problems into scalable engineering solutions.

- Contribute to architectural decisions, code reviews, and a culture of craft and continuous improvement.

- Participate in on-call rotation and incident response.

- Mentor team members and contribute to team processes and technical standards.

- Support performance, reliability, and accessibility across the features you own.

- Adapt patterns and services built for Aging in Place to future verticals (Things, Pets) as team scope expands.

What We’re Looking For

- 4+ years of experience building and operating high-quality, consumer-scale services.

- 1+ years of hands-on experience prompting, evaluating, and building with LLMs.

- Full-stack proficiency spanning backend services (Java, Spring Boot, Kafka) and mobile client development (Swift for iOS and/or Kotlin for Android), with the versatility to work across the whole stack as needed.

- Hands-on experience with agentic workflows, prompt engineering, context window management, and MCP/function calling.

- A track record of using AI tooling to multiply your own output — not just as autocomplete, but as a development partner.

- A strong sense of ownership — you don't wait to be told what to fix, and you follow through past "it works on my machine" to "it works for the member, in production, at scale."

- Strong communication and collaboration skills — you work well with product, design, and platform engineers.

- Excitement for defining what it means to be AI-Native — you're not waiting for the playbook, you want to write it.

- Empathy for the humans behind the product — an aging parent trying to stay independent, or a family member trying to help from afar.

- Bachelor's Degree in a Technical field, or equivalent experience.

Nice-to-Have 

- Experience with IoT, telematics, or embedded/hardware-adjacent systems.

- Familiarity with Kafka, Kinesis, or other high-throughput streaming platforms.

- Background with observability tooling (Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry, DataDog).

AI-Native Expectations

We use AI coding tools as a professional standard on this team. Here's what that means in practice:

- Daily use: You use AI coding assistants (we support Claude Code, Cursor, and GitHub Copilot) for real, substantive tasks: analysis, coding, refactoring, testing, navigating codebases, and documentation. Not just research or autocomplete but as a development partner.

- Judgment and ownership: AI-generated code gets the same review you'd give any PR. You are accountable for everything you ship.

- Velocity: We expect senior engineers who use AI well to operate with meaningful leverage — doing more with the same time, taking on problems that would otherwise require a larger team.

- Team leadership: You share what works. You automate prompting strategies that others can build on and help teammates earlier in their AI workflow adoption get up to speed.

- Continuous learning: The tooling is changing fast. You stay current and bring recommendations to the team when something would meaningfully improve how we work.

Our Benefits

- Medical, dental, vision, life and disability insurance plans (100% paid for US employees). We offer life and disability as well as supplemental plans for medical and dental for Canadian employees.

- 401(k) plan with company matching program in the US and RRSP with DPSP plan for Canadian employees.

- Paid parental leave.

- Mental Wellness Program & Employee Assistance Program (EAP) for mental well-being.

- Generous time off: flexible PTO, companywide holidays throughout the year plus summer and winter shutdowns.

- Learning & Development programs.

- Equipment, tools, and reimbursement support for a productive remote environment.

- Free Life360 Platinum Membership and Tile trackers.

AI Usage: We use AI to help make our hiring process efficient. That said, every hiring decision is made by real Life360 hiring teams

Life360 Values

About the Team 

Fanatics Markets is the real-money prediction and trading app where you can invest in moments you care about. Built on a secure platform, we let users predict real-world outcomes and trade on events they actually follow—from sports and entertainment to political elections and beyond. Our mission is to redefine how fans engage with the moments and markets that matter most. We're looking for the right people to help us build the future of prediction markets.

As a Staff Software Engineer within our Platform team, you will help define the technical direction of the platform underpinning our exchange and trading systems. You will lead the design and evolution of our infrastructure and platform standards to support a highly available, low-latency exchange, partnering closely with exchange engineers and engineering leads to enable rapid innovation without compromising stability or security.

This role requires a balance of deep hands-on software engineering, systems thinking and technical leadership. You will lead complex projects that support the exchange—from load-testing environments and mock integrations to monitoring and automated recovery. You will turn ambiguous requirements into practical designs, own delivery from ideation to production and help operate the platform as the exchange goes live. The balance of coding and infrastructure work varies by project, but you should be comfortable independently developing new software as well as improving existing systems, setting platform standards and mentoring engineers across experience levels.

On the engineering side, we are pioneering the use of AI as a code collaborator. We need engineers who have moved beyond experimentation—who actively use tools like Claude Code, Cursor, or GitHub Copilot to ship production code faster while maintaining exceptional quality.

Responsibilities 

- Lead the design and development of software tools, services and automation that solve complex infrastructure, reliability and developer experience challenges.

- Lead the development of load-testing environments and supporting software, including mock services and integrations.

- Establish and evolve standards for AI-augmented development, using effective prompting and validation practices to increase velocity without sacrificing code quality.

- Identify and mitigate AI-generated code pitfalls, such as security vulnerabilities or over-abstraction, and help teams evaluate the impact on quality and productivity.

- Guide the design and implementation of platform security safeguards and compliance standards to protect the integrity of the firm’s systems.

- Shape the system observability roadmap and lead improvements to monitoring, tracing, alerting and automated recovery.

- Partner with exchange, product and engineering leads to resolve architectural trade-offs, align priorities and deliver scalable platform solutions.

- Mentor engineers across experience levels, lead technical design discussions and raise engineering standards across teams.

- Participate in the on-call rotation, lead incident response for team-owned services and drive engineering improvements that prevent recurring incidents.

Skills 

- Significant experience in software, backend or platform engineering, with a track record of leading complex technical projects and delivering production software and scalable, cloud-native environments.

- Deep software development expertise, including the ability to independently design, build, test and deploy services or substantial tools from scratch and guide others through complex implementation decisions.

- Deep hands-on Kubernetes experience, including designing and operating production environments, troubleshooting complex failures, and establishing patterns for high availability and efficient scaling.

- Strong hands-on experience with AWS and infrastructure as code using Terraform, including making architectural decisions across complex environments.

- High proficiency in Java and Python; Go is a plus. You should be comfortable bridging the gap between infrastructure and application logic.

- Deep understanding of distributed systems and the ability to make and explain trade-offs between low latency, high availability, scalability and operational complexity.

- Experience shaping CI/CD and observability approaches, with hands-on knowledge of tools such as Prometheus, Grafana or Datadog.

- Strong proficiency in using AI collaborators such as Claude Code, Cursor or GitHub Copilot to ship production code and improve engineering workflows.

- Ability to evaluate AI-generated code for security gaps or architectural errors and establish rigorous testing and validation practices.

- Strong communication skills, including the ability to explain complex technical decisions, influence without formal authority and collaborate effectively with distributed engineering and product teams.

- Experience mentoring senior engineers and building alignment around technical standards and architectural decisions.

Preferred Qualifications

title: Software Engineer, Robot Autonomy (Actuator Control & Locomotion), Intern
description:
Our Mission

At Laelaps AI, we believe robotics is entering a transformative decade, much like the arrival of the internet. Advances in AI, cloud computing, and hardware are reshaping what autonomous systems can do. Our mission is to build the intelligent software that powers physical security in the real world - enabling robots and sensors to handle dangerous and critical tasks that humans shouldn't have to. By engineering the orchestration layer for intelligent security, we aim to create a world that is safer, more secure, and more resilient.

We're a strong founding team based in Zurich, backed by visionary investors and advisors. We are engineering the future of security today!

The Role

As a Software Engineer intern on Robot Autonomy, you'll train locomotion and low-level control policies for our legged security robots and help take them from simulation to real hardware. You'll work close to the actuators, from joint-level behavior through coordinated locomotion, on robots that patrol outdoor sites across varied terrain and challenging weather.

This role is highly practical: you'll design training setups, run experiments in simulation, transfer policies to physical robots, and measure how they hold up. You'll get hands-on experience with the gap between a policy that works in simulation and one that keeps a robot on its feet on wet ground at night.

What You'll Work On

- Train and evaluate reinforcement learning policies for locomotion and low-level control in simulation.

- Apply sim-to-real techniques such as domain randomization, reward design, and policy robustness methods, and test the results on physical robots.

- Make policies robust to varied terrain, challenging weather, and noisy, delayed, or missing sensor data.

- Explore control approaches that transfer across robot embodiments with different actuators and dynamics.

- Build evaluation workflows with clear metrics and repeatable experiments, in simulation and on hardware.

- Apply solid engineering practices: experiment tracking, version control, reproducible training runs.

Who We're Looking For

We're looking for a motivated robotics or machine learning student excited to apply academic training in a fast-moving startup. You'll be surrounded by a team that values learning, experimentation, and building things that actually work in the real world.

Your Background

title: Director of Engineering
description:
About Wheely 

Wheely is redefining premium transportation across major cities in Europe, the US, and the Middle East. We blend cutting-edge technology with the craft of five-star chauffeuring to deliver an experience trusted by more than 100,000 active riders and 1,200 corporate accounts.

We’re a profitable, fast-growing scale-up with $43M raised and over $100M in annual revenue. Having recently launched in New York City, we’re expanding rapidly across the US and EMEA. If you take pride in your craft and want to help shape the next chapter of our growth, we'd love to hear from you.

About The Role

We're rebuilding Wheely to be the fastest and most reliable ride-hailing app on the planet — one where both the passenger app and the driver app stay responsive on a flaky signal in the back of an apartment building, keep working behind censorship firewalls, and don't drop the real-time guarantees a moving car depends on.

We're also adding something nobody in this category has built seriously: privacy as a product, not a compliance footnote.

This role owns the core that makes all of that possible: the platform, the infrastructure, the privacy primitives the rest of engineering builds on top of, and the internal agent harness that lets teams across the company automate work that used to need humans.

You'll inherit a mostly-Go codebase and a small group of strong engineers. You'll also inherit a genuinely open question on most of what matters. Is microservices the right end state, or did we default into it? How should a backend look in 2026 when AI has absorbed a large share of routine engineering work, when QA isn't a separate function, and when a small senior team paired with a few unusually strong grads can outship a 2019-style org several times its size?

Our main engineering hub is in Cyprus. We're now building up London as a second hub, and this role is part of that — you'd be one of the first senior engineering leaders on the ground here, helping shape what London looks like as a location, who we hire into it, and what work belongs where.

Responsibilities

- Own the technical direction of the platform end to end — including the architectural questions that haven't been answered yet, like whether to keep moving toward microservices or reconsider.

- Make real-time work, end to end. Driver app especially (location, dispatch, ride state) all of it under adversarial network conditions.

- Lead the privacy story on the engineering side — what's actually different about how data flows through our systems vs. every other ride-hailing company.

- Own and grow the agent harness so other teams can wire AI into workflows that used to need people. Today it's Rust. Tomorrow's shape is yours.

- Help build London as an engineering hub. That means hiring into it, deciding (with the rest of the leadership team) what work makes sense in London vs Cyprus, and setting the culture for a new office while staying tightly coupled to the main hub.

Requirements

- You have designed backend systems from scratch (not only maintained, scaled, or rewritten what someone else built). We'll spend real time in the interview on the trade-offs you made and why.

- Real-time systems experience at consumer scale.

- Several years of managing engineers, with hiring and firing calls you'd defend in detail. Total headcount matters less to us than the calibre and the outcomes.

- Based in London. We sponsor visas: you don't need to be in the UK today, you just need to be willing to move. Regular travel to our Cyprus hub expected, especially early on.

What we offer

- Office-based role in West London, four days a week with flexible start and finish times, plus one remote day of your choice

- Employee stock options plan

- Private medical and dental insurance

- Life and critical illness cover

- Latest-generation MacBook Pro and 4k display

- Monthly credit towards Wheely journeys

- Cycle to Work scheme

- Professional development stipend

- Relocation support, including visa sponsorship and allowance

All of your personal information will be collected stored and processed in accordance with Wheely’s Candidate Privacy Notice

title: [Paris] Applied AI Architect, Industries
description:
About Anthropic 

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About the role 

As an Applied AI team member at Anthropic, you will be a pre-sales architect focused on becoming a trusted technical advisor helping large enterprises understand the value of Claude and paint the vision on how they can successfully integrate and deploy Claude into their technology stack. You'll combine your deep technical expertise with customer-facing skills to architect innovative LLM solutions that address complex business challenges while maintaining our high standards for safety and reliability.

Working closely with our Sales, Product, and Engineering teams, you'll guide customers from initial technical discovery through successful deployment. You'll leverage your expertise to help customers understand Claude's capabilities, develop evals, and design scalable architectures that maximize the value of our AI systems.

Responsibilities: 

- 
Partner with account executives to deeply understand customer requirements and translate them into technical solutions, ensuring alignment between business objectives and technical implementation

- 
Serve as the primary technical advisor to enterprise customers throughout their Claude adoption journey, from discovery to initial evaluation through deployment. You will need to coordinate internally across multiple teams & stakeholders to drive customer success

- 
Support customers building with both the Claude API and Claude for Work

- 
Create and deliver compelling technical content tailored to different audiences. You will need to be able to spread the gamut from technical deep dives for engineering & development teams up to business value focused conversations with executives

- 
Guide technical architecture decisions and help customers integrate Claude effectively into their existing technology stack

- 
Help customers develop evaluation frameworks to measure Claude's performance for their specific use cases

- 
Identify common integration patterns and contribute insights back to our Product and Engineering teams

- 
Travel occasionally to customer sites for workshops, technical deep dives, and relationship building

- 
Maintain strong knowledge of the latest developments in LLM capabilities and implementation patterns

You may be a good fit if you have: 

- 
5+ years of experience in technical customer-facing roles such as Solutions Architect, Sales Engineer, or Technical Account Manager

- 
Native or fluent French speaker (C1 or above)

- 
Experience working with enterprise customers, navigating complex buying cycles involving multiple stakeholders

- 
Exceptional ability to build relationships with and communicate technical concepts to diverse stakeholders to include C-suite executives, engineering & IT teams, and more

Strong technical communication skills with the ability to translate customer requirements between technical and business stakeholders

Au sein de l’équipe Applied AI d’Anthropic, vous intervenez comme architecte avant-vente, avec un objectif : devenir le conseil technique de confiance des grandes entreprises. Vous les aidez à comprendre la valeur de Claude et à se projeter sur la façon de l’intégrer et de le déployer avec succès dans leur environnement technologique. Vous alliez une expertise technique pointue à un vrai sens du client pour concevoir des solutions innovantes à base de LLM, qui répondent à des enjeux métier complexes tout en respectant nos exigences élevées de sécurité et de fiabilité.

En lien étroit avec nos équipes Sales, Produit et Engineering, vous accompagnez les clients depuis le cadrage technique initial jusqu’au déploiement. - Travailler avec les account executives pour comprendre en profondeur les besoins des clients et les traduire en solutions techniques, en alignant objectifs métier et mise en œuvre

- Être le conseil technique principal des grands comptes tout au long de leur adoption de Claude, du cadrage à l’évaluation initiale puis au déploiement, en coordonnant en interne les différentes équipes et parties prenantes pour assurer leur réussite

- Accompagner les clients qui développent aussi bien avec l’API Claude qu’avec Claude for Work

Ce poste est fait pour vous si vous avez

Aucune. Les candidatures sont étudiées au fil de l’eau.

Annual Salary:

€190.000 — €220.000 EUR

Minimum years of experience: Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position

Location-based hybrid policy: Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices.

Visa sponsorship: We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this.

title: CDI - Senior Context & Analytics Engineer - Paris
description:
Mission 

Un agent ne vaut que ce que valent les données et les connaissances sur lesquelles il répond. Pipelines, modèles de données, définitions de métriques, droits d’accès : vous créez et gouvernez ce socle, et les applications et les agents de nos clients s’appuient dessus. Quand un analyste ou un agent demande un chiffre, la réponse est celle de l’équipe finance, accompagnée de sa définition et de sa source.

Ce poste est fait pour vous si vous voulez que les métiers et les agents puissent se fier aux données, et les utilisent. 

Artefact accompagne les plus grandes entreprises du monde dans le déploiement de l’IA : 3 000 AI makers dans plus de 30 pays, plus de 1 000 clients. En France, le département Engineering réunit environ 300 personnes sous la responsabilité du CTO ; vous y rejoignez le chapter AI Applied Engineer, archétype Context & Analytics Engineer.

Activités et responsabilités 

Avec les équipes métier et les analystes, il s’agit de définir ce que signifie chaque métrique et de vérifier que les données y correspondent. Sur ce socle, les Product Engineers et les AI Engineers construisent applications et agents.

Les Platform Engineers exploitent l’infrastructure sur laquelle tournent vos pipelines. Les échanges avec les data owners et les équipes de gouvernance du client, la relecture de code entre pairs et l’accompagnement des nouvelles recrues complètent le quotidien.

Vos responsabilités : 

- Construire des pipelines d’ingestion et des modèles de données, avec dbt par exemple.

- Mettre en place des contrôles de qualité des données et maintenir le lineage.

- Construire la couche sémantique et les définitions de métriques, pour que les personnes et les agents utilisent les mêmes chiffres, y compris en text-to-SQL.

- Définir les règles de gouvernance et les droits d’accès.

- Construire des pipelines de connaissances pour le RAG : indexation, chunking, métadonnées, permissions.

- Préparer le contexte exploitable par les agents : métadonnées, définitions, lineage et permissions.

Profil recherché 

Les indispensables : 

- Vous écrivez du SQL avec aisance et modélisez les données pour l’analyse.

- Des pipelines de données planifiés, testés et surveillés figurent à votre actif.

- Aux côtés des équipes métier, vous définissez les métriques et vérifiez que les données veulent bien dire ce que tout le monde croit y lire.

- La qualité des données, la documentation et les droits d’accès comptent pour vous.

- Les coding agents font déjà partie de votre quotidien, et vous vérifiez ce qu’ils produisent.

Un plus, pas un prérequis : 

- Python pour le traitement de données.

- Une plateforme de données cloud, comme BigQuery, Snowflake ou Databricks.

- Une couche sémantique ou un metrics store.

- La préparation de documents pour le RAG : chunking, indexation, métadonnées.

- Des outils de data catalogue ou de lineage.

Pas besoin de cocher toutes les cases pour postuler : si vous avez l’essentiel des indispensables et l’envie d’apprendre le reste, parlons-en.

Pourquoi nous rejoindre ? 

Dans un métier où deux tableaux de bord affichent parfois deux chiffres différents, ce poste consiste à rétablir la confiance : un chiffre juste, une définition partagée, une source identifiable. Ce travail, discret quand il réussit, conditionne tout ce que les autres archétypes construisent au-dessus.

Nous sommes des AI makers : l’IA se construit avec nos clients, pas seulement pour eux. Leurs enjeux deviennent les nôtres, et nos choix techniques s’expliquent dans le langage du métier. Les positions que nous prenons sont claires ; elles évoluent face aux faits, jamais sous la pression.

Notre domaine change tous les mois, et ce rythme nous convient : les nouvelles technologies et les nouveaux secteurs s’apprennent vite, et les habitudes qui ne servent plus s’abandonnent sans regret. Devant un problème difficile, le réflexe est de le découper en étapes vérifiables, avec un haut niveau d’exigence sur le code comme sur les livrables.

Quand il manque quelque chose, pour un client ou pour le chapter, nous le construisons. La progression passe par des retours constructifs, par le partage des connaissances, par la demande d’aide sans attendre et par la reconnaissance du travail des autres. Il y a beaucoup à apprendre, et beaucoup à construire.

Un counsellor accompagne vos premiers mois. L’onboarding technique ouvre le parcours, suivi d’un premier projet client ; si aucun n’est prêt, les starter kits internes prennent le relais.

Le reste s’apprend sur les projets, avec les AI Engineers et l’appui de la communauté Context & Analytics Engineer, notamment le context engineering, c’est-à-dire le travail qui rend les données exploitables par les agents d’IA. À partir de 2027, l’archétype Context & Analytics Engineer disposera de sa propre grille de compétences et de son propre parcours de formation, en plus du socle commun à tous les AI Applied Engineers (évaluation de l’IA, responsabilité en production).

Plus tard, un rôle transverse devient possible (Project Tech Lead, Pre-sales Engineer, Engineering Manager), tout comme les chapters AI Architect et AI Product Manager.

Processus de recrutement 

Le processus demande environ quatre heures, réparties en six étapes dont une seule sur site.

- Entretien RH (45 min, à distance) : parcours, motivations et points pratiques, comme le calendrier et les prétentions salariales.

- Appel avec le CTO (15 à 30 min, à distance).

- Screening technique (30 min, à distance, avec un membre du chapter AI Applied Engineer) : retour détaillé sur vos projets passés, puis questions techniques et de design de solution.

- Code review et live coding (60 min, sur site, avec un membre du chapter) : relecture d’un dépôt de code existant et correction de ses défauts, puis construction d’une nouvelle fonctionnalité avec un coding agent et présentation du résultat.

- Cas technique (45 min, à distance, avec un membre du chapter) : cadrage d’un problème métier, proposition d’une solution technique, description de la méthode d’évaluation, puis discussion de vos choix.

- Entretien final (30 min, à distance, avec une personne de l’encadrement du département, Engineering Manager ou Director) : reprise des points restés ouverts, choix de l’archétype et du niveau les mieux adaptés à votre profil, et réponses à toutes vos questions.

Selon les étapes, tous les outils d’IA sont autorisés, ou aucun. Lors du live coding, c’est la manière de travailler avec l’assistance de l’IA qui est observée.

Rémunération : 53 000€ à 70 000€ brut annuel (fixe) + variable selon expérience et séniorité

Chez Artefact, nous sommes convaincus que la diversité des parcours, des expériences et des perspectives fait la richesse de nos équipes. Nous nous engageons à offrir un environnement inclusif et des opportunités équitables, où chacune et chacun peut évoluer et exprimer pleinement son potentiel. Nos recrutements reposent sur les compétences, le potentiel et l’adéquation avec le rôle.

- Définir les règles de gouvernance et les droits d’accès.

- Construire des pipelines de connaissances pour le RAG : indexation, chunking, métadonnées, permissions.

- Préparer le contexte exploitable par les agents : métadonnées, définitions, lineage et permissions.

Profil recherché 

Les indispensables : 

- Vous écrivez du SQL avec aisance et modélisez les données pour l’analyse.

- Des pipelines de données planifiés, testés et surveillés figurent à votre actif.

- Aux côtés des équipes métier, vous définissez les métriques et vérifiez que les données veulent bien dire ce que tout le monde croit y lire.

- La qualité des données, la documentation et les droits d’accès comptent pour vous.

- Les coding agents font déjà partie de votre quotidien, et vous vérifiez ce qu’ils produisent.

Un plus, pas un prérequis : 

- Python pour le traitement de données.

- Une plateforme de données cloud, comme BigQuery, Snowflake ou Databricks.

- Une couche sémantique ou un metrics store.

- La préparation de documents pour le RAG : chunking, indexation, métadonnées.

- Des outils de data catalogue ou de lineage.

Pas besoin de cocher toutes les cases pour postuler : si vous avez l’essentiel des indispensables et l’envie d’apprendre le reste, parlons-en.

Pourquoi nous rejoindre ? 

Dans un métier où deux tableaux de bord affichent parfois deux chiffres différents, ce poste consiste à rétablir la confiance : un chiffre juste, une définition partagée, une source identifiable. Ce travail, discret quand il réussit, conditionne tout ce que les autres archétypes construisent au-dessus.

Nous sommes des AI makers : l’IA se construit avec nos clients, pas seulement pour eux. Leurs enjeux deviennent les nôtres, et nos choix techniques s’expliquent dans le langage du métier. Les positions que nous prenons sont claires ; elles évoluent face aux faits, jamais sous la pression.

Notre domaine change tous les mois, et ce rythme nous convient : les nouvelles technologies et les nouveaux secteurs s’apprennent vite, et les habitudes qui ne servent plus s’abandonnent sans regret. Devant un problème difficile, le réflexe est de le découper en étapes vérifiables, avec un haut niveau d’exigence sur le code comme sur les livrables.

Quand il manque quelque chose, pour un client ou pour le chapter, nous le construisons. La progression passe par des retours constructifs, par le partage des connaissances, par la demande d’aide sans attendre et par la reconnaissance du travail des autres. Il y a beaucoup à apprendre, et beaucoup à construire.

À partir de 2027, l’archétype Context & Analytics Engineer disposera de sa propre grille de compétences et de son propre parcours de formation, en plus du socle commun à tous les AI Applied Engineers (évaluation de l’IA, responsabilité en production).

Plus tard, un rôle transverse devient possible (Project Tech Lead, Pre-sales Engineer, Engineering Manager), tout comme les chapters AI Architect et AI Product Manager.

Processus de recrutement 

Le processus demande environ quatre heures, réparties en six étapes dont une seule sur site.

- Entretien RH (45 min, à distance) : parcours, motivations et points pratiques, comme le calendrier et les prétentions salariales.

- Appel avec le CTO (15 à 30 min, à distance).

- Screening technique (30 min, à distance, avec un membre du chapter AI Applied Engineer) : retour détaillé sur vos projets passés, puis questions techniques et de design de solution.

- Code review et live coding (60 min, sur site, avec un membre du chapter) : relecture d’un dépôt de code existant et correction de ses défauts, puis construction d’une nouvelle fonctionnalité avec un coding agent et présentation du résultat.

- Cas technique (45 min, à distance, avec un membre du chapter) : cadrage d’un problème métier, proposition d’une solution technique, description de la méthode d’évaluation, puis discussion de vos choix.

- Entretien final (30 min, à distance, avec une personne de l’encadrement du département, Engineering Manager ou Director) : reprise des points restés ouverts, choix de l’archétype et du niveau les mieux adaptés à votre profil, et réponses à toutes vos questions.

Selon les étapes, tous les outils d’IA sont autorisés, ou aucun. Lors du live coding, c’est la manière de travailler avec l’assistance de l’IA qui est observée.

Nous nous engageons à offrir un environnement inclusif et des opportunités équitables, où chacune et chacun peut évoluer et exprimer pleinement son potentiel. Nos recrutements reposent sur les compétences, le potentiel et l’adéquation avec le rôle.

title: Applied AI Engineer - AI Finance Agent
description:
About BJAK 

The original mission of BJAK is we believe people deserve smarter ways to plan, save and grow their money. This is the origin of our name.

Started in 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, its the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

Today, we are expanding ways to help people in the region — this includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our mission is help people get more from their money every day.

We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities from our offices and remotely, who truly enjoys their work. We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.

The Role 

We are looking for applied AI engineers to build AI-native systems for BJAK's AI Finance Agent.

This is not a research-only role. We need builders who can use AI to automate real workflows, improve products, reduce manual work and make financial services easier for users and teams.

What You'll Own 

- 
Build AI-powered workflows, assistants, agents and automation systems.

- 
Apply AI across customer support, CRM, onboarding, claims, renewals, payments, operations and internal tools.

- 
Work with product and engineering teams to turn manual processes into scalable AI-native systems.

- 
Build integrations with LLMs, internal data, APIs, documents, knowledge bases and business systems.

- 
Design evaluation, monitoring and fallback flows so AI outputs are useful, safe and reliable.

- 
Prototype quickly, test with users or operators, then productionize what works.

- 
Improve speed, quality and consistency across workflows using AI where it creates real business value.

What We're Looking For 

- 
Strong software engineering foundation, preferably with Python and backend systems.

- 
Hands-on experience building with LLM APIs, agents, RAG, workflow automation or AI tools.

- 
Able to connect AI systems with real product, data and operational workflows.

- 
Good judgement on where AI helps and where rule-based systems or human review are better.

- 
Understands evaluation, accuracy, latency, cost, privacy and failure modes.

- 
Fast builder who can prototype, test and ship practical systems.

- 
Experience in fintech, insurance, support automation, CRM or operations automation is a strong advantage.

The Kind of Builder We Want 

- 
Practical AI builder, not just a prompt experimenter.

- 
Thinks in workflows, systems and measurable quality.

- 
Can build quickly but still cares about guardrails and reliability.

- 
Comfortable working with messy real-world data and processes.

- 
Honest about what AI can and cannot do.

This Role Is Not For 

- 
People who only want research projects with no production ownership.

- 
Candidates who treat AI as demos instead of working systems.

- 
Engineers who do not care about evaluation, reliability or user impact.

- 
People who overclaim AI impact without evidence.

- 
Builders who cannot work with product, ops and business teams.

Location 

This role is remote, but candidates must be based in Netherlands . We are hiring specifically for this market, so applicants should already be based in Netherlands. 

Language 

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

Interview Process 

Our process is designed to move fast:

- 
Online assessment or practical task

- 
Technical interview

- 
CEO / final round

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

title: Front End Developer
description:
Job Title: Front-End Developer
Location: Fully Remote (US)
Department: Global Enrollment Marketing and Sales
Reports to: Director of Web Development
Classification: Regular, Full-time
FLSA Status: Exempt
Prepared by: Global Head of Creative
Prepared Date: 10/1/26
Salary range: $85,000â$100,000

About Edconic 

Edconic is a leading player in the alternative, experiential education space. We partner with the world's largest and most well-known brands to create and run schools that capture the legacy and value of each brand. Our students get truly unique, once-in-a-lifetime experiences that help shape their future and give them the skills they need to reach their goals.

Our Mission: 

Edconic exists to help learners stand out, move forward, and build meaningful futures in the fields that inspire them. We bring together education and industry, partnering with iconic global organizations to create transformative learning experiences. Our programs are created and delivered by educators and industry practitioners, giving learners access to professional experts, real world challenges, and practical skills. As early career opportunities shrink, we offer credibility, connections, and hands on experience that internships once provided. We prepare learners not simply for their first job but for a lifetime of growth.

Our values 

- Transformative education: relationship-rich, experiential learning that draws out each learnerâs potential.
- Belonging: a community where learners, educators, experts, and staff can bring their authentic selves and support one another.
- Stewardship: as a family-owned organization, we think in generations, developing talent, caring for our partnerships, and building an impact that lasts.

The Role 

We're looking for an experienced Front-End Developer to join our web team, which owns every Edconic digital property â from our school websites to landing pages and email templates. You'll work alongside designers, IT, and MarTech to build solutions that serve real business needs while protecting each brand's unique identity.

You'll be one of two developers on the team, working directly with our lead developer. That means real ownership of your work, a genuine voice in how we build, very little process overhead, and a codebase that is actively moving toward a modern, standardized WordPress stack. We value craft: fast pages and code that the next developer can read.

What You'll Do 

- Build and maintain public-facing websites, micro-sites, and landing pages in collaboration with our lead developer, IT, and MarTech.
- Work with UX/UI designers to confirm the technical feasibility of designs, then translate them into polished, responsive pages that stay true to each brand.
- Build and maintain custom WordPress themes across both of our stacks: modern block-based builds (ACF Blocks, core blocks, block patterns, theme.json) and established classic themes built on PHP templates, Advanced Custom Fields, and Sass.
- Collaborate with our lead developer to shape the team's coding standards, tooling, and workflow, and help migrate our existing sites toward our new modern stack.
- Stay current on emerging web standards and bring ideas to the table where they genuinely fit.

What You Bring 

- 4+ years of front-end web development experience, with strong skills in semantic HTML, CSS, JavaScript, PHP, and WordPress.
- The ability to build a custom WordPress theme from scratch using PHP templates and Advanced Custom Fields.
- Strong CSS skills across Sass and modern native CSS (custom properties, nesting), and solid vanilla JavaScript.
- Comfort working in Git/GitHub with pull requests and code reviews, and with npm-based build tools and the command line.
- A habit of writing semantic, well-structured HTML that covers accessibility basics, with an eye for reuse, cross-browser compatibility, performance, and SEO.
- Experience building and testing HTML emails.
- Strong UX/UI sensibilities and a desire to sweat the small stuff.
- A proactive, self-directed working style â you can run with a project independently and prioritize across several at once.
- Excellent written and verbal communication â you're positive, collaborative, objective, and solution-oriented.

Bonus Experience 

- Modern WordPress block development: ACF Blocks, block.json, theme.json, and block patterns.
- Composer, Bedrock or other Roots tooling (Sage/Blade, Trellis), Vite, or CI/CD with GitHub Actions.
- Deeper accessibility experience (WCAG, ARIA, assistive-technology testing).
- CRM and marketing automation integration (Salesforce, Pardot/Account Engagement).
- Multilingual WordPress sites.
- A modern JavaScript framework such as React or Vue.
- UX or UI design, and design tools such as Figma and Adobe Creative Suite.

How We Use AI 

AI-assisted development is a new and evolving part of our workflow. We use AI coding tools to speed up research, scaffolding, review, and routine work, and you're welcome to do the same.

AI is a tool here, not a substitute for expertise. You are accountable for every line of code that you ship, which means you must be able to write, review, debug, and explain production code entirely on your own. Expect to demonstrate those skills without AI assistance during the interview process.

Location, Travel & Eligibility 

- Fully remote within the United States. Occasional travel to our New York office may be required.
- Must be legally authorized to work in the US.
- Bachelor's degree preferred (Computer Science, Interaction Design, Graphic Design, Communications, or a related field); equivalent professional experience is equally welcome.

Our Commitment 

Edconic supports and embraces diversity and inclusiveness, and we encourage candidates from all backgrounds to apply, even if you don't meet every requirement listed here. Reasonable accommodations are available to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of the role and to participate in the interview process.

The above statements describe the general nature and level of work for this position. They are not an exhaustive list of all duties, responsibilities, and skills. Edconic reserves the right to modify this job description at its sole discretion.

title: Confirmed / Senior Machine Learning Engineer (Jobexit)
description:
Notre mission ⚖️ 

Chez Doctrine, nous construisons le leader de l’IA juridique en Europe.

Notre conviction ? Le droit ne doit pas être ralenti par des tâches répétitives. Il doit être augmenté par une IA spécialisée, conçue pour comprendre, analyser et produire du raisonnement juridique avec un haut niveau d’exigence.

Notre ambition ? Permettre aux professionnels du droit de gagner en fiabilité, en efficacité et en sérénité, grâce à une plateforme unique, exhaustive et sécurisée.

Aujourd’hui, 27 000 professionnels du droit, répartis dans cinq pays (France, Italie, Allemagne, Espagne, Luxembourg), nous font confiance.

Notre développement est guidé par une approche claire : une vision globale, ancrée dans une compréhension fine des spécificités locales.

Derrière cette ambition, une équipe d’environ 250 personnes, réunies autour d’un même objectif : accompagner les juristes et avocats à toutes les étapes de leur travail, de l’analyse à la rédaction.

Et nous n’en sommes qu’au début.

Le contexte

Doctrine développe des workflows dédiés aux professionnels du droit pour accélérer et améliorer la gestion de leurs dossiers. Parmi eux, la squad Jobexit accompagne les avocats et juristes en droit social dans la simulation de ruptures du contrat de travail, notamment en calculant les indemnités de départ, les indemnités en cas de contentieux, le calendrier de sortie et les allocations chômage.

Le scope de la squad s'est considérablement enrichi au-delà du simulateur, en allant vers la gestion de cabinet d’avocat à travers plusieurs langues.

Tu peux trouver des détails sur l’ensemble de la stack sur Github !

A savoir : il n’est pas nécessaire d’avoir une expérience professionnelle dans le domaine du droit, cependant l’envie de s’investir et de monter en compétence dans la compréhension des documents juridique est importante :)

Les missions 🛠 

- Apporter de la compréhension et de l’automatisation autour des activités administratives et commerciales des avocats.

- Générer automatiquement des documents administratifs propres aux dossiers de l’avocat.

- Tirer parti de la jurimétrie et des simulations existantes pour apporter du contexte et des suggestions personnalisées autour d’une simulation de rupture de contrat de travail.

- Étudier le développement d’un chatbot spécialisé sur la plateforme Jobexit.

- Collaborer avec différents types de profils (ingénieurs, product managers, product designers, juristes) pour identifier de nouveaux axes de développement produit.

- Participer à la diffusion interne et à la consolidation de nos bonnes pratiques dans le chapter ML ; contribuer à l’élaboration de notre stratégie Engineering.

- Faire monter en compétence les autres ingénieurs de l’équipe.

Le profil idéal 👀 

- Une expérience significative en termes de construction de produits reposants sur des modèles de machine learning, de classification, de résumé, de génération de contenu, etc.

- Une bonne connaissance du machine learning et en particuliers des modèles de deep learning.

- Une capacité à délivrer rapidement des prototypes dans un environnement product-centric.

- Un fort intérêt pour les sujets d’intelligence artificielle.

- L’envie d’identifier, d'analyser, et d'intégrer en production les dernières avancées scientifiques dans le domaine.

- Une bonne maîtrise du développement Python, avec un focus sur la construction d’algorithmes.

- La maîtrise de la langue française et anglaise.

Les à côtés du poste 👁 

- Comme tous les ingénieurs de Doctrine, tu participeras à un de nos chapters transverses, en l’espèce du chapter Data Science.

- Au sein de ce chapter, tu contribueras à des projets internes pour améliorer nos process et notre vision long-terme. Le chapter se réunit toutes les semaines pour :

- 🤝 Partager des connaissances : suivit de l’état de l’art, revue de papiers scientifiques, amélioration continue, bonnes pratiques, etc.

- 🎯 Proposer des évolutions : nouveaux outils à expérimenter, nouveaux process à mettre en œuvre.

- Tu participeras également au 👩‍💻 recrutement : tous les contributeurs individuels rencontrent des candidats à l’occasion de tests techniques ou d’entretiens.

Ce qui t'attend si tu rejoins Doctrine 🤝 

- Contribuer à un projet ambitieux, avec un impact réel et positif sur la société : rendre le droit plus accessible et plus ouvert.

title: Senior Power Electronics Engineer
description:
About Us 

Harmattan AI is a next-generation defense prime building autonomous and scalable defense systems. Following the close of a $200M Series B, valuing the company at $1.4 billion, we are expanding our teams and capabilities to deliver mission-critical systems to allied forces.

Our work is guided by clear values: building technologies with real-world impact, pursuing excellence in everything we do, setting ambitious goals, and taking on the hardest technical challenges. We operate in a demanding environment where rigor, ownership, and execution are expected.

About the Role 

Power electronics are the bottleneck on every next-generation UAS airframe we build: motor controllers, gate drivers, and DC-DC stages are what define flight time, payload, thermal envelope, and field reliability. We're looking for a senior IC to own the analog power chain end-to-end across our UXV platforms: from MOSFET commutation simulation through PCB layout to lab validation. You will be the technical reference on power electronics inside our Lausanne engineering hub, unblocking propulsion, airframe, and embedded teams in parallel as we scale from prototype cadence to multi-platform deployment.

This is a builder role, not a research seat. You ship hardware.

Responsibilities 

- Power Stage Architecture: Lead motor-controller and DC-DC topology across fixed-wing, multicopter, and hybrid UXV platforms. Translate mission constraints into power-chain specification.

- MOSFET Commutation & Gate-Drive Design: Own the analog switching design: dead-time tuning, gate shaping, switching-loss vs EMI vs thermal trade-offs.

- Multi-fidelity Simulation: Deploy the full stack: analytical loss budgeting, transient SPICE (LTspice), system-level modelling in PLECS or Simulink.

- BLDC Drive Stages: Design three-phase inverters with integrated current sensing, protection, Trapezoidal and FOC-aware hardware interfaces.

- High-Power-Density PCBA: Lead schematic and layout in Altium or KiCad with thermal, parasitics, and EMC engineered in from the first revision.

- EMI / EMC Engineering: Drive pre-compliance, filter design, and root-cause debug under flight-representative loads.

- Prototype-to-Production: Take motor-controller PCBAs through revision discipline, DFM, and qualification - closing the loop on field returns.

- Lab Validation: Execute bench characterization (power analysers, oscilloscopes, thermal imaging, double-pulse testing) and reconcile against simulation.

- Firmware & Controls Interface: Partner with embedded and propulsion on FOC tuning, current-sense calibration, and the hardware/firmware compensation boundary.

- Design Authority & Mentorship: Set the bar via design-decision records and reference designs. Mentor 1–2 junior engineers.

Candidate Requirements 

- MSc or PhD in Electrical Engineering, Power Electronics, or equivalent.

- 5+ years of hands-on R&D experience on motor drives, BLDC/PMSM controllers, or high-power-density power electronics.

- Deep working mastery of MOSFET commutation design : gate-driver selection, dead-time tuning, switching transitions, loss budgets.

- Proven ownership of at least one motor-controller PCBA shipped from prototype through production (or pre-production qualification) : ideally on drone, robotics, eVTOL, or automotive platforms.

- Fluency in simulation (LTspice, PLECS, or Simulink) and PCB design (Altium).

- Strong, hard-earned intuition for EMI / EMC design and debug.

- Lab-bench discipline: you've personally debugged what simulation missed.

- Comfort with scale-up iteration speed and end-to-end ownership.

- English fluent (working language); French is a nice-to-have, not a requirement.

Bonus points for: GaN / SiC experience, safety-critical design exposure , applied control theory implemented in hardware, exposure to defense, aerospace, or UAS programmes.

We look forward to hearing how you can help shape the future of autonomous defense systems at Harmattan AI.

Mozilla Corporation is the non-profit-backed technology company that has shaped the internet for the better over the last 25 years. We make pioneering brands like Firefox, the privacy-minded web browser. Now, with more than 225 million people around the world using our products each month, we’re shaping the next 25 years of technology and helping to reclaim an internet built for people, not companies. Our work focuses on diverse areas including AI, social media, security and more. And we’re doing this while never losing our focus on our core mission – to make the internet better for people. 

The Mozilla Corporation is wholly owned by the non-profit 501(c) Mozilla Foundation. This means we aren’t beholden to any shareholders — only to our mission. Along with thousands of volunteer contributors and collaborators all over the world, Mozillians design, build and distribute open-source software that enables people to enjoy the internet on their terms. 

About the OS Integration team: 

The OS Integration team ensures Firefox works well with the host operating system and environment. We’re a distributed team with expertise in Windows, macOS, and Linux-based operating systems. Our responsibilities include developing fixes and improvements for Firefox related to Windows, macOS, and Linux environments. This might include integration with a new OS feature or fixing an OS-specific user interface bug. Other responsibilities include native crash reporting, OS abstraction layers, sandboxing, hardening, installer, updater, device APIs, and enterprise DLP support. 

About the role: 

As a member of the OS Integration team, you’ll develop fixes, improvements, and new features for Firefox. The role will be focused on Firefox on Windows, but projects may have a cross-platform component. This role will include development of features for Firefox in enterprise environments and especially implementation of Data Loss Prevention (DLP) features. You’ll contribute to the team through code review and discussion. 

What you’ll do: 

- Improve the quality of Firefox and other Mozilla products by debugging and fixing software defects, improving the browsing experience for hundreds of millions of users. 

- Contribute to new features and improvements. 

- Break down tasks and work with others to deliver solutions. 

- Collaborate with experienced software engineers. 

- Perform code reviews and provide technical direction. 

- Work with a geographically-distributed development team. 

- Interact with teams throughout the organization. 

What you’ll bring: 

- 5+ years of overall software engineering experience 

- Experience with desktop application development on Windows with C++ (will consider experience with C++ on macOS or Linux). 

- Strong knowledge of C, C++, and assembly language such as x64, x86, or arm64. 

- Knowledge of web technologies such as Javascript, HTML, and CSS. 

- Knowledge of secure coding practices and memory safety concerns. 

- Strong problem-solving and debugging skills. 

- Written and verbal communication skills with a collaborative mindset. 

- Willingness to work effectively in a distributed team environment. 

- Commitment to our values: 

- Welcoming differences 

- Being relationship-minded 

- Practicing responsible participation 

- Having grit 

Bonus Points for experience with: 

- Enterprise DLP development or deployment 

- Open-source contributions or personal engineering projects 

What you’ll get: 

- Generous performance-based bonus plans to all eligible employees - we share in our success as one team 

- Generous retirement contributions with 100% immediate vesting (regardless of whether you contribute) 

- Quarterly all-company wellness days where everyone takes a pause together 

- Country specific holidays plus a day off for your birthday 

- One-time home office stipend 

- Annual professional development budget 

- Considerable paid parental leave 

- Employee referral bonus program 

- Other benefits (life/AD&D, disability, EAP, etc. - varies by country) 

About Mozilla 

Mozilla exists to build the Internet as a public resource accessible to all because we believe that open and free is better than closed and controlled. When you work at Mozilla, you give yourself a chance to make a difference in the lives of Web users everywhere. And you give us a chance to make a difference in your life every single day. Join us to work on the Web as the platform and help create more opportunity and innovation for everyone online.

Commitment to diversity, equity, inclusion, and belonging 

Mozilla understands that valuing diverse creative practices and forms of knowledge are crucial to and enrich the company’s core mission. We encourage applications from everyone, including members of all equity-seeking communities, such as (but certainly not limited to) women, racialized and Indigenous persons, persons with disabilities, persons of all sexual orientation s, gender identities, and expressions.

We will ensure that qualified individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodations to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment, as appropriate. Please contact us at We are an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race (including hairstyle and texture), religion (including religious grooming and dress practices), gender, gender identity, gender expression, color, national origin, pregnancy, ancestry, domestic partner status, disability, sexual orientation, age, genetic predisposition, medical condition, marital status, citizenship status, military or veteran status, or any other basis covered by applicable laws. Mozilla will not tolerate discrimination or harassment based on any of these characteristics or any other unlawful behavior, conduct, or purpose.
